bestiary.hemomancy.locked.title: Unrecorded Lifeform
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.black_yeast: Raised by the Veiled Fold, who live in screened clefts beyond the sunlight. Its partner is a black yeast that darkens its tissue. A guest there is given one room, not the house, and nobody is owed anyone else's history.

A shaggy pale cap that blackens from the rim and digests itself into ink, as ink cap mushrooms do. A melanised black yeast lives in the tissue, and the dark parts drink up nearly all the light that reaches them. The veil hangs from the cap and blurs the host's outline. Hostiles notice the host late, and when that fails the strain spends itself as ink and gets them out. It's escape tissue. It won't help you ambush anything.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the black yeast partner, found in swamps, dark forests, mushroom ground and dark places. Incubate with Ink Sac, Chromatophores and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.bone_bacter: Raised by Last Marrow, who make their homes inside whale falls and the bones of great bodies. Its partner is a bacterium that dissolves bone. Their rooted elders live inside hollow bones by choice, and they can still uproot.

Bone-white flesh beading bright red, with scarlet clubs that rise into feathery crowns like stalked sea lilies. A partner bacterium dissolves bone, so the strain feeds on remains, on bone blocks and on whatever a fight leaves behind. It roots into bone to feed and can pull free again, the way a sea lily lets go of its stalk and crawls off. Kills yield more with it. Nothing's wasted, which I appreciate in a specimen.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the bone bacteria partner, found in deserts, badlands, jungles, forests and buried soil and stone. Incubate with Bone Worm Colony, Bone and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.cold_bacter: Raised by the Still Bell, who keep a sealed refuge in cold deep water from one generation to the next. Its partner is a bacterium that thrives in the cold. Their elders sleep folded in the bell and are woken only when their knowledge is needed.

A frost-grey mantle that folds around the host in layers and closes into a bell when things go badly. The tissue hardens like a sclerotium, the dormant fungal mass that waits out a winter, and a cold-loving bacterium keeps it working where most tissue would stall. It slows hunger and air loss, sheds poison and holds the host shut through a killing blow. Stillness is its preferred state. It seems to resent being worn at a run.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the cold bacteria partner, found in taiga, old growth and on stony heights. Incubate with Cleansing Hemolymph, Packed Ice and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.coralline_a: Raised by the Holding Stone, keepers of the rocky shallows and the tide-pool refuges. Its partner is a red alga that cements itself to stone. Their elders brace the refuge entrances in holdfast masses, anchored, not petrified: they can still let go.

Knotted, root-like growth at the hands and feet that cements to stone the way a kelp holdfast does. It lives with an encrusting red alga that lays down its own cement, which accounts for the pink flecks. It doesn't plate the host or grow a shell. It grips. On stone or underwater the host is very hard to shift, and the strain braces hardest with someone sheltering behind it.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the coralline alga partner, found on stone and high rocky ground. Incubate with Chitinous Husk, Kelp and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.gut_bacteri: Raised by the Shared Wake, whose families live as a travelling school in open water. Its partner is a gut bacterium that digests blood. They raise the sail to herd prey and take turns striking, and the purse feeds whoever falls behind.

A fast, cobalt-backed strain that grows finlets, a sail along the spine and, late on, a crescent tail. The flank purses are a fungal trick, small cups that hold banked blood. A gut bacterium in the tissue digests that blood, so the strain can store a kill and spend it later on whoever's bleeding worst. Bats share blood with their roost-mates the same way. It feeds best at speed, and it's calmer with company in the water.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the gut bacteria partner, found in open water, rivers and swamps. Incubate with Raw Pelagic Herring, Cod and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.light_bacte: Raised by the Woven Current, whose settlements hang on lines between canyon walls and come apart and rejoin as they need. Its partner is a bacterium that makes its light. They hold that a connection should be free to make and free to release.

Translucent violet-blue veins that branch, join and let go again, like a slime mould streaming between meals. It throws ribbon strands that catch on blocks and on allies, and links them into beaded chains. The pulse running down each strand is light, made by a partner bacterium. Either end can drop a strand, and the strain doesn't seem to care which. It's named for the seaweed, not for a dead man. I checked.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the light bacteria partner, found in water, in forests and in dark places underground. Incubate with Ganglion Cluster, Glow Ink Sac and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.sun_alga.co: Raised by the Giving Light, the house at the sunlit top of the Court. Its partner is a green alga that feeds it sunlight. The arbors around their lighthouse are hosts anchored among the fronds, and every one of them can still walk away.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.sun_alga.de: Gold-orange lichen that crusts the shoulders and fans out into fronds. It keeps a green alga alive in its tissue and lives on what that alga makes from sunlight, so a host under open sky barely needs to eat. The fronds ruffle like a sea slug's flaps for the same reason: more surface, more light. Under a roof it's a passenger. It'll feed a failing companion before it looks after its own host, and I haven't found the mechanism for that preference.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.sun_alga.so: Grown from wild polyps carrying the sun alga partner, found on open ground and in sunlit water. Incubate with Hematic Algal Crust, Sea Pickle and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.vent_bacter: Raised by the Kindling, who live among the hydrothermal vents and call them Hydra's heads. Its partner is a vent bacterium that lives on heat. They cultivate the strain for a lifetime, and the regrown tissue is meant to replace the human form in the end.

A pale polyp along the spine that buds at the nape and grows a mane of trailing tentacles, amber at the root and crimson at the tips. It reproduces by budding, like a yeast, and regrows lost tissue the way a freshwater hydra regrows its whole body. The tentacles sting, and late on a second head buds from the shoulder in a fight. A vent bacterium in the tissue lives on heat and sulfur. The mane looks like fire and doesn't burn. I tested that too.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the vent bacteria partner, found in deserts, badlands, jungles and deep stone. Incubate with Giant Tube Worm Colony, Magma Cream and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.barbed_urchi: A defensive reef organism whose spines keep up a blood-warm sting long after they are pulled out.
Grazes the Erythrocoral Reef bottom and other red aquatic growth. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.blood_lanter: A drifting bell of translucent flesh that pulses like a lamp behind closed eyes.
Mostly the Midnight Ocean. A few drift into reefs and neighboring depths. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.bloody_belly: Transparent lobes reveal a crimson gut while moving comb rows catch the dark water's light.
Midnight water, with sparse Twilight and Carrion visitors. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chalybeate_s: An armored grazer that gathers among heated, iron-rich mineral aprons and withdraws beneath its shell.
Mineral chimneys in Hydrothermal Depths and other deep-ocean vent sites. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chitinite.de: A plated scavenger with shell memory dense enough to confuse simple blood-sense.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chitinite.so: Found near fungal growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.descr: Eight overlapping plates seal a grazing foot against the rock. Its iron-rich blood can only be drawn with a Living Syringe.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.sourc: Wet coastal stone on Rockpool Shores. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.title: Chiton
A wary herd animal. Infection shows in it as bright veins and a strange calm, and it does not turn aggressive.
Found in infected wilds and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.desiccant.de: A dry husk that drinks moisture from the air and leaves old blood brittle.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.desiccant.so: Found in arid infected pockets and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.fervent_chit: A heat-adapted form of chitinite. Its shell holds a feverish, iron-heavy pressure.
Found in hotter infected regions and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hagfish.desc: A jawless scavenger of old bones. Disturbance draws a brief veil of slime before it withdraws.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hagfish.sour: Carrion fossil sites; accepts rotten flesh offered by hand. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hematic_burr: A tunneling creature that chews in a steady rhythm, following the memory of buried vessels.
Found below infected terrain and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hemojelly.de: A surface-floating blood jelly in temperate and warm seas. Its long submerged tendrils gather small fish beneath the bell.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hemojelly.so: Temperate and warm ocean surfaces, including upper Pelagic waters. Player kills yield Enthralling Filament, and its enzyme is still useful.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hemolymphopo: A small many-legged feeder whose blood analogue stains its path through fungal matter.
Tide-pool margins and shallow bottoms on Rockpool Shore, as well as infected undergrowth. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.ice_fish.des: A pale, broad-headed fish that swims in cold-water schools. The Unstained regard its hemoglobin-free circulation as naturally pure.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.ice_fish.sou: Cold and frozen oceans, Frozen Rivers and submerged Ice Spikes pools. Drops Cleansing Hemolymph; capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.lantern_tick: A patient parasite whose dim glow brightens near warm blood.
Found near infected hosts and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.morphling_po: A wild bud of morphling tissue that hasn't settled into a strain. It carries up to three partner organisms picked up from where it grew.
Found as wild morphling growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.osteophage.d: A skeletal bearded vulture roosting on valley fossils. It climbs above skeleton prey before striking, then grinds loose bones in its hooked beak.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.osteophage.s: Soul Sand Valley bone formations. Offer dropped bones; player kills yield Venous Pinions. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pelagic_herr: A swift silver shoaler whose crimson lateral line follows the turn of its neighbors.
Schools of six to ten in the open Pelagic Ocean. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.phlegethonti: A heat-fed beetle whose fused chemical glands turn its territorial warning into a directed stream of burning ichor.
Found in Phlegethontic Basins and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.prism_cuttle: A cuttle-form specimen whose chromatophores flash with broken blood-memory.
Mostly Twilight gullies, though it also lives in warm water. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pyrosome.des: A hollow living colony; waves of light pass between its small, coordinated bodies.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pyrosome.sou: Open Pelagic water, with occasional Twilight visitors. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.scarlet_serp: A red serpent whose ribs move like a suture being pulled through living cloth.
Found in infected wilds and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.siphonophore: A Ductilis colonial swimmer whose hanging tentacles zap small fish in the deeper Pelagic water column.
Twilight waters and adjacent Pelagic layers. Player kills yield ordinary Ganglion Clusters, not the unique Naeglerophaeon organ.
A chattering colony of tooth-bodied pests whose bites turn bone and blood into shared appetite.
Found near Devil's Tooth growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.vampire_squi: Eight curling arms bear a crimson web lined with pale barbs. When threatened, the web folds around the mantle as the squid retreats.
Open water in Carrion and Hydrothermal Depths. Drops Barbed Splinters; capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.venom_rib_ce: A long predator whose ribbed venom glands flex as each segment moves.
Found in infected ground cover and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.venous_strid: A tall strider that walks over soft red ground as if reading veins beneath it.
Found in infected wetlands and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.verdigris_mo: A powder-winged moth whose green oxidation dust settles over blood-wet surfaces.
Found near infected growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
