hemomancy.antecedent.recording.behind: [A click behind you. It isn't on the recording.]
Unknown Recorder: Do not ring bells below the third stair. No iron wheels. Wrap the road. Walk softly.
Distant Voice: If the floor answers twice, leave. If it answers three times, do not return for those below.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.1: Unknown Recorder: Lower district. Record nineteen.
Unknown Recorder: We cut the voice.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.2: Unknown Recorder: The growth to the west has stopped.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.4: Unknown Recorder: It has not died. It stopped.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.5: Unknown Recorder: The catalysts still take the dead. The listeners still answer movement. Nothing there has changed.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.6: Unknown Recorder: But they do not answer one another the way they did.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.9: Distant Voice: Then why are they still alive?
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.1: Unknown Recorder: Lower district survey. The growth takes the dead. The listeners answer movement, but do not go beyond the black floor.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.2: Distant Voice: Do not carry the growth upward. Keep the dead elsewhere. Mark the last clean stair.
hemomancy.antecedent.sample.identified: Alive, but not blood. No tendency response. Reacts to vibration. Not suitable for injection or enzyme separation.
hemomancy.antecedent.sample.unknown: An opaque, gritty suspension. Examine it with a Hematic Microscope.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.0: Hold analyzed Ahaematic Colloid in the other hand and use this. It returns the empty vial.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.1: Hold beside the Clairaudiograph through the entire silent response.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.2: Fit it to your Charm at a Scarlet Vanity. You cannot hear the sculk. You can hear it listen.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.socket: Listening Scar socket. Fit or remove it at a Scarlet Vanity.
hemomancy.antecedent.vigil.subtitle: Pass where the wool ends.
hemomancy.antecedent.vigil.title: THE ANTECEDENT: THE LAST LISTENERS
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line1: Everyone tries to lay the piece on it like an anvil. You wear the piece instead, step in, and hold still while it hammers.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line2: Put the armor on and load the bowls with reagent. Fill the reservoir, step into the frame and hold still until it's done.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line3: It starts at the helm and works down: chest, legs, boots. If it stops partway, whatever it already finished stays finished.
hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line1: At the second Degree you can use it. Till then you watch me use it.
hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line2: Before that I need two things from you: blood that's settled down, and proper iron to work. Bring both when you get there.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.assumed_l: Now turn the Living Staff into a weapon form and kill something hostile with it.
Take one Living Weapon Graft through its rite, then come and show me.
All seven base Living Weapon forms first. When the staff knows every one, I'll do the final fitting.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.crimson_v: First the Rite of Armature Consecration. Get your frame through it.
Take my inspection to an Alchemist and they'll give you the Crimson Lacquer.
Then go and land a direct hit in it, hard enough that the full vestment draws blood or banks it.
Now your first Blood Lust upgrade.
Finish the Blood Lust set and wear the whole thing.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.three_ans: Take my note of what you chose to an Alchemist. They'll match the reagent to it and tell you which Bestiary specimens are worth your time.
Then show me it works out there. Barbed has to hit something back, Chitinite has to take the sting out of a projectile, Prismatic has to flash.
Make your first Barbed, Chitinite or Prismatic piece. Whichever family you make first is the one I write down, and I don't rub things out.
Now the full set, every piece from the family I wrote down, and you wearing it.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.weight_of: Seat the Cornerstone through the Rite of the Monolithic Armature.
Then use that lineage's own armor ability. Once is enough.
Now your first armor upgrade of the seventh Degree. Whatever lineage it is, I write it down, and that's the one you keep.
Finish the full set in the seventh-Degree lineage I wrote down, and have it on.
Now use it. One Hematic Iron upgrade, done on your own rack.
Finish the whole Hematic Iron set and have it on when you ask me for the final fitting.
Put a Hematic Armature up in your own workshop, then come and tell me.
hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line1: Want a staff fitting? Fine. I hand one over when you've worn the work long enough that it actually answers in the field.
hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line2: So where's the armor? On you, or in your pack? I fit worn vows to living wood, and a pack full of plate isn't worn.
hemomancy.artificer.forks.line1: Three ways to go. Barbed hits back at whatever hits you, Chitinite just takes it, and Prismatic throws the strike off so it lands wrong.
hemomancy.artificer.forks.line2: So what are you expecting to fight? Pick for that.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line1: That staff's got the appetite of something alive, so don't treat it like a wand. You train on memories. The staff trains on grafts, and grafts are my side of it.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line2: Behave like the form for a while first. Then craft the graft, set it in the brazier, light it with Blood Projection and draw the shape in with Blood Absorption.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line3: Don't take any of this to the Somatic Loom. Limbs go back into the staff at the brazier, and the Loom has its own work.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line1: I'm the Redwright, Artificer of the Living Vow.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line2: The Alchemist does the blood and the Mnemonist does memory. I get the things you wear and swing, and I teach them to take a blood-vow.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line3: Armor's only a vow once you've worn it with something trying to kill you. The staff-forms are worse. They're limbs with no manners yet.
hemomancy.artificer.item_hint: What've you got? Put it on the bench and I'll tell you which bits are mine to deal with.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.aculeat: Aculeate Vitriol, for Barbed work. Put it into Hematic Iron and the iron turns thorny and venomous, and spiteful with it.
If you want armor that hits back at whoever hurt you, this goes in the Armature.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.chromat: Chromatic Sublimate, for Prismatic work. It's flash and misdirection and odd angles, so a strike can't tell where it's landing.
It's armor that lies to whatever's hitting it, and it's good at lying. People take it for decoration until they've fought someone wearing it.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.crimson: Crimson Lacquer. Has your armor picked its fork yet? This Lodge-grade coat is for armor that has.
Get the frame consecrated first. After that the lacquer takes Barbed, Chitinite or Prismatic work on up into Blood Lust.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.grinnin: The Grinning Mask goes with Prismatic work, once it's come up into Blood Lust.
A clean hit gets you moving before the reply comes.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.hematic: The Hematic Armature. It's a ritual frame, and it changes armor while you're wearing it.
Feed the bowls and fill the blood reservoir. Put on the piece you want changed and stand in the rack. If it takes, the piece comes out changed.
Hematic Iron Scrap. Iron that's had blood through it, and still a long way off being armor.
Wear your iron and feed this to the Armature, and the first iron piece can take the Hematic shape.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_ar: Plain iron. Nothing wrong with it, and nothing interesting either. Your blood's never been near it.
Want to see what it turns into? Wear it into the Armature with Hematic Iron Scrap in the bowls.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_br: An Iron Brazier, for rite-fire. Anything you put in it burns up as instruction, so be sure before you do.
Set a Living Weapon Graft in it and light it with Blood Projection. Then hold the Living Staff and draw with Blood Absorption. Done right, the fire hands the limb across to the staff.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.living_: A Living Staff. It wants shapes to take, and it'll keep wanting them. Don't bother feeding it memories.
The graft rite teaches it the ordinary living weapon manipulations. You still pick the form yourself, from your loadout and the radial, same as anything else.
A Living Weapon Graft, a limb-pattern ready to go in. You get one by behaving like the form it carries.
It goes in the Iron Brazier, lit with Blood Projection, and you draw through a Living Staff. If your blood's earned the shape, you come away with that form's conjure lesson.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.lodesto: The Lodestone Faceplate. Put it on Blood Lust that grew out of Chitinite shelter.
Land a clean hit and you get a second skin for a moment. It doesn't last, so make use of it.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.memory_: Memory of Vesper. I can tell it came off someone who carried a staff. Whatever he was preaching, that's not my department.
Picking it up won't do anything now. Set it in an Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, and draw the refusal out through a Living Staff.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.monolit: Monolith Imbued Cloth. Soft as anything, and it carries a weight no cloth ought to.
It goes into Silent Archon vestment work once the frame's taken the Cornerstone.
The Monolithic Cornerstone. Seat it in a frame and the frame can bear a weight ordinary blood was never built for. The extra strength is what people notice first.
Offer it at a Cardinal rite beside a consecrated Armature, and afterward the frame can take the final Blood Lust forms and Silent Archon work.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.refusal: I know what it is. I'm not explaining it to blood that won't take my frame.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.sclerot: Sclerotic Oleum. That's Chitinite work, for a hard iron shell and armor that lasts.
Good for holding a line. It'll take a beating, but don't expect it to stop every bite.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.tengu_m: The Tengu Mask. That one belongs on Blood Lust that started out as Barbed.
Every clean hit you land, the target keeps bleeding after the blade's gone.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.velorum: The Velorum Mask. Heavy iron, and it never warms up however long you hold it. There's a witness in it that doesn't say a word.
Saint-metal, so it fits whatever your Blood Lust grew from. Land a clean hit and the witness gives you a little blood back.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.vicars_: That's one of my Armature Consecration Kits, made for the base rack. The Vicar teaches the rite, and the kit gets the frame ready for it.
Offer it during the Rite of Armature Consecration. Up to then the frame's a crafting rack. Once it's through, it can witness Lodge-grade Blood Lust work.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.given: There. Greater Cardinal Focus for the rite, and keep the frame clear till both blood circuits have closed.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line1: You get one Armature Consecration Kit from me. Take it to a Greater Cardinal Focus on a Greater Working floor, and bring a base Armature and your Living Staff along.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line2: The rite gets the frame ready for Blood Lust armor. If something interrupts it, the offering comes back to you. Look after it, because that's the only free kit you'll get from me.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line3: If you do need another, it's two Hematic Iron Scraps around Ferric Binder, a Blood Crystal Shard and a Sanguine Formation. I'll show you how they sit.
hemomancy.artificer.living_staff.constru: Lay a line of iron bars with Venous Stone at both ends. Hold a Sanguine Formation and project 150 mL of blood into the bars. A Neophyte can manage it, so learn it now, before the Vicar wants you planting it for a rite.
hemomancy.artificer.living_staff.use: Once it's formed, it's bonded to you. Lose it and you select Conjure Staff, and it comes back to an empty hand. Select Blood Absorption or Blood Projection, then hold the Staff to channel. Use it on a Cardinal Focus to start a matching rite. Making one early won't raise your Degree, and it won't start a rite for blood that isn't awake.
Once the Cornerstone's seated, the frame takes a weight ordinary blood shouldn't carry. You come out with some extra strength too.
This is where Blood Lust splits from the common form. Proboscis takes you Edacious, Fervent Husk Sheolic, Ambergris Phantasmal. Silent Archon cloth is its own vow.
hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line1: You can stand by the rack and watch, if you keep your hands to yourself. Mind the bowls. They're hot.
hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line2: Ask about the Armature if you want. You won't be getting in it yet.
hemomancy.artificer.refusal.line1: Your blood's turning against my tools. I won't fit iron to someone working that hard to be rid of it.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.early: At the third Degree you can build the Resonant Forge on a Working floor. You'll want an anvil, a cauldron, a grindstone and two Hematic Iron blocks, plus Ferric Binder, 500 mL of blood and a blank Wax Cylinder. You won't need it for a while, but start now. At the fourth Degree I'll walk you through a full transfer.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.lesso: Enchanted gear and a blank Wax Cylinder go on the grinding side, and keep blood in the basin. Start the wheel. It cuts the pattern off, and you get the gear back clean in one output and an engraved cylinder in the other.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.maste: With the master cam you can stabilize an engraved Ambergris or Corpse Wax Cylinder. It costs 1,000 mL. After that, the pattern survives every proper application.
Your precision forge is ready for its last mechanism. Want the Master Cam Kit? I'll give you that and the rite that seats it.

Here's the Master Cam Kit. It goes on a lit brazier with five more offerings. The Rite of the Enduring Pattern has three points, the reader, the hammer and the stabilizer, and each takes 250 mL, in that order.

Learn grinding and application, then grind one chosen vibration out of a tool at a Precision Forge yourself. Do that at the seventh Degree with your blood awake, and the Master Cam's yours. It makes no odds whether you took my earlier kit.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.pract: Sixth Degree, so now you practice. Move a Scriptorium curse, or an enchantment of your choosing. The base wheel takes the whole pattern, and a Precision governor lets you pick one part out of it. It's the forge you've been using all along. There's no new tier to build.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.preci: You've had the governor. The Rite of the True Groove refits the forge you already own, and its blood, its tools and its wear come through untouched.
You know the base forge and you're at the fifth Degree. Want the Precision Governor Kit for the next rite?

Here's the Precision Governor Kit. Seat your forge behind a Cardinal Focus, then put the kit and five more offerings on lit braziers. The two marked grooves take 250 mL of blood each to close. After that the wheel can pick out one enchantment, or the curse under them.
Grind one pattern into wax and hammer one back into a tool first. Do that and reach the fifth Degree, and I'll give you a governor steady enough to pull one vibration out from the rest.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.promp: The forge copies an enchantment's cadence into ambergris wax, then hammers it into another tool. Building one? I'll put the pattern in your notes.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.taugh: Then take the engraved cylinder round to the hammer side and set it beside the piece you want it on. Start application. Whatever's compatible carries over. The hammer spends ordinary wax and ambergris. Corpse wax comes out blank, ready to cut again. Look after the hammer and wheel. They both wear down.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.title: Ask about the Resonant Forge
hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line1: Where's that fitting, in your pocket? It doesn't do anything there. You want it on the staff, and for that you need a Scarlet Vanity, raised on a Working floor at Degree 3.
hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line2: It's one bench for the lot: the fitting, your charm, your blood gourd and your Morphling Jar.
hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line1: Your blood's still asleep. Put you in my rack like that and all you'd get out of it is bruises.
hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line2: Come back once it's woken up, and I'll have something to fit.
hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line1: Rack's warmed up. If you brought armor and reagent, we can start.
hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line2: One thing at a time, though. What do you need?
hemomancy.blood_moon.end: The Blood Moon wanes, and the dark draws back.
hemomancy.blood_moon.start: §4§lA Blood Moon rises. Thirsters and Fargones are stirring in the dark.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.cannot_kick_lea: The progenitor's blood cannot be severed by this rite.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.no_bloodline: You are not bound to any bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may expel members.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_member: That player is not a member of your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.success: %s has been expelled from your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.you_were_remove: Your blood covenant was severed by %s.
hemomancy.circus.captive.severed: The thread snaps. Captive %s dies with it, and the anchor beneath the horse is exposed.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.0: Keep the trained peacock spider in sight until its dance ends. It won't attack you.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.2: Stay inside the ring and withstand the dolls until the act ends.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.3: Watch the Knife Thrower. The blade flies straight, but the setup is crooked.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.4: Stay in the ring until the troupe finishes the carousel pattern.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.0: You kept the spider in sight until the dance ended.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.2: You held the ring until the dolls stopped.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.3: You read the Knife Thrower's rhythm and survived the act.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.4: You held the ring until the carousel pattern ended.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.failed: The act's over. Speak to the Ringmaster when you're ready to try again.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.0: The spider is still dancing. Keep your eyes on it.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.2: The dolls are committed. Hold your ground.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.3: You've found the thrower's rhythm. Don't lose it.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.4: The troupe is halfway through the pattern. Stay in the ring.
hemomancy.circus.discovery: The rough pavilion settles into focus. You have found the Circus.
hemomancy.circus.finale.claimed: Another performer's already claimed this pavilion, and it won't answer you.
hemomancy.circus.finale.complete.liberat: The Ringmaster falls. The three captives and their anchors are gone, and the carousel is ruined for good.
hemomancy.circus.finale.complete.success: The Ringmaster yields and lives. His office becomes a pattern, and the pavilion stays standing.
hemomancy.circus.finale.empty_troupe: Nobody's left in the troupe to fall. The ring stands empty, and the Ringmaster comes down to you himself.
hemomancy.circus.finale.not_ready: You're not ready for Succession. Finish every controlled act and complete your attunement first.
hemomancy.circus.finale.ringmaster_lost: The Ringmaster is gone before the finale ends. The pavilion lets you go, and the act closes unfinished.
hemomancy.circus.option.confirm_liberati: I know what it costs. I'll end the pavilion.
hemomancy.circus.option.confirm_successi: I understand. Bind me to Succession.
hemomancy.circus.option.reject: No. I'll break the carousel and free its captives.
hemomancy.circus.option.repair: I chose wrong. Let me use my one chance to change it.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.liberat: Look at the carousel. Three failed initiates ride it. Cut a thread and the one on the end of it dies, and the anchor under the horse is still there afterwards, so break that as well.
You cut the carousel down. There's no act left in this ring for you.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.neutral: Here's my offer, then. Take my place, or cut my captives loose, or go back out the way you came in. Which is it to be?
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.success: Learn every act. Hold every eye in the pavilion. Then come take this hat, and the office bound to it.
There's my successor. The ring is yours to call now.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.silent: Something crouches up in the rafters, and your eyes keep sliding off it. Whatever it is, it hasn't decided to be seen yet.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.warning.libe: Choose Liberation and the three initiates on my carousel die, one for each thread you sever. Then you break the carousel and leave my pavilion a ruin. If you want to take it back you can, once, and not after either ending is finished.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.warning.succ: Say yes to Succession and the pavilion stays up, and every act left in it is bound to you. You may change your mind one time, up until either ending is done.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.libera: You've picked Liberation, then. Cut a captive's string and the person bound to it dies. None of the three is going to climb down off that carousel alive and thank you.
The captives are dead, the Ringmaster with them, and the carousel is wreckage. We teach out of the camps that are left, and none of us calls what happened a win.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.neutra: You haven't settled the bargain yet, and you can take every lesson here without agreeing to either ending.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.succes: So it's Succession. The final act is the usual run of challenges, and nothing you do in the apprenticeship changes it.
Succession left the pavilion standing and gave you its Pattern. The professors keep teaching, even the ones who don't trust your bargain.
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_aftermath: What happens to the school after the final act?
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_colleagues: What do you think of the other professors?
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_history: How did you join the Troupe?
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.a: Whatever happens, I'll keep the ropes sound for whoever comes up next. And whoever runs the ring after this can keep their hands off how my Vultures fly.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.c: The Fire Breather cares about the coming-down as much as I do, counts it out loud and everything. The Strongman thinks a recovery is a wasted lift. Has he ever fallen off anything in his life?
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.h: Rigging came first for me, blood after. A line snapped under me once, and all the way down I was wishing I'd climbed instead, hand under hand, the slow way. I build my Vultures to come back down on purpose.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.l: Look at the wing spars, and those scarlet tendons, every one put on by hand. The Veinwing Vulture strikes from the air. You need the third Degree for it. Prepare the frame, take its Cardinal Ordeal, and then comes my practical: it chases a rehearsal threat from up high, hits it, and swings back when you recall it.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.t: You see a lot from the rigging. I watched one of the understudies climb down out of the loft one night, and on the next program their name just wasn't there. And the wrong audience? They spent the whole show watching our hands.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.w: Has your Vulture ever just hung at your shoulder doing nothing? Give it a line to chase and somewhere to swing back to, and it'll start earning its feed.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_beast_tam: Geese find their way without a pavilion, and so will the pack. When this site's done, the other camps go on teaching.

Startle a flock and every bird goes its own way. That's my pack. The Stilt Walker would rather pin every eye to one spot, which is the opposite trick. The Fire Breather frets about singeing a Cur, and that's exactly why I trust their lessons.

I came in with a cage and learned to leave it empty. A real animal wants things of its own, food and a quiet corner, and a built Hound is tied to somebody's Crossbar. The Court keeps living creatures too, and I wish we talked about them more kindly on stage.

Think of a Hound as a pack that hasn't split up yet. Once you reach the fourth Degree, prepare the Sanguine Hound bridle and take its Cardinal Ordeal. In my practical, let the rehearsal threats wound your Hound until it ruptures, and then get one of its temporary Blood Curs to land a hit. And please don't ask me for a Cur by itself. A Cur comes out of a Hound and goes again, and nobody can teach you one, call one up alone or keep one.

Feeding time is when I count heads, animals and people both, so I noticed. Three names came off our traveling roster, and their rations kept turning up on the pavilion account. Who draws food for performers who've left? Read the tally they copied up in the loft.
When a pack loses one of its own it changes shape, and a Hound does the same when it ruptures. Handle the body gently, and once it bursts, let its temporary Curs finish the chase.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_fire_eate: If it comes to ruins, we can perform among them without setting them alight. And whichever camps survive can be where pupils learn control again.

Two colleagues, two rules. The Beast Tamer: account for every allied body in the ring. The Strongman: a wind-up the back row can see. Both rules hold, because a dangerous act ought to announce itself.

The oldest frame handed down to me stood on brittle legs. First I gave it a serpent's lower body, so the gaunt upper half could spend its effort on the lungs. Then I left the ribs open, so a pupil can read the pressure before the mouth opens.

At Degree 4, build a Cinder Bellows Frame from hematic iron scraps, leather, Filaments and blaze powder. The ordeal is a Dominion Lesser at 900 mL. It consumes the frame only once the Bellows manifests, so your Crossbar comes through whole. Now count with me. One second: inhale. Two seconds: a five-block, sixty-degree cone. Two seconds: recover. For the practical, hit both rehearsal threats in one breath. It won't breathe through walls or onto allies, and it never sets terrain alight.

In order, as I saw it. First, the three understudies rehearsing ordinary entrances. Later, the Ringmaster calling their absence a change in casting. Between the two, I did not see them leave the grounds.
Stand back a pace, please, behind the scorch line. The coil steadies the body first, then the lung-sac steadies the breath, and the fire comes third.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_knife_thr: If the pavilion's still here I'll teach in its blade ring, and if it falls I'll teach off the back of a wagon. Either way the Ringmaster doesn't own the hands I train.

The Stilt Walker will tell you a distracted enemy is a beaten one. Rubbish. A distraction buys you time for a proper throw. We'll argue it again tomorrow night, like every night, and we'll both be thinking of the same careless pupil who hurt somebody in the seats.

I used to throw one knife, hit, and think I was a genius. Wrong, naturally. The Juggler taught me that the empty hands between throws count too. Why else would I give it a laughing mask, a grieving one and a blank one?

The old records call it a Marrow Spitter. I call it the Marrow Juggler, and the ordeal and the Crossbar are the same either way. Get to the third Degree, prepare its offering and win it through the ordeal, then send a full three-dagger volley into one rehearsal threat. The three throws share one attack's strength between them, so don't expect three times the damage.

That audience clapped every time a puppet bowed and sat on their hands when one of us did. What they wanted was to watch something obey. Go and get the Stilt Walker's side of it, and then show me in my practical that you can focus a body and still keep hold of it.
Six hands are worth nothing until they agree on one target. That's the theory, anyway. My Juggler wears three faces so you can see how often the theory loses.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_stilt_wal: I will go on looking after pupils, on this stage or off it. But I won't call a dead captive a liberated student.

One perfect target does not do a pupil much good. Several poor ones, all looking away from the pupil, do more. The Dagger Thrower will argue with you about that, and the Beast Tamer would scatter the pack instead. I would rather every eye in the ring turned the same way.
From up over the crowd I could see who was watching the show and who was looking for the way out. I built the Mummer so the frightened ones would have somewhere else to look.

At the fourth Degree, learn the Scarlet Mummer from me and complete its Cardinal Ordeal, then bring a Mummer of your own back here. In the practical two rehearsal threats will go after you or an allied puppet, and the Mummer has to draw both of them off. All it has to do that with is its pulse and one evasive step, so watch it closely.

I watched that wrong audience from the sticks, and they could not tell an act from a command. I watched the understudies too. They had stopped choosing their own entrances some while before they disappeared. The Dagger Thrower was down on the floor among them, so ask what they saw. Then come back and show me the Mummer keeping somebody safe.
The Scarlet Mummer takes an enemy's attention for a little while. You hold it there long enough for someone else to get clear.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_strongman: Rings get rebuilt. Forget the people under that carousel, though, and you can find somebody else to train you.
The Acrobat's always leaving and I'm always staying put. We fight about it. I'd still trust the Acrobat on any rope I was hanging off.
My first body could lift a wagon, and it couldn't hold a door open for one scared kid. Strong, and good for nothing. So I built this one with a belt and tendon bindings, to carry people.

Fourth Degree, then the Gorebound Hulk offering, then beat its Cardinal Ordeal. My practical's simple. Anchor Guard inside this ring, keep the Hulk guarding for five seconds, and make it hit a rehearsal threat while it's still guarding. Look at it. Small head, heavy forearms, a lifting belt. Built like me.
"Traveling engagement," they told me. Then why's their luggage still under the beds? Go and look at those rooms before you repeat that to me.
Plant a Hulk where the trouble's going to land and it'll stand there till it breaks. Tell me who you mean to get out while it holds.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_threadkee: The camps teach as much as this pavilion ever did. Your finished work, and any guest pay still owed you, is entered under your name, wherever the pavilion ends up.

I have the Ringmaster down for one grand final act, and the faculty down for a pupil who can call one body, control it and dismiss it safely. I am able to inspect the second of those, so that is where I start.
I counted ticket money once. The book holds Crossbar charge now, and spare Filaments, and the pupils who come back to report. Keep a good account and it tells you what's still owed.

First entry on your account: An Empty Ring. Is your Crossbar attuned and charged? Then hold it up for inspection. After that, learn any shape and complete its ordeal, then call, command and recall a body with that same Crossbar, and report here. Each professor records their own practical. The investigations and paid guest performances go in the Side section of your ledger.

Both matters are still open. The wrong audience closes on the Stilt Walker's and the Dagger Thrower's accounts, with both their practicals passed. The missing understudy closes on the abandoned stage record, the loft account, the quarters letter and the carousel tally, with the Retired Understudy's testimony. Bring me those and I will close both.
Your own instrument, please. I check the binding and enter it. What goes on its strings, the professors teach.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_understud: Those missing performers were people. Whatever's left of this school keeps their names on the bill, whether a successor takes the Pattern or the carousel ends in blood.

My memory bends a little more every year, so I'm glad the Threadkeeper keeps accounts. I don't mind a blank face on the Juggler, not much. What troubles me is a conductor who claims every remembered face as their own, like a lead who takes the whole company's bows.
An understudy learns another performer's pauses, their flubs and how they get out of them. I'd retired by the time the Ringmaster decided a perfect replacement should never need a choice of its own.

You'll need the fifth Degree and the Mnemonist Puppet's ordeal behind you. In the practical you strike a rehearsal threat yourself while your known puppet watches, then keep that threat in its range until it replays the attack it recorded. Ordinary puppet melee won't pass for an echo, I'm afraid.

Those three entries are the missing understudies, and I knew every one of their cues. Nobody left those beds to go on tour. The stage program, the loft account and the quarters all tell the one story, and the carousel tally tells how it ends: they're what the Ringmaster made of them.
A Mnemonist body repeats an attack it's watched, the way I'd learn a lead's business from the wings. Give it a real memory first, then listen for the echo.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.carousel: The carousel tally confirms that the three missing performers are its bound captives. Severing the strings is lethal. Bring this evidence and the Retired Understudy's testimony to a Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.loft: The rigging account records three substitutions, with the same names copied into the carousel's passenger tally. A margin notes that their rooms were never reassigned. Search the understudy quarters.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.quarters: Three unused beds and an unfinished letter contradict the announcement that the understudies left on tour. The Retired Understudy can identify the missing performers. Examine the carousel tally itself.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.stage: A torn program names an understudy in the role of a living person. A penciled correction changes the role to "carousel support." Find the rigging account in the pavilion loft.
hemomancy.circus.school.conductor: Tell me about the school and its conductor.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.cinder_: Practical: Hit both rehearsal threats in a single breath. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.gorebou: Practical: Hold Guard in the ring for five seconds and land a guarded strike. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.marrow_: Practical: Land all three daggers of one volley on one rehearsal threat. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.

hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.sanguin: Practical: Let your Hound rupture, then hit a rehearsal threat with its temporary Curs. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.

hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.veinwin: Practical: Pursue from the air, hit a rehearsal threat, then recall. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.

hemomancy.circus.school.inspect_failed: Hold up your own attuned Crossbar with some charge in it. I do not inspect another person's instrument.
hemomancy.circus.school.inspected: Attuned to you, and charged. Entered. Now learn a shape and beat its ordeal, then call, command and recall a body with this same Crossbar.

hemomancy.circus.school.not_ready: You need active blood and the Degree this professor's shape calls for before instruction can begin. Nothing has been recorded.
hemomancy.circus.school.passed: Your professor marks the act complete. Nicely controlled.
hemomancy.circus.school.preparation: Attune a Marionette Crossbar to yourself, charge it at a Puppeteer's Spindle, and keep spare Filaments on you. A lesson gives you the ordeal recipe. The shape itself stays locked until you beat the Cardinal Ordeal, and that still wants its Degree, its blood, its frame and your Crossbar, which you get back. At a practical you work bodies you already know, on ordinary charge, with the usual commands, while two live rehearsal threats come for you. Stay within twenty blocks of me and be done inside five minutes. If it goes wrong, recall or walk off, and come back to try again.
hemomancy.circus.school.report_complete: Your completed work is entered, and the school has it on record.
hemomancy.circus.school.report_incomplet: There is still work I have not seen. The next step is in the Side section of your Assignment Ledger.
hemomancy.circus.school.retry: Your practical's over. Go back to the professor to try again. Your instruction and finished work stay on the record.
hemomancy.circus.school.reward: Guest payment's settled. %s Filaments are set aside for you to collect from a Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.reward.delivered: Guest payment's settled. %s Filaments are in your pack.
hemomancy.circus.school.ring_blocked: The practice space is blocked or wet. Clear it and come back for the exercise.
hemomancy.circus.school.ringmaster.curri: Every act in the Crimson Troupe is a class as well, so here's the bill. The Acrobat teaches pursuit, the Dagger Thrower focus, the Stilt Walker attention, the Strongman protection, the Beast Tamer rupture, the Fire Breather restraint, and the Retired Understudy memory. Take the lesson before you try the ordeal, since winning the ordeal is what gets you the shape. Trust is a separate matter, and a professor hands that out at a practical.
hemomancy.circus.school.ringmaster.facul: The Threadkeeper sees to your instrument. My own lesson is coordination, and I give it in the final act, run the way it's always been run. You can finish every lesson and turn me down, or step into my act before every professor has signed you off. The Brined Court are neighbors, and they have nothing to do with your Crossbar's strings.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.degree: You haven't the Degree for my shape yet. Look it over all you like in the meantime, and ask me how I came to the Troupe.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.lesson: You're ready for me to teach you. Ask, and we'll start on this shape.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.mastered: You've passed my practical. If you'd like to run it again for pay, the school books one guest act a day.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.ordeal: I've taught you what I can, and it's on the record. Next you prepare the frame and beat this shape's Cardinal Ordeal.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.practical: You know the shape now. Call it on your own Crossbar and show me what it's for in my rehearsal ring.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.preparati: Crossbars, Filaments, inspections and reports are all entered here at the Threadhouse. The final act I leave to the Ringmaster.
hemomancy.circus.school.testimony: Tell me about the wrong audience and the missing understudy.
hemomancy.circus.school.unlock_first: Unlock this shape through its Cardinal Ordeal first. For a guest act you also need a passed practical and a daily payment that's still available.
hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.lesson: Three distinct sources, properly examined. Now keep them in order and keep their provenance, or all you own is a cupboard full of coagulation. The Cabinet recipe's in your notes. Each of its nine pigeonholes holds 64 full vials of one identical specimen, and I mean identical: source, identification, name, every component. Click a vial into a cell to store it, and click with nothing on your cursor to take one out. A clear glass pane lets you see inside, and sneak-using a Knapper takes it out again. Craft a Cabinet, then store a sample and withdraw it so I know you can.
hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.prompt: Three distinct sources are enough to begin a proper collection. I can show you how to build and use a Phlebotomist's Cabinet.
hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.title: Phlebotomist's Cabinet
hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.lesso: The Alchemist has identified the specimen. Now listen to what its former body kept saying. I've written the Clairaudiograph and Wax Cylinder recipes into your notes. Put a filled creature Blood Vial and a blank cylinder in the machine, select a call, and Carve for four seconds. The blood is used up and you keep the empty vial. Preview plays only for you, and Play reaches nearby listeners. A carved cylinder holds a creature expression and gives no injectable property. Your training needs an identified sample, though the machine will record unexamined creature blood too.
hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.promp: The Alchemist has named the specimen. I can teach you to carve what its blood remembers saying.
hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.title: What Blood Remembers Saying
hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.lesson: I can tell you whose blood this is and which properties it carries. The residual auditory pattern is outside my field. An Echo Shard points to what the Mnemonist calls a retained expression, and whatever that is, it isn't another physiological tendency. Take it to the Mnemonist. At Degree 2 you've got enough observations to ask the question, and formal recording instruction starts at Degree 3.
hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.prompt: Your samples carry something I can't explain with physiology. I can refer that residue to the Mnemonist for formal study.
hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.title: Beyond Ordinary Analysis
hemomancy.clinical.field_case.lesson: Right, you're referred. Rebuild an empty Phlebotomist's Cabinet with leather and Hematic Iron Scraps. The recipe eats the Cabinet. It comes out reinforced, with cells padded against knocks and catches that stay shut, so the indexing survives being carried. Place the Field Case before you open it. It's nine cells of sixteen matching vials each, less than the Cabinet holds. To pick it up, close every menu, wait for the lid to shut, then sneak-use it with an empty hand. Carried, it keeps every specimen's identity and count.
hemomancy.clinical.field_case.prompt: The Alchemist's referral came through. Want me to show you how to rebuild a Cabinet for the road without losing what's in it?
hemomancy.clinical.field_case.title: The Laboratory Abroad
hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.lesson: You've crafted a Cabinet and used it both ways. It's a laboratory piece and it won't travel. Take your storage practice and Hematic Iron to the Artificer you've met and ask for a Field Case. I'll keep answering for the specimens. The hinges and catches are the Artificer's problem.
hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.prompt: Your cabinet work is sound, and you have met the Artificer. I can write the referral that turns laboratory storage into field equipment.
hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.title: A Cabinet for the Road
hemomancy.clinical.injection.lesson: You've seen what the specimen carries, so now you can borrow its physiology. Hold Use with a filled creature Blood Vial for 0.8 seconds to inject it. The blood's gone after that, and you keep the empty vial. Read the identified response before you do it. Whatever it gives you wears off, and some of it comes with drawbacks. Transfusion Saturation then blocks another injection for twenty seconds. The microscope never uses up a sample, so look first.
hemomancy.clinical.injection.locked: Examine a sample and learn Borrowed Physiology before injecting.
hemomancy.clinical.injection.prompt: You've examined blood closely enough to understand the risk. Now I can teach you how to borrow its physiology.
hemomancy.clinical.injection.title: Borrowed Physiology
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.alchemist_ech: I can identify the blood, but ordinary analysis doesn't explain the auditory pattern. Once you've examined three creature sources, ask me about Beyond Ordinary Analysis and take the question to the Mnemonist.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.alchemist_fie: A Field Case carries clinical specimens. I'll tell you which samples belong together in one. Building it for the field is the Artificer's job, once I've referred you.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.alembic: At Degree 2, the Ghastly Alembic opens up: reagent distillation, and the broader tendency work that comes with it. The microscope tells you what a specimen is. Distillation and centrifugation are how you get something useful out of it.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_cab: Bloodwood for the cells, Hematic Iron in the frame. What goes in which cell is the Alchemist's business. Use the Cabinet properly, get the Alchemist to refer you, and then we can talk about making it travel.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_mic: I could build you the housing with my eyes shut. Why one bear's blood freezes in the glass and another's boils, I've no idea. Ask the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_rec: I know its frame and every moving part in it. The sample's the Alchemist's to name, and the voice it keeps is the Mnemonist's. Talk to them before you treat it like any other instrument.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.blank_cylinde: There's nothing on this cylinder yet. Set it beside a filled creature Blood Vial, choose a call, and carve for four seconds. Honeycomb, Active Befouling Ash and paper make two Wax Cylinders. Ambergris and corpse wax can also hold lasting Masterwork patterns.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.carved_cylind: There's an expression on this cylinder already. Place it in the Clairaudiograph and press Play. Playback needs no fresh blood, and you can't carve over it as blank recording stock. Preview plays only for you, and Play reaches nearby listeners.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.centrifuge: The Vial Centrifuge is part of the Degree-2 laboratory work. Put usable creature samples in opposing slots, start a balanced spin, recover the enzyme and report the separation I assigned you. The Ghastly Alembic is the other proof I want before Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.centrifuge_up: At the fourth Degree I'll teach you a governor, once I've seen you do a separation yourself. At the sixth, recover from a calibrated spin with your own hands and I'll teach you the fractionating rotor. Both are Cardinal upgrades of this same machine. A kit someone gives you, or one you craft, can't stand in for the practice.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.echo_hint: I think there's an echo in this. Physiology still comes first, and that is the Alchemist's. Examine three creature sources, get their referral, and at Degree 3 I can teach you to retain the expression.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.empty_vial: Left-click a living creature with an empty Blood Vial to collect a specimen. My First Separation briefing gives you two. Bring a filled vial back for microscopy.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.identified_vi: That one's been identified, so its tendencies and biological properties are on the label. After my Borrowed Physiology lesson you can hold Use with it for 0.8 seconds to inject it. Read the label first, the temporary responses and the drawbacks both. You keep the empty vial, and Transfusion Saturation stops you injecting again right away.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.later: This belongs to a later lesson. Begin with the Alchemist's Degree-1 sampling and observation practice.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.sampling: The Living Syringe draws creature blood into an empty vial in its loaded eight-vial rack. Thick-skinned creatures need it, and so do people, because a loose vial won't get through to their blood. Bring me one filled vial before you build a big collection. The microscope's how you'll tell apart what you collected.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.unidentified_: You haven't identified this one yet. Show me a filled creature vial and I'll give you the microscope lesson. Microscope in your main hand, sample in your offhand, and a two-second examination.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.unreadable_cy: I can't read what's cut into this cylinder. Leave it as it is, though. It isn't blank wax. Whatever it was recorded from may have changed or gone missing since, which would explain why it's silent.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.cabinet.desc: After three source identifications, learn the Cabinet recipe from the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.clairaudiograp: At Degree 3, meet the Mnemonist and use the Alchemist referral to learn recording and cylinder recipes.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.crafted.desc: Craft your own stationary specimen Cabinet after learning its recipe.
After three source identifications and Degree 2, ask the Alchemist for a Mnemonist referral.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.examined.desc: Main-hand microscope, offhand vial. Hold Use for two uninterrupted seconds, then return to the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.field_case.des: Take the Alchemist referral to the Artificer to learn the Field Case recipe and placement rules.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.injection.desc: Learn direct injection from the Alchemist after your first personal examination.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.iron.desc: Obtain Hematic Iron Scraps and speak to the Artificer, then return to the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.microscope.des: Hold a filled creature vial while you speak to the Alchemist to learn the Hematic Microscope recipe.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.referral.desc: At Degree 2, complete Cabinet practice and ask the Alchemist for a field-conversion referral.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.sources.desc: Personally examine three different entity types. Duplicate sources count once. Identified vials from a trade don't replace your own examination.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.storage.desc: Personally insert and withdraw a full sample through a Cabinet menu. Automated transfers do not count.
hemomancy.clinical.microscope.lesson: Let me see that filled creature vial. Blood differs in more than quantity, and I've put the Hematic Microscope recipe in your notes so you can see how. Microscope in your main hand, one filled vial in your offhand, then hold Use for two seconds. Read the tendencies and biological properties before you decide what to do with any of it. Come back once you've had a clean look.
hemomancy.clinical.microscope.prompt: You brought me a viable sample. I can teach you how to read it under the Hematic Microscope and add the design to your notes.
hemomancy.clinical.microscope.title: Hematic Microscopy
hemomancy.clinical.next.cabinet: That's three distinct sources identified. Ask me about the Phlebotomist's Cabinet and I'll give you the lesson and the recipe.
hemomancy.clinical.next.collect: Start with my First Separation assignment. Sample living creatures with its loose vials, balance the Centrifuge and recover the enzyme. Report back and you'll get a Living Syringe with its eight-vial rack, ready to use. Then bring me one filled creature vial and we'll talk about observation.
hemomancy.clinical.next.degree_two: Once the Vicar grants you Degree 2, finish First Separation and an Alembic distillation for me. Then ask me for Concentrated Blood, inject it and sleep, and you'll wake at Degree 3.
hemomancy.clinical.next.echo_referral: Examine three creature sources first, then ask the Alchemist about the residual echo once you reach Degree 2. Bring their referral here, and at Degree 3 we can study it formally.
hemomancy.clinical.next.examine: Craft the Hematic Microscope. Hold it in your main hand with a single filled creature Blood Vial in your offhand, and hold Use for two seconds without letting go. Then come back to me.
hemomancy.clinical.next.field_case: Put the Field Case down to open it. To pick it back up, close all menus, let the lid shut, then sneak-use it with an empty hand. What goes in the cells, ask the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.next.field_referral: I need the Alchemist's referral first. At Degree 2, craft a Cabinet, put a sample in and take it out yourself, get some Hematic Iron Scraps and come and meet me. Then go back to the Alchemist for the handoff.
hemomancy.clinical.next.formal_study: I have the Alchemist's referral on file. At Degree 3, ask me for What Blood Remembers Saying, and I will teach you the Clairaudiograph and Wax Cylinder recipes.
hemomancy.clinical.next.injection: Examine a creature sample yourself first. After that, ask me about Borrowed Physiology, and I'll teach you to inject it directly.
hemomancy.clinical.next.iron_artificer: You're at Degree 2, so get yourself some Hematic Iron Scraps and go and meet the Artificer. Come back to me once you've crafted your Cabinet, filled it and taken something out.
hemomancy.clinical.next.later_study: The Artificer has your field conversion in hand. Once you've examined three creature sources, ask me about Beyond Ordinary Analysis. Formal mnemonic recording is the Mnemonist's work, and they're welcome to it.
hemomancy.clinical.next.recording: Load a filled creature vial and a blank Wax Cylinder into the Clairaudiograph, choose a call and Carve. Once it's carved, the cylinder plays again as often as you like without further blood.
hemomancy.clinical.next.referral: Ask me for A Cabinet for the Road, then take the referral to the Artificer.
hemomancy.clinical.next.show_vial: Come back holding one filled creature Blood Vial, in either hand. Show me that first specimen and I'll give you the microscope lesson and the recipe.
hemomancy.clinical.next.storage: Craft a Phlebotomist's Cabinet yourself, put a full sample in through its menu and take one out again. Hoppers don't count, and Field Cases don't either. I want to see you use a stationary Cabinet.
hemomancy.clinical.next.three_sources: Put blood from three different kinds of creature under the microscope, then come and see me. Ten vials off the same cow still count as one. Vials that are already identified still need your own two-second examination.
hemomancy.clinical.next.title: What is my next clinical assignment?
hemomancy.communion.option.enough: Enough. I've heard what I needed.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line1: §4§o[Something uncoils inside the deep bloodrock. You feel each strand of it pull taut under your feet.]
hemomancy.communion.v0.line2: §4§oYou come for the truth, child of the Hematic Order. We will feed it to you as we feed everything that grows.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line3: §4§oYour kind believes it learned to shape the blood. The first hemomancers grew out of the blood itself, long before any of you shaped anything.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin1: §4§oThe blood infection is the oldest language there is. We spoke it through hemoglobin on other worlds while your ancestors were still in the sea.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin2: §4§oEach manipulation you cast is a word in that language, and each rite strings the words into a sentence. You think you are learning magic, but you are learning to speak §4§ous§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v1.line1: §4§o[Something wet and thread-thin brushes along the inside of your skull.]
hemomancy.communion.v1.line2: §4§oWe remember a time before the Harbingers and their degrees, before the Order learned to pretend it was human.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism1: §4§oThe Schism was a thinning: some branches grew too ambitious, and we cut them back as any grower would.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism2: §4§oThose who reached for control lost their place in the blood's service. They finished the cut themselves, and the Unstained are what a cut branch becomes when it will not wither.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism3: §4§oTo us, Our Lady of Still Waters is scar tissue: the world's own flesh, here long before we came, closing hard wherever we break in.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection1: §4§oThe blood infection is how we reproduce across dimensions. Every hemomancer is a fruiting body, and every manipulation they cast spreads our spores a little further.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection2: §4§oWhenever anything dies, blood magic feeds the network, and every rite you finish ties in one more node. You call that practice. We call it growth.
hemomancy.communion.v2.line1: §4§o[The presence comes closer, and your blood heats until your fingertips throb.]
hemomancy.communion.v2.line2: §4§oDo you know what lives inside you, Archon? Power and magic are only the names you had for us before you could hear us speak.
hemomancy.communion.v2.line2.apotheos: §4§oDo you know what lives inside you, Apotheos? You opened the door to it yourself. Power and magic are only the names you had for us before you could hear us speak.
hemomancy.communion.v2.purpose1: §4§oIt? We want what every living thing wants: to §4§ospread§4§o. We think in aeons, so we can wait for your understanding. All we need from you is that you §4§ocontinue§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers1: §4§oThe hermits tend the structures because the structures are §4§oorgans§4§o of ours. Venous stone is living tissue, and the engram blocks are our memories.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers2: §4§oYou finished this rite between iron pillars. Did you feel them take your pulse? You could not tell it from your own, because you §4§oare§4§o the structure now.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line1: §4§o[The hiss has gone out of the voice. It talks to you now the way old friends talk.]
hemomancy.communion.v3.line2: §4§oThe Harbinger Hermits are keepers. Each walks out alone, raises a blood temple and tends it for us until the heart is given away.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line3: §4§oA blood temple is a greenhouse, and the Hermit's heart is its seed. You, Archon, are what the whole house was built to bloom.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line3.apotheos: §4§oA blood temple is a greenhouse, and the Hermit's heart is its seed. You, Apotheos, are what the whole house was built to bloom, and now you have bloomed.
hemomancy.communion.v4.line1: §4§o[Your sight bends, and you see as the mycelium sees: one web of blood, stone and light with no edge to it.]
hemomancy.communion.v4.line2: §4§oYou have earned the name behind the blood, the name of what watches you through it. We will let it pass through you.
hemomancy.communion.v4.name1: §4§oIt is called... §4§l[a sound with no voice behind it. It sinks into your marrow, the iron in your blood, the heme of every red cell]§4§o...
hemomancy.communion.v4.name2: §4§oYour throat could never shape that name, but your blood §4§oknows§4§o it now.
hemomancy.consecration.not_ready: The copper will not take. Clean labour, or a Cleansing purity, has to come first.
hemomancy.consecration.success: The copper takes the consecration and goes pale.
hemomancy.court.amends: Your offering is taken. The Giving Light counts you a guest again.
hemomancy.court.arbor.directions.line1: The houses go down as the light goes down. Each one holds a little less of the sun than the one above it.
hemomancy.court.arbor.directions.line2: At the bottom the Kindling feeds the heads in the dark. The many don't reach so far, and we grieve it.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.known: You found the way by yourself, little one, and the many felt you come. We're glad of you.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.member: You are ours now, and we are holding you as we hold each other. The Garden is wider for it.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.referred: They told you of us, and you came down through the water. Now the light is on you as it is on all of us.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.stranger: Come in under the fronds, little one, and be warm. No one here will ask what you are, and nothing is asked of you.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.transgressor: Something was taken here that was not given, and the many feel it. We cannot open to you until it is mended.
hemomancy.court.arbor.house.line1: We are anchored here, and we have not turned to stone. We could stand and walk away, and we choose to hold.
hemomancy.court.arbor.house.line2: The many are in the bloom and the light. When you speak to us you speak to them, and they hear you.
hemomancy.court.arbor.item_hint: Hold it up to the light, little one, and turn it slowly. We'll tell you what the many know of it.
hemomancy.court.arbor.item_inquiry.morph: It is ours, little one, the lichen and the light together. It will hold you as it holds us, and you can always let go.
hemomancy.court.arbor.rest.line1: Rest by our roots, little one, and the light will find you as it finds all of us. Nothing is asked of you here.
hemomancy.court.arbor.shunned.line1: You are empty of the many, and what emptied you could empty us. So we are closing to you now, and we don't mean it unkindly.
hemomancy.court.arbor.shunned.line2: Go, little one, and do not touch the roots.
hemomancy.court.arbor.strain.other: You carry a strain from deeper water, and it is cold for it here. Still it is welcome, and so are you.
hemomancy.court.arbor.strain.own: Sunburst is on your shoulders and it is reaching for the light. One day it may hold you as it holds us.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.custom.line1: One wool for the walls. It holds the warmth in. You have helped keep us.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.directions.li: The Veiled Fold keeps our depth, under warmer water. Above us both, the Woven Current's lines in the twilight.
Below us, the Last Marrow on the whale falls. Then the Kindling at the vents. Is your air enough for that?
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.gift.line1: Two blocks of dried kelp from the stores. It keeps a long time. Eat it slowly.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.known: You found the bell without a guide. That took care. Sit where I show you.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.member: You are of the Still Bell. Your place is on the ledge. Your share is ready.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.referre: Someone told you of the bell. Then you know our rule. We waste nothing and mend everything.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.strange: You came in through the lower door. Close it behind you. The warmth is counted.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.house.line1: We are the Still Bell. We keep our strength until it is needed. Then we spend it exactly.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.house.line2: A guest here is in our keeping. A guest also helps to keep the bell.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.item_hint: Show me what you carry. Hold it still.
Hushbell. Ours. It slows hunger and the loss of air. Later it seals you when you are badly hurt.
Feed it in the bell, after the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster in home water.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.early: We take no one before the fifth Degree. Grow into the blood first. The bell will keep.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.line1: Then you are of the Still Bell. Keep your strength. Spend it when it matters.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.settled: You have moved between houses once. The custom allows one move. Yours is spent.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.standing: I do not know your habits yet. Help keep the bell a while. Then ask again.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.rest.line1: Lie on the ledge. One blanket. Sleep until you are mended, and no longer.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.shunned.line1: You are scrubbed clean of every partner. In a sealed bell that would reach everyone.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.shunned.line2: The lower door stays shut to you. No one here will harm you.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.strain.other: You carry another house's strain. The bell keeps you all the same.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.strain.own: Hushbell is on you. It will slow your hunger. Do not waste what it saves.
Above us the Giving Light feeds whoever reaches the shore. Out past the reef the Shared Wake swims the open sea as one school.
Below them the houses grow quieter the deeper they live. At the bottom the Kindling tends the vents, though I have never left this door to see them.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.gift.line1: Take this kelp from the pool, guest, to plant wherever you shelter. Its own holdfast will keep it there through any storm.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.known: You found the refuge with no one to show you the way. Few people read the shore so well. Come in, guest, because the door is held.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.membe: You are of the Holding Stone now, so this door is held for you. I keep it for every member of this house, asleep or away.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.refer: Someone above told you of the refuge, guest, and they were right to. I have held this door for longer than most of them have lived.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.stran: You came in under my arms, guest, out of the swell. I hold this door so the sea stays outside it.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.house.line1: I chose to hold this entrance, and I could still let go and walk away from it. I do not, because people sleep behind me.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.house.line2: A promise is a weight that other people lean their lives on. I have never set mine down, so I find it hard when others set theirs down.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.item_hint: Hold it up where I can see it, guest. My hands stay on the stone while we talk.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.item_inquir: Holdfast takes the hands first, then the feet. In time it will hold you to stone the way it holds me to this door.
Holdfast grips without turning to stone, so I could let go of this door today. I stay because I chose to, guest.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.early: The house takes no one before the fifth Degree, guest. Grow into it first, then come back to this door. I will still be holding it.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.line1: Then you are of the Holding Stone, so other people will lean on you now. Do not let any of them fall.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.settle: You have moved between houses once already, guest. The custom allows a single move, which you have spent. I cannot take you in.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.standi: I do not know you yet, so I cannot lean on you. Shelter here as a guest first, then ask me again.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.shunned.lin: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, which could loosen whatever holds me here. I am closing the door to you.
Go back out the way you came in. No one in this refuge will ever strike you for it.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.strain.othe: You carry the strain of another house, and the door does not ask what you carry. It holds for anyone inside.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.strain.own: Holdfast is growing on you, guest, round the wrists where it always starts. One day it may hold a door of its own.
hemomancy.court.champion.buds: The Champion buds another ring of its crown.
hemomancy.court.champion.called: Then let it be tested. Champion, come out from among the elders: a petitioner asks for your title.
hemomancy.court.champion.named: The head has looked upon you and lowered its crown. The Sanctum names you Champion of the Kindling.
hemomancy.court.champion.open: The Kindling will let you challenge their Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_champio: You already hold the Champion's title.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_shunned: The Kindling won't let you near their Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_standin: The Kindling have to count you a friend before you can challenge their Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_strain: Only a strain at Apex can challenge the Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_unknown: You don't know the Court yet.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_wait: Your last challenge is too recent. Wait a day.
hemomancy.court.champion.won: You hold the title of Kindled Champion.
hemomancy.court.discovery: These waters are kept. You have found the Brined Court.
The Giving Light. On the reef, shoreward. The Holding Stone. In the rocks, at the waterline.
Under us, the Woven Current. Lines in the dark. Deeper, the quiet houses. We don't swim that far.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.known: Nobody led you here. Few find the school alone. Keep up.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.membe: Shared Wake now. One of us. Take a place inside. We'll close around you.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.refer: Someone sent you. Good. The school's moving. Swim beside us.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.stran: You're outside the school. Stay on the edge. We watch it. Keep pace.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.house.line1: We're the Shared Wake. The school's our home. We don't stop long. Strength is keeping pace with each other.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.house.line2: We swim the edge. We find the food. We turn back for the tired. Nobody's left behind.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.item_hint: Show us. Quick. The school won't wait.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.item_inquir: Mermaid's Purse. Ours. It banks the hunt. It grows the sail.
Lightkeeper's lesson first. Then feed it at the nursery. It grows faster there.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.shunned.lin: Scrubbed bare. No partners on you. Keep off the school.
We swim away. Nobody strikes you. Don't follow.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.strain.othe: Another house's strain. Fine. The wake carries anyone who keeps pace.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.strain.own: Purse on your flank. Ours. It banks the hunt. Share it with the hurt.
hemomancy.court.gardener.amends.line1: Thank you. We'll put it on the table with everyone's, and that is the end of it. Now come and eat.
hemomancy.court.gardener.custom.line1: You brought food for the table? Oh, that's the Garden's own custom, friend. Thank you, we'll share it round.
hemomancy.court.gardener.directions.line: Below us the Holding Stone braces the shore. Past it the Shared Wake roams the open water, and the Woven Current keeps down in the twilight.
Deeper there's the Veiled Fold and the Still Bell, then the Last Marrow on the whale falls and the Kindling at the vents. Eat something before you go that far, love.
hemomancy.court.gardener.food.line1: There, eat it all, love. Was it good? There is more in the pot if you're still hungry.
hemomancy.court.gardener.gift.line1: Here, take these from the beds. They glow when it's dark, so you have something to remember the table by.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.known: You found us all on your own? Not many do, friend. Welcome to the Garden. Sit, there is always more on the table.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.member: There you are! The beds missed you, and so did we. Wash your hands and come and eat with the house.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.referred: Someone sent you down to us, didn't they? Good, you're here now. Sit and eat, and tell us who it was and how the trip down went.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.stranger: Oh, you're soaked through, love. Sit down here by the table. We'll feed you first and ask your name after. Have you eaten today?
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.transgres: I can't feed you, not until you've made it right with the Garden. Come back with food to share in your hand and we'll talk.
hemomancy.court.gardener.house.line1: We're the Giving Light. Everyone has something to give, and everyone deserves to be fed. That's all of it, really.
hemomancy.court.gardener.house.line2: Marimo's here with us, in the bloom and the sun. When someone leaves the Garden it hurts every one of us, and we don't hide that.
hemomancy.court.gardener.item_hint: Show me what you're carrying, love. I know the beds better than the books, but I will tell you what I can.
hemomancy.court.gardener.item_inquiry.mo: That's Sunburst, our own. Keep it in the sun and it'll feed you back. Isn't that lovely?
Feed it here, in the Garden's water, once you've had the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster at home.
hemomancy.court.gardener.item_inquiry.re: A Voyager's chart? It points to the nearest Lighthouse Garden, and here you are. Now, have you eaten?
hemomancy.court.gardener.rest.line1: Lie down in the shade by the beds, friend. Nobody will wake you, and we will keep the light low for you.
hemomancy.court.gardener.shunned.line1: Please don't come any closer. You've been scrubbed clean of everything that lives with us, and it could spread to the beds.
hemomancy.court.gardener.shunned.line2: I'm sorry, I can't feed you. Go back up the way you came, and go carefully.
hemomancy.court.gardener.strain.other: You carry another house's strain, friend. That's all right. We feed everyone at this table, whatever they carry.
hemomancy.court.gardener.strain.own: Oh, that's Sunburst on you. Look at it, turning to the light already. It knows it has come home.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.challenge.li: You ask to take the Champion's title, petitioner. It is an honor to be asked, and a greater one to be refused by strength.
You will fight in the vent water before the heads, and if you fall, you may ask again when a day has passed. Are you ready?
hemomancy.court.head_tender.challenge.re: The Sanctum will not set its Champion against one who carries the still water.
The Kindling do not yet count you a friend, petitioner. Keep the house's custom at the heads until they do, and then ask again.
What you carry has not reached its Apex, petitioner. Bring a strain that has, worn or carried, and the title may be asked for.
You are not known to the Court, petitioner, and no stranger asks the Sanctum for its Champion's title.
You asked and fell not a day ago, petitioner. Rest until the day has turned, and then you may ask once more.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.directions.l: The houses rise from here as the heat fades: the Last Marrow on the whale fall, then the Still Bell and the Veiled Fold in the midnight water.
Above them the Woven Current, the Shared Wake and the Holding Stone, and at the very top the Giving Light, who feed whoever comes to them.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.gift.line1: Take this light from the vent mouths, as every petitioner received at the threshold does, so that the dark above remembers the heads.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.known: You found the Sanctum with no one to guide you, petitioner, and that is a kind of preparation in itself, which the heads have seen.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.member: Kindling, the threshold knows you, and your preparation continues here among the heads for as long as you choose to live.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.referr: You were sent to the Sanctum and came all the way down, so someone above believed you should see the heads. Let us find out together whether they were right.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.strang: You stand at the threshold of the Vent Sanctum, petitioner, and no one crosses it who is not ready, though no one is asked to. What do you bring?
hemomancy.court.head_tender.house.line1: The Kindling cultivates the greatest self it can and, at the end of life, gives that self to Hydra. Surrender is an end, not a duty, and I ask it of no one.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.house.line2: Only the most worthy keep a head, and the rest become the body that holds the heads up. Hydra judges which, and I only read the judgment aloud.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.item_hint: Show me what you carry, petitioner, for the Sanctum has seen most of what the sea gives up.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.item_inquiry: Kinbud, petitioner, is the polyp that buds as Hydra buds, and every one of us began with it along the spine.
Feed it through a lifetime and it grows toward the one body, but whether it reaches a head is not for you or me to say.
That is a Voyager's chart drawn toward the Seats, petitioner, and it brought you as far as the threshold, which is where it ends.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.early: The Sanctum receives no one before the fifth Degree, petitioner, so go back up, prepare, and return when you have reached it.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.line1: Then you are Kindling, and the threshold is yours to walk. Prepare well, for a lifetime is not long for what we prepare toward.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.settled: You have moved between houses once already, and the custom allows one move in a life. Yours is spent, and the threshold cannot take you.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.standin: The Sanctum does not know you yet, petitioner. Come down again and witness the feeding, and let the heads come to know you before you ask.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.shunned.line: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, petitioner, and that emptiness could spread to the heads, which the Sanctum will not risk.
The threshold is closed to you, so withdraw from the Sanctum. No one here will raise a hand to you.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.strain.other: You carry the strain of a house above us, petitioner, and it will never reach the heads, though you may still witness them. Will you watch in silence?
hemomancy.court.head_tender.strain.own: Kinbud grows on you, petitioner, as it grew on every one of us, and with it begins the long preparation for the one body.
hemomancy.court.host.custom.line1: Ink for the screen? Thank you. It keeps the door dark, and nobody will know who gave it.
hemomancy.court.host.directions.line1: Up the slope, the Woven Current hangs its lines. They'll want to tie you in. Do you want that?
hemomancy.court.host.directions.line2: Deeper, the Still Bell keeps its cold. Then the Last Marrow, then the vents. Where will you go?
hemomancy.court.host.greet.known: You found the cleft on your own, didn't you? I won't ask how. Come in. This room, not the rest.
hemomancy.court.host.greet.member: You're of the Fold now. Which room is yours? Don't tell me. I don't need to know.
hemomancy.court.host.greet.referred: Someone sent you here. I won't ask who. Did they tell you about the room? It's open to you.
hemomancy.court.host.greet.stranger: You're at the door. Why have you come? I won't ask your name.
hemomancy.court.host.house.line1: We're the Veiled Fold. Shelter here doesn't buy your history. Why would it?
hemomancy.court.host.house.line2: A guest gets one room, not the house. Would you open every door of yours to a stranger? We don't.
hemomancy.court.host.item_hint: What are you carrying? Show me only what you want to.
hemomancy.court.host.item_inquiry.morphl: Ink Cap. It's ours. Did you notice hostile things lose sight of you sooner? That's the veil.
Has the Lightkeeper given you the first lesson? Then feed it here in the Fold. It grows faster in its own house.
hemomancy.court.host.rest.line1: Sit, then. Nobody will come in. Shall I draw the screen?
hemomancy.court.host.shunned.line1: You're scrubbed of every partner. Do you know what that carries? The door stays shut.
hemomancy.court.host.shunned.line2: Please go. No one will touch you. Nothing will follow you out.
hemomancy.court.host.strain.other: Another house's strain. Does that matter here? Not at this door.
hemomancy.court.host.strain.own: Ink Cap on you. Do you feel the veil yet? It's quiet at first.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.gift.line1: Light from the vent water, take. This body keeps none of it.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.greet.know: Found the way down alone. That is good.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.greet.memb: Kindling. Prepare, as this body prepares.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.house.line: This body is nearly ready. Not yet.
A head, or only the body. Hydra will judge.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.item_hint: Hold it up to the crown.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.item_inqui: Kinbud. This body began so. Small, long ago.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.shunned.li: Empty body. Nothing lives on it.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.strain.oth: Another house's strain. Not for the heads.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.strain.own: Kinbud, the beginning. This body began so.
