hemomancy.court.known: You know of the Brined Court now.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.directions.l: Above the camp the light grows, through the Shared Wake and the Holding Stone up to the Giving Light at the surface.
Below the camp the light is gone, where the Veiled Fold, the Still Bell and the Last Marrow live, with the Kindling lowest of all.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.gift.line1: Take these leads, lines made to tie and to untie, so that wherever you go a joining stays something you choose.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.known: You found the camp with no strand to guide you, which the network felt as a small surprise passing from pod to pod.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.member: You are of the Woven Current now, so when you tie in we will feel you, and when you let go we will let you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.referr: Someone above sent you to the lines, and we felt you arrive along every strand before I let go to greet you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.strang: We were holding the line when you came, and I have let go of it so that one voice can speak to you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.house.line1: While I am joined I am many, and the camp sees with all of us. When I let go I am one again, as I am now.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.house.line2: Every joining here is chosen, so that every one can be undone, which I know because I have let go many times in a long life and joined again.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.item_hint: Hold it near, so that I can see it with my own eyes while I am apart from the others.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.item_inquiry: Dead Man's Rope is ours, the strain that let me join the network and that still lets me leave it when I choose.
Feed it here in the camp once you have had the Lightkeeper's lesson, because a strain grows faster in its own house's water.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.early: The house takes no one before the fifth Degree, so grow into the blood first, and the lines will still be here for you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.line1: Then you are of the Woven Current, and the camp will feel you on the lines whenever you choose to tie in.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.settled: You have moved between houses once already, and the custom allows a single move, so I cannot take you in now.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.standin: The network does not know you yet, so stay at the camp a while and bring line for it, then ask me again.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.shunned.line: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, and through one strand that could pass into every one of us at once.
I am taking hold of the line again, and the network closes to you, but nothing here will ever strike you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.strain.other: You carry the strain of another house, which the network does not mind, though it cannot feel you through it.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.strain.own: Our rope is in your veins, so the network can feel you through it, while the strain grows toward tying you to whoever you choose.
hemomancy.court.lesson.already_taught: You already know the Lightkeeper's lesson.
hemomancy.court.lesson.refused_degree: The Garden teaches nothing before the fifth Degree.
hemomancy.court.lesson.refused_shunned: The Garden won't teach someone scrubbed clean of partners.
hemomancy.court.lesson.refused_transgres: The Garden teaches nothing while your wrong against it stands.
hemomancy.court.lesson.taught: A strain fed in its own house's waters grows faster. You know that now.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.amends.line1: Thank you, it's on the table now with everyone's, and the Garden is open to you again.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.directions.l: The houses keep their own depths: the Holding Stone on the shore, the Shared Wake in open water, and the Woven Current in the twilight.
Then come the Veiled Fold and the Still Bell at midnight, the Last Marrow on the falls and the Kindling at the vents. Each house feeds its own strain best.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.food.line1: Eat first, guest, because a lesson is wasted on an empty stomach, and so is most of everything else.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.known: You found the Garden without a guide, which tells me something about you already. Sit down with us, and we'll see what you came for.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.member: Welcome home, Giving Light. The lamp is lit and the beds are tended. Is there anything you need from me?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.referr: So you were sent to us, guest. Whoever sent you knew that the Court begins here, and that the first lesson is mine to give.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.strang: Welcome to the Lighthouse Garden, guest. I keep the lamp here, and I teach the first lesson when someone is ready to learn it. Have they fed you yet?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.transg: You took what wasn't given here, and the Garden won't open to you until you bring something back to the table. Do you understand?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.house.line1: The Giving Light keeps the top of the water, nearest Marimo. We hold that everyone has something to give, and everyone deserves to be fed.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.house.line2: The Garden is where the Court meets the world, so we feed whoever comes, and some of them stay. Do you see why the lamp stays lit?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.item_hint: Show me what you've brought, and if it came from the Court I can tell you where it was grown.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.item_inquiry: This letter came from one of the drowned envoys. Someone meant to reach us and didn't, and you have carried it the rest of the way.
Sunburst is the Giving Light's own strain, a fungus and an alga living as one. It feeds whoever carries it in the sun.
Fed in the Garden's water after the first lesson, it grows faster than it would anywhere else, because this is its home water.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.early: The Court takes no one into a house before the fifth Degree. Come back to me then, and ask me again.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.line1: Then be welcome in the Giving Light. You'll have a place at the table and a share of the work, because that is what a house is.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.settled: You have moved houses once already, and the custom allows only the one move. You made yours, and I'm sorry.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.standin: We hardly know you yet, guest. Spend some time in the Garden first, and let the house come to know you before you ask.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.early: Not yet, guest. The lesson waits for the fifth Degree, and until then you are welcome to eat with us and rest. There is no hurry here.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.known: You've had the first lesson already. Take your strain home to its own house's water and feed it there, where it grows fastest.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.line1: A strain fed inside its own house's water grows faster than it does anywhere else. That is the whole of the first lesson.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.line2: Your Morphling is a partner, and like any partner it wants its home water. Feed it there and it answers you. Do you see why we call it partnership?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.shunned.line: I'm sorry, but you're clean of every partner we live with, and whatever did that to you could take our strains as well.
I can't teach you or feed you, guest. Please keep your distance from the beds, and go in peace.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.strain.other: Your strain belongs to another house, guest. The lesson still holds for it, but only in its own house's water, not in ours.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.strain.own: You carry Sunburst, and once you've had the lesson it will grow faster in this water than anywhere else. Ask me for it.
hemomancy.court.linesman.custom.line1: Line for the camp. Thank you. If the water pulls at a pod tonight, this is what'll hold it.
hemomancy.court.linesman.directions.line: Above us the Shared Wake swims the open water, and the Holding Stone and the Giving Light keep the shore. If you go up, follow the light.
Below the camp the Veiled Fold keeps its clefts and the Still Bell sits in the cold. If you go down, go slowly, because the light ends here.
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.known: You found the lines on your own, in the dark between the walls. Will you let me show you where they hold?
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.member: You're Woven Current now, so tie in when you like. You can let go just as freely, and nobody will ask why.
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.referred: Someone told you the camp hangs here, and they were right to. If you want a line, there's slack on this one.
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.stranger: You came down into the gully without a line. If you'll take one, I'll tie you in while you're here.
hemomancy.court.linesman.house.line1: We're the Woven Current. The camp hangs between the walls on lines, and the pods part or join as the water needs.
hemomancy.court.linesman.house.line2: Nobody ties you in but you. If you let go, that's yours to choose too, and we'll keep your place either way.
hemomancy.court.linesman.item_hint: If you'll show me what you carry, I'll tell you what I know of it.
hemomancy.court.linesman.item_inquiry.mo: Dead Man's Rope. It's ours. It feels the living through its strands, and later it ties you to anyone who chooses to hold on.
If you'll feed it here in the camp after the Lightkeeper's lesson, it'll grow faster. The camp's water does that.
hemomancy.court.linesman.shunned.line1: You're scrubbed of every partner, and a strand could carry that through the whole camp. I can't tie you in.
hemomancy.court.linesman.shunned.line2: If you'll keep off the lines, that's all we ask. Nobody here will raise a hand to you.
hemomancy.court.linesman.strain.other: You carry another house's strain, and that's fine on the lines. If you'll hold a strand, the camp won't ask which.
hemomancy.court.linesman.strain.own: That's our rope in your veins. If you link with someone, tell them first that either of you can let go.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.custom.lin: Remains for the fall. Good. The elders root in bone, and the plumes eat the rest.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.directions: Above us there's the Still Bell in the cold, and the Veiled Fold in its clefts. They'll take you in, carefully.
Below us there's only the Kindling at the vents. They'd give a body to their heads. I'd rather mine fed people.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.food.line1: Eat. It's from the fall, and it was strong once. Now it's yours.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.know: You found the fall on your own. Most follow the scavengers down.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.memb: You're Last Marrow now. There's work in the bones, and food after it.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.refe: Someone told you about the fall. Good. There's plenty left on the bones.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.stra: You've come down to the fall. Mind the ribs, they're sharp where the flesh is gone.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.house.line: We're Last Marrow. A whale fall's food and shelter, and it won't last forever.
Nothing goes to waste here. When I'm spent, I'll root in the bones and feed whoever's next.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.item_hint: Show me. If it was alive once, I'll know what it's good for.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.item_inqui: Marrowplume. It's ours. It feeds off what's dead and heals you with it. Later it roots.
Feed it here at the fall after the Lightkeeper's lesson. It'll grow faster in home water.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.rest.line1: Lie down under the ribs, out of the cold. I'll keep the scavengers off.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.shunned.li: You've been scrubbed of every partner. Down here that'd rot the whole fall.
Stay off the bones. Nobody here's going to hurt you, but you can't come in.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.strain.oth: You carry another house's strain. That's fine. The fall feeds everyone the same.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.strain.own: That's Marrowplume on your arms. It'll feed you off whatever's left. Let it.
hemomancy.court.membership.refused_degre: Nobody joins %s before the fifth Degree.
hemomancy.court.membership.refused_shunn: No house will take you. They keep clear of whatever cleansed you.
hemomancy.court.membership.refused_stand: You need to be a guest of %s before you can join.
hemomancy.court.membership.refused_switc: You have moved once already. Your house is fixed.
hemomancy.court.membership.refused_trans: %s won't take you while your wrong against it stands.
hemomancy.court.membership.switched: You leave %s for %s. You won't move again.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.custom.li: A fish for the young is our custom, sharing the catch with the ones who can't hunt yet. They'll eat well tonight.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.direction: The school swims a wide loop through open water, so watch for the edge-swimmers. They'll see you long before you see them.
Shoreward are the Giving Light and the Holding Stone. The Woven Current's lines hang in the twilight water below, and we don't take the young that deep.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.gift.line: Here's some cooked salmon for you. Have you eaten anything since you left the shore?
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.kno: You found the nursery without the school to lead you. That's a lot of open water to cross alone.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.mem: You're Shared Wake now, so come and count the young with me. The cups hold one more than last time.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.ref: Someone told you where the nursery is, then, and I'm glad they did. The school's out on its loop, but we keep this ground for it.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.str: Mind the cups as you come in, because the young are in them. Did you swim all this way alone?
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.house.lin: We're the Shared Wake. The school is our home, and this ground is where the young grow until they can keep pace.
Strength is keeping pace with each other. The fast ones swim the edge, and the rest of us make sure no one's left behind.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.item_hint: Hold it up where I can see it, but gently, please, and never over the cups.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.item_inqu: Mermaid's Purse is ours. It banks blood on the hunt and gives it to whoever in the school is hurt worst.
Feed it here at the nursery once you've had the Lightkeeper's lesson, because it grows faster on home ground.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.earl: We take no one in before the fifth Degree, so grow into the blood first. The school will still be swimming when you come back.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.line: Then you're Shared Wake. Swim with the school when you can, and always turn back for anyone who tires.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.sett: You've moved between houses once already, and the custom allows only one move. I'm sorry, but you've used yours.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.stan: We barely know you yet, so bring the young a share of your catch and swim with us a while, then ask me again.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.shunned.l: You've been scrubbed of every partner, and that could pass to the young, who have so little of their own yet.
Please keep away from the nursery and the cups. No one here will ever hurt you for it, but you can't come near.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.strain.ot: You carry another house's strain, and that's fine here. The young only care how gently you swim near them.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.strain.ow: That's our purse on your flank. When someone in the school is hurt, it gives them what it's banked.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.custom.l: This goes down to the heads with ours. Your offering is received, and they are fed.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.directio: Above us is the Last Marrow, on the bones of the whale fall. Above them are the Still Bell and the Veiled Fold.
The Garden is at the top, where the light reaches. The houses between will tell you the rest of the way.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.kn: You came down without a guide, visitor, and few do that. The heads will not mind you, and neither will we.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.me: Kindling. Your share of the feeding waits by the basins. We prepare together.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.re: Someone above sent you down to the Sanctum, visitor. Watch the feeding, and do not hurry.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.st: You are in the Kindling's water, visitor. The heads are fed here every day. Do not touch the offerings.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.house.li: We are the Kindling. We cultivate the greatest self we can grow, and at the end of a life we give it to Hydra.
The vents are the heads, and we feed them all our lives. To waste a person before they are ready is the worst thing we know.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.item_hin: Show it to me. I will tell you what the Kindling knows of it.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.item_inq: Kinbud is the Kindling's strain. It buds along the spine, the way Hydra buds.
Carry it for a lifetime. Then you will know what it is for.
You carry nothing living, visitor. Stand back from the offerings.
Nothing of yours will go down to the heads. Leave the Sanctum now.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.strain.o: Your strain belongs to another house. It will not reach the heads. You may still watch the feeding.
Kinbud grows along your spine, visitor. That is only the beginning. A lifetime of preparation follows it.
hemomancy.court.presence.hydra.call: Be still, petitioner, and do not reach for it. The great head rises only to look upon who has come.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.0: The ones in the walls were people, and they still are. They only stopped needing to move.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.1: Nobody is kept here. Each of us came down a tier at a time, over a whole lifetime.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.2: There's food in the pool and room on the ledges, and nobody here will ask you for anything.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.3: When one of us goes still at last, the moss carries what they knew to all the rest of us.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.4: That's how we talk to the walls, and it's how the walls answer us when we're quiet enough.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.5: Marimo gives slowly. Food first, then belonging, and at the very end a place in the walls. Are you hungry?
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.first: You've come all the way down. We felt you on the stair, every tier of it. Stay as long as you like.
hemomancy.court.presence.refused.marimo: Marimo's moss does not come away.
hemomancy.court.presence.refused.site: The Court does not let this be broken.
hemomancy.court.rest.recent: You rested here only a little while ago.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.gift.line1: Take this bone meal, ground from a fall that was eaten long ago, and let it grow something for you wherever you go.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.known: You found the fall with no one to lead you, which means you read the scavengers well, as I once had to when I was young and walked.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.membe: You are of Last Marrow now, you who follow, so the fall will feed you as it feeds the rest of the house for as long as there is bone.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.refer: Someone above sent you down to the bones, you who follow, and my plumes felt the water stir as you came.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.stran: You have come down to the fall, you who follow, and I am glad to be awake for it, though I cannot rise to meet you.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.house.line1: I chose to root in this bone when my strength began to fail, so that what was left of it would feed the young.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.house.line2: Rooting is a choice, and I could still draw my roots out of the bone and go, but I would rather be of use here.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.item_hint: Hold it out over the bone where I can see it, because I cannot lean any closer to you than this.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.item_inquir: Marrowplume is the strain of this house, which feeds on what the dead leave behind and which rooted me in this bone when my strength was spent.
Feed it here on the fall once you have had the Lightkeeper's lesson, because a strain grows faster in its own house's water.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.early: The house takes no one before the fifth Degree, so grow into the blood first and come back down to the bones when you have.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.line1: Then you are of Last Marrow, you who follow, and when your strength is spent it will feed the ones after you.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.settle: You have moved between houses once already, and the custom allows only that one move, so I cannot take you in.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.standi: I do not know you well enough yet, you who follow, so work beside the tenders on the fall a while and then ask again.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.shunned.lin: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, and in the bones that emptiness could spread through every elder rooted here, so I cannot let you near.
I am drawing my plumes in, and the tenders will keep you from the fall, but no one here will ever do you harm.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.strain.othe: You carry the strain of another house, and the fall will feed you just the same, because nothing here is wasted.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.strain.own: Marrowplume is on your arms already, and at its fullest it will let you root as I have rooted, though your roots, like mine, can always be drawn out again.
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.known: [Frost has formed along the mantle's lowest fold. Nothing inside it stirs.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.member: [The mantle eases a little at its lowest fold, then settles still.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.referred: [The folded mantle rises once with a slow breath, then is still again.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.stranger: [The sleeper hangs sealed in its mantle from a bone hook in the dome. It does not wake.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.house.line1: [The sleepers of the Still Bell are woken only when the bell needs one of them. It does not need this one yet.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.house.line2: [Through the mantle, barely a word:] Still.
hemomancy.court.sleeper.item_hint: [The sleeper's eyes stay closed under the frost on its brows.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.shunned.line1: [The mantle draws tighter around the sleeper as you come near.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.shunned.line2: [It stays sealed. Nothing in the bell moves toward you.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.strain.other: [The sleeper gives no sign of the strain you carry.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.strain.own: [A faint frost-blue pulse passes along the fold nearest you, in time with your Hushbell.]
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.custom.line1: Stone for the passage. It goes in with the next repair. You've shared the upkeep. That's our custom. Thank you.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.directions.li: The Giving Light's above us, in the sun. Eat there. Out in open water swims the Shared Wake. Follow the school.
Deeper, the Woven Current strings its lines through the twilight. Below that I don't go. My passage is here.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.known: Found us on your own? Then you read the rocks well. Stay inside the walls. I'll keep the sea out.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.member: Holding Stone. Welcome home. Your place by the pool is kept. Nobody's moved it.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.referre: They said you'd come. You came. Good. The passage is clear. I checked it this morning.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.strange: Stop there. You're in the refuge now. Mind the rock, it's wet. I keep this passage. You'll be safe in it.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.house.line1: We're the Holding Stone. We keep the shelters and the passages. Someone always has to. Here, it's us.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.house.line2: A promise here is a wall. People build their days on it. So we don't make one lightly.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.item_hint: Show me. If it came off the shore, I'll know it.
Holdfast. Ours. It grips stone, not shell. Feed it here and it grips sooner.
Feed it in the refuge's water once you've had the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster at home.
A Voyager's chart. It points to the Garden. The refuge isn't on it. We're small. That's fine.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.rest.line1: Sit in the shelter, out of the swell. I'll watch the door. That's a promise.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.shunned.line1: Stay outside. You're scrubbed bare. Whatever did that could strip the growth off us.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.shunned.line2: The refuge is closed to you. I won't hurt you. I won't open it either.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.strain.other: That's another house's strain. Fine. The refuge shelters everyone. Keep to the passage.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.strain.own: Holdfast on your arms. Good grip. It'll take the stone when you need it.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.gift.lin: Dark glass. You see out. No one sees in.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.kn: You came alone. I noticed you.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.me: One of the Fold. I will not ask more.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.re: Someone named this place to you. Who?
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.st: You see me. Few do. Why?
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.house.li: I fold away when still. I choose to.
Belonging asks nothing of my name. Does yours?
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.item_inq: Ink Cap. Ours. It veils. Later it hides.
The Lightkeeper's lesson first. Then feed it here. It grows faster.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.ear: Not before the fifth Degree. Come back then.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.lin: Then you are of the Fold. Keep your own counsel.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.set: You have moved houses once. That was your one.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.sta: I do not know you yet. Stay a while. Then ask.
Scrubbed of every partner. I fold away from you.
No one here will harm you. Go.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.strain.o: Another house's strain. It hides nothing here.
The veil is starting on you. Keep it.
hemomancy.court.warden.amends: You brought something back to the table. That's all we wanted, and it's enough. Come and sit with us again.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.growth: You tore up what we planted for everyone. It wasn't yours, and it wasn't only ours either.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.harm: You raised your hand against someone who lives here. Nobody in the Garden does that to anyone.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.second_gift: You took what was set out for the others. There's always enough here, but only when it's shared.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.undercroft: You reached into the walls for one of us. They're still people down there, and they felt your hand.
hemomancy.court.warden.turned_away: The Giving Light turns you away until you make amends. Bring an offering of food.
hemomancy.degree.8: Eighth Degree of the Hematic Order
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_c: I can offer a silver chalice.
I can help consecrate the church.
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_w: I can offer a poppy wreath.
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.vow_ge: I have completed the Gentle Separation.
hemomancy.dialogue.action.confirm: Review what this choice will do, then continue when you are ready.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.conductive_: Your Ductilis record predicts a conductive response. The Mnemonist insists on calling that a Noetic Memory, and I've stopped arguing. The Loom formula's recorded.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.acce: Show me how blood changes the body.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.arti: The Artificer sent me for Crimson Lacquer.
The Artificer sent me about my first armor answer.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.ashe: How do I make an Ashen Vessel?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.ask_: Where do these strains come from?
I have a question about something I found...
What work does the Mnemonist need?
Which specimens should I study for this armor?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.begi: What living specimens do you need?
What field samples do you need?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.crim: How do I make a Crimson Vessel?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.curv: How do I make a Curved Horn?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.deep: Can you give me a Deep Dark bearing?
What do you need from the Deep Dark?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.enzy: What can I use these enzymes for?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.firs: What is my first Alembic assignment?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.gour: How do I fill and use it?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.how_: How should I keep upgrading my gourd?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.lant: How do I keep an enzyme culture going?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.loom: How do I raise the Loom?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.pall: Teach me the first blood vessel.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.phle: Can you point me toward a Basin?
What are you studying in the Nether?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.reco: Record this living specimen and return it.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.repo: Show the Basin sample and Scyphus.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.spec: Can I take two jars to start?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.surr: Surrender this polyp as an Ink Cap Morphling.
Surrender this polyp as a Marrowplume Morphling.
Surrender this polyp as a Hushbell Morphling.
Surrender this polyp as a Holdfast Morphling.
Surrender this polyp as a Mermaid's Purse Morphling.
Surrender this polyp as a Dead Man's Rope Morphling.
Surrender this polyp as a Sunburst Morphling.
Surrender this polyp as a Kinbud Morphling.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.tell: Tell me about the Ghastly Alembic.
Tell me about the Vial Centrifuge.
Tell me about the Chisel Station.
Tell me about the Somatic Loom.
Tell me about the machines in this Outpost.
Tell me about the Morphling Incubator.
Tell me about the Cerebral Scarring Station.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.thel: What else can the body learn?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.vagr: What lives around the Vagrant Mind?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.what: What do you see when you look at me now?
What remains to be learned at this stage?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.wild: How should I study wild Morphlings?
hemomancy.dialogue.anchorite.option.abou: How does your work differ from the Alchemist's?
How does your work differ from the Artificer's?
hemomancy.dialogue.anchorite.option.acce: I will take the question to a Mnemonist.
hemomancy.dialogue.annetta.option.how_lo: How long was it in you?
hemomancy.dialogue.annetta.option.what_i: It'll draw out what's inside you.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.armo: What armor path should I choose?
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.clai: Give me the Armature Consecration Kit.
Issue the material for my recorded lineage.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.livi: Teach me to make a Living Staff.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.reco: My first lineage was Silent Archon.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.scar: How do I equip my fittings?
hemomancy.dialogue.brief.line: [Insert message about %s here, in a %s tone.]
hemomancy.dialogue.category.conversation: Talk, and what they know of the old work.
hemomancy.dialogue.category.inquiries.su: Choose an item from your inventory to ask about.
hemomancy.dialogue.category.trade.summar: What they want, and what they give for it.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_acrobat.line1: By the time you've worked out where I landed, I'm already gone from it.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_acrobat.line2: Everybody says I vanish. You just picked the landing too soon, that's all.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_acrobat.line3: The Mummer pulls your eye over, and I go in the moment after you've turned it.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_fire_eater.lin: You teach your body which burns to keep and which to breathe back out, and the crowd calls that swallowing fire.
The torch is only a staff-form. Our work's in making the breath carry farther.
The crowd holds the shape for me. Without them watching I'd just be burning my own throat.
The blade goes where it's thrown. It's the hand pointing out the landing that lies to you.
Knives fly straight. It's always the people that bend.
The first nine marks teach distance. With the tenth you learn when to hold the knife.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_performer.welc: Stand still a moment and let everyone have a look at you. New faces settle in quicker once the whole pavilion has seen them.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_stilt_walker.l: Up here, I decide where the crowd looks for danger.
They're braces. If you want to see how I walk, watch the cords and forget my feet.
Once every eye comes up to meet me, somebody else owns the floor.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.amends: Offer the food in your hand, as amends.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.directio: Where do the other houses live?
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.lost_let: I lost a sealed letter a drowned Votary was carrying.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer: Give the food in your hand.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_ca: Give the fish in your hand, for the young.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_in: Give the ink in your hand, for the screen.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_li: Give the line in your hand, for the camp.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_re: Give the remains in your hand, for the fall.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_st: Give the stone in your hand, for the passages.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_wo: Give the wool in your hand, for the bell's warmth.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.read_let: Who was this letter meant for?
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.rest: May I rest here a while?
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.apot: The machines still work. Bring me what needs mending.
Apotheosis, then. I only know it from old stories, and nobody in them came back as someone you'd recognize. The rite isn't finished yet. What does the apparatus need until it is?
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.sile: You beat Vesper, but you're still carrying his memory. Burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and pull it in with the Staff. That finishes it.
Silentium, then. You came back from Vesper with his memory in you. I can still make and mend the instruments you use.
Your refusal's on record, but Vesper's still ahead of you. The workshop's open for repairs and preparations.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.unde: There's work ahead I can't measure yet. What do you need from the workshop?
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.apot: Your frame's changed. I couldn't tell you what half of it is now. Anything still need fitting?

So you're going the way they call Apotheosis. I only know it from stories, and none of my frames would fit whatever comes out the other side. The rite's not done yet, though, so till then I'll fit the one you've got.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.sile: So Vesper's down, but his memory's not in you yet. Light the Iron Brazier, set the Memory in it and draw it through the Living Staff.
You held against Vesper and took his memory in, so it's Silentium now. I can still fit the armature, and I'll finish whatever you left on my bench.
Silence, then, and Vesper still in front of you. Wear something that'll last against him, and bring me whatever he breaks.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.unde: So you made Archon. How's the frame holding? It isn't done with you yet, so when it starts to strain somewhere new, bring it in.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.apot: I've written Apotheos in the record. If you came for memories, I can still help you recover them.
I'm keeping notes on the rite as it goes. I won't close the page on it yet.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.sile: I have Vesper's defeat written down, and his memory is still loose. Burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff, and I can close the entry.
Silentium, then. Vesper's memory is filed in you now, and the older lessons are still on my shelves if you need them.
You refused. The entry stays open until Vesper falls.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.unde: I'll write down what you have seen and leave the rest of the page blank.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.apotheos: The Apotheosis is complete. I do not understand it, but I can still tend our rites and whatever obligations remain unfinished.
You've chosen the road the old accounts call Apotheosis. I can't tell you what waits at the end of it, only that the rite isn't finished, and I'll keep the records open until it is.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.silent_a: Vesper has fallen, and you are still carrying his memory. Burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff, and your refusal is finished.
Silentium. Vesper has fallen, your refusal stands, and our rites are still yours.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.silent_p: So you refused the call. That was yours to do, and I will not argue with it. It is not won yet, though. Come back to me once Vesper is defeated.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.undecide: I have no ending to enter in the record for you yet. Some of your work is still open.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_church: The Zealot nods. 'Follow the silver bells. They'll lead you to the church.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_purifica: The Zealot's eyes brighten. 'Bring hemolytic solution to the podium and begin.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.alchemist_armor: The Alchemist compares your Bestiary notes with the Artificer's work and gives you another matching reagent.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.alchemist_besti: The Alchemist taps the jar. 'Already recorded.' Living Bestiary progress: %2$s/%3$s.
The Alchemist studies the polyp. 'That layer's not in this specimen.'
The Alchemist gestures to the bench. 'Filled specimen jar, please. I can't study an empty one.'
The Alchemist studies %s and shakes their head. 'Useful glasswork, maybe. It doesn't belong in this bestiary.'
The Alchemist dissects the polyp and seals the active layer into %s. It's still wild-bound, so incubate it if you want it fully mature.
The Alchemist records %s and returns the jar. Living Bestiary progress: %2$s/%3$s.
The Alchemist lowers their voice while the Tooth Pecks scrape at the glass. 'Dental swarm, social bite. They're useful if you treat every tooth as a witness.' Living Bestiary progress: %2$s/%3$s.
The Alchemist accepts %s for study and returns %s.
The Alchemist accepts the Tooth Pecks and slides %2$s across the bench. 'Save your sympathy for my bench. It'll be covered in tooth marks by morning.'
The Alchemist keeps the ledger shut. 'Living specimens wait until you've learned the Votary's discipline. Come back when you have.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.alchemist_red_t: Your first useful specimen earns you one empty Blood Vial from the Alchemist for field sampling.
The Alchemist waves the %s away. 'I've already cataloged that one. Bring me a different expression.'
The Alchemist looks at your empty hands. 'The sample, Votary. I can't test an idea.'
The Alchemist seals the %s in a specimen vessel. Red Taxonomy progress: %s/4.
That fourth diagnosis finishes your field assay. The Alchemist hands you jars and empty blood vials so you can keep sampling.
The Alchemist shuts the specimen case. 'Not yet. Learn the Votary's discipline first.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.anchorite_d5_re: The Vein-Mason hands you a tier-two pattern, a Blank Scar, its catalyst and four Runic Motifs.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.anchorite_d6_re: The Vein-Mason hands you a tier-three pattern, a Blank Scar, its catalyst and eight Runic Motifs. Carving it still takes Deep Inscription.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_e: §4§oYou surface from the dreaming root with your veins pulling in a new direction, toward the Rite of Apotheos, which has been calling you all along.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_s: §8§oYou have chosen refusal, but it is not yet won. Strike the base of your own spent Bloom with a base Living Weapon to shape a temporary Living Sickle. A second strike with the sickle opens the wound, and you enter through it. Defeat both faces of Vesper, then burn his memory in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff. Only then do you stand at the eighth Degree as a Silentium.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_assum: The Artificer hands you a blank Hematic Memory. 'That limb's yours now. Take this, and don't let it rattle about in your pack.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_blood: The Artificer gives you the Crimson Vestment Fitting. 'That's my mark that I saw the vestment work. It won't put an edge on your staff, so don't go looking for one.'
The Artificer glances at the fitting. 'The Lodge already saw that vestment.'
The Artificer replaces your Crimson Vestment Fitting. 'Try to hang on to this one.'
The Artificer looks you up and down. 'The full Blood Lust set, and all of it on you at the same time. I'm not counting anything else.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_conse: The Artificer gives you an Armature Consecration Kit.
The Artificer shakes his head. 'You've had your kit. A canceled rite gives its offerings back, and you know how to make another now.'
The Artificer keeps a hand on the kit. 'Work the Armature yourself first, and come back at the fifth Degree with your blood awake.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_crims: The frame came through consecration sound. %3$s. Take my referral to an Alchemist.
The Alchemist gives you Crimson Lacquer. 'Here's the lacquer. Finish the vestment, then let the Artificer see it answer.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_d7_fi: The Artificer gives you the Monolithic Frame Fitting. 'That's for the weight you took on.' It's heavy, and it does nothing else.
The Artificer nods once. 'I've already fitted you for that weight.'
The Artificer replaces your Monolithic Frame Fitting. 'Here. You'd think something that heavy would be harder to lose.'
The Artificer looks over your armor. 'What am I looking at here? I want a complete Archon-grade set that matches. I don't fit odds and ends.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_d7_re: The material matches the first lineage. Later upgrades will not rewrite it.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_equip: The full recorded set is equipped
Equip the full recorded set first
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_fork_: The Artificer finds the fitting that matches your family, thorn, shell or prism, and gives it to you. 'There. Somebody's seen it work now.'
The Artificer leaves the drawer closed. 'You've already got the fitting for that shell.'
The Artificer digs out another fitting for your family. 'Try not to lose this one as well.'
The Artificer pushes the fitting back across the bench. 'One complete set from one family. Mixing them tells me you haven't made up your mind.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_hemat: The Artificer gives you the Worn Vow Fitting. 'Goes on the staff. Your armor won't get any tougher for it. It shows I've seen the work.'
The Artificer taps the fitting you're already carrying. 'I've seen that vow. You don't get two.'
The Artificer replaces your Worn Vow Fitting. 'Losing the fitting doesn't cancel the appointment.'
The Artificer looks at the gaps. 'Full Hematic Iron set, on your body. Then I'll fit it.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_inspe: The work hasn't been inspected yet.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_livin: The Artificer gives you the Assumed Limb Fitting, a record of all seven assumed limbs and proof of the work. It adds no fang to the staff and no hidden strength.
The Artificer almost smiles. 'You've already been fitted for the full arsenal.'
The Artificer replaces your Assumed Limb Fitting. 'Your staff kept the record of all seven. Try to keep hold of the fitting this time.'
The Artificer weighs your staff in his hands. 'How many forms is that? It isn't all seven.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_rewar: That material has not been earned, or was already issued.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_three: Recorded fork: %1$s. %3$s. Take the inspection to an Alchemist, who can compare it with your Bestiary records.
The Alchemist gives you the reagent for your recorded armor family. 'Catalog its living examples and I might be able to refine another measure.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_weigh: Recorded Degree 7 lineage: %2$s. %3$s. Its matching material has been issued.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_worn_: The Artificer tips some Hematic Iron Scrap into your hand. 'That's one piece. The rest of the set won't do itself.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.gives_stained_c: [A stained route is set down where you can take it. You recognize the marked church before you have ever seen it.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_accept_g: Keep the waybill somewhere dry. If you still want to join when you get to the outpost, tell its Vicar, and he will take you in.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_archon_w: The Hermit bows low. 'Everything I know is in your blood already, Archon.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_farewell: §7[The Hermit presses a hand to the empty place in his chest. With the Mortal Display claimed, crimson light spills out of him and his body begins to come apart.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_heart_of: Go on, then. You have my blessing. Touch the Mortal Display and take the heart, and come back to me before you leave.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_passing: §o'Heart was never mine to keep, only to give... Follow the waybill to the others at their outpost. Walk the crimson path, young Harbinger. I will go now where blood returns to silence.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_clarity_ri: §bThe words sink into your mind like a stone into still water, and with them the Rite of Clarity Ascension. You know how to perform it now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_enlightene: §bHer words settle on you, cold and clear as snow. You are done with the life that brought you here, and you find you don't mind.
§bShe is still here. She was here the whole time. The world has gone quieter around you.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_circu: The Mnemonist folds a scarlet waybill along a line that tugs toward the nearest Circus.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_start: The Mnemonist shakes their head, nearly smiling. You already know that one.
The Mnemonist drops a crude memory shard into your palm. It hums faintly against your skin.
The Mnemonist closes their hand around the shard and keeps it. You can't claim this lesson now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_woven: The Mnemonist indexes the blank vessel. At the Loom, choose Blood Shot: one bulb, 50 mL of blood, one Vivacious Enzyme. Keep a Living Staff in hand. When the engram unfurls around the Loom, rest your eyes on the fragment until you hear it. Then hold the staff on it and sweep its thread along the star's lines into the Loom.
The Mnemonist turns back a few pages and taps an entry. 'Already indexed. You did this one. Go and use what it taught you.'
The Mnemonist waits beside an empty desk. 'A book, ink and three sheets of paper. I can't index anything without them.'
The Mnemonist holds out an empty hand. 'The blank memory first. I can't index a lesson with nothing to put it in.'
The Mnemonist listens to your pulse and shakes their head. 'Not yet. Come back once you're an Initiate, and keep your blood awake until then.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.monolith_corner: §4The Lodestone presses a Monolithic Cornerstone into your hand. It is small and cold, and far heavier than it should be.
The Lodestone has already given you its cornerstone. It will not give another.
The Lodestone stays silent. It answers only Archons who have worked a consecrated Armature.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.qliphoth_commun: §4§oSomething vast and patient knows you now. You feel the silence of the ninth shell settle into your bones.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.reject_help: The Zealot watches you turn away, silver eyes dimming.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.relay_chart_car: You already carry a Relay Chart.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.relay_chart_iss: The Voyager draws you a Relay Chart.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.scout_gives_not: §7[The Scout presses a small, water-stained journal into your hands. Her grip loosens almost immediately.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.unstained_start: The Zealot already gave you your own entry supplies. Anything in the church chest is shared with other visitors.
The Zealot supplies whatever your entry kit was missing: two Hemolytic Solutions and the Liber Immaculatus. Use one solution at the Podium and the other to make Cleansed Stone.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_firs: The Vein-Mason gives you a Scar Pattern and the materials to carve it.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_know: The Vein-Mason has already given you your first pattern.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_rewa: The Vein-Mason gives you a second pattern, a blank scar, its catalyst, and fresh Motif Paper.
The Vein-Mason has already given you the second pattern and its supplies.
The Vein-Mason waits for you to commit your first loadout.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_unre: The Vein-Mason will not teach you yet.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_assignmen: The Vicar hands you an Assignment Ledger. Your formal work will be entered there. If you lose it, ask him for another copy.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_blood_sho: §4Your eyes ache as the blood-script begins arranging itself into meaning.
§8The blood-script is already open to you.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_first_blo: The promotion could not be completed. Ask the Vicar again.
The Vicar raises you to the second Degree and gives you the Order's first bloodcraft kit, unless you already have it.
The Order has already recognized your First Bloodcraft service.
The Vicar is waiting for all four first bloodcraft proofs: absorption, formation, Venous Stone, and one structure craft.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_gives_scr: §7[The Vicar takes a small, weathered scrap of parchment from his vestments and presses it into your hands.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_hermit_ro: The Vicar taps your ledger. 'That one is reported and entered already. Go and find me another.'
The Vicar writes the wild remnant down as a side road and gives you ash for the next stretch.
The Vicar shakes his head. He wants proof from a wild remnant, one nobody led you to.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_masons_re: The route to Masons Respite is already yours.
The Vicar gives you a scar-scribed route to Masons Respite.
The Vicar will not speak of the Vein-Mason before the fourth Degree.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.whisper_truth_a: §4A fungal awareness settles into your bones. What was said stays with you.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.ask_a: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.repla: I need a replacement Absolution Dagger.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.task_: I will ring the Pale Watch.
I will plate the quiet watch.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.vow_s: I sheltered another from the stain.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.replace_abso: Lost it. I'll replace it. Two Pale Silver Ingots. One Cleansed Blood Crystal Shard. Pledged hands only.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.accept_: I understand. Show me the way.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.how_do_: How do I begin the path of hemomancy?
How do scars reshape the mind?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.what_he: What is this heart you speak of?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.who_are: Who are you? Why are you here?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.conductive_: Your first weave has the conductive pattern in it, the same one the Alchemist measured in Ductilis tissue. They measured it and I heard it. It's one Noetic Memory, and we got to it by two routes.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.anch: The Vein-Mason sent me to ask how a scar should bear a memory.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_: Why do I dream of a chamber?
How do I save a memory loadout?
What can you tell me about this?
Tell me about the Somatic Loom.
How should I choose which memories to keep ready?
You said memory has three movements?
Tell me about the Mnemonic Reliquary.
How do active manipulation slots work?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.choo: Can you teach me a first crude memory?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.morp: Why is my Morphling worrying the puppet threads?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.reli: Show me how to weave the Reliquary.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.take: Give me a waybill to their pavilion.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.turn: I brought the blank vessel and archive materials.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.vagr: Where can I look for one?
Tell you what I saw inside the Mind.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.wove: How do I prepare a blank memory?
hemomancy.dialogue.monolith.option.ancho: What does the Armature still lack?
hemomancy.dialogue.monolith.option.couns: What would you have me do?
hemomancy.dialogue.monolith.option.ripen: What do you mean by ripening?
hemomancy.dialogue.monolith.option.where: Where did the Lodge find what you hold?
hemomancy.dialogue.monolith.option.why_n: Why do you speak to me now?
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.acolyte: They're the ones who keep the blood arts, I think. A Vicar at one of their outposts could tell you more than I can. Come back to us after, if you need somewhere quiet.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.alchemist: The Vicar can tell you who we are. Talk to him before you put your hands on any of my apparatus.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.artificer: New here? Go and find the Vicar first. He's better at explaining the Covenant than I am.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.cicatrix_anc: You are not on my table yet. Find the Vicar first, and ask him what road brought you out here.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_arbor: You are new to the blood, little one, and the Order's Vicars walk on land, and they will show you the first steps.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_bellwa: You are new to the blood. Go to a Vicar on land first. They teach the beginning. Come back after.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_braced: You are new to the blood, guest. The Vicars of the Order teach beginners on land, so go to them first. This door will wait for you.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_edge_s: No Vicar yet. On land. Go there first. We'll still be swimming.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_garden: You haven't met a Vicar yet? Eat with us first. The Order's Vicars will tell you the rest, up on land.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_head_t: You have not yet begun, petitioner. The Vicars of the Order receive beginners on land. Return to the Sanctum when you are Harbinger.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_host: New to the blood? Then find a Vicar on land first. They'll teach you, and they won't ask why you came either.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_kindle: New. Too new. Land first. The Vicars.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_lamp_c: You are new to the blood, so go first to the Vicars on land, who teach the beginnings, and come back to the lines later.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_lightk: You're very new to the blood. Find a Vicar of the Order on land first. Then come back, and the Garden will still be here.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_linesm: New to the blood? If you'll take some advice, find a Vicar on land first. They teach the start of it, and the camp will keep.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_marrow: New to the blood? Go to a Vicar on land first. They'll teach you the start, and then you'll be some use down here.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_nurser: New to the blood? Find a Vicar on land first, because they teach the beginnings. We only teach the young to swim.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_offeri: You have barely begun. The Order's Vicars teach the first steps, on land. Go to them.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_rooted: You are new to the blood, you who follow, so go to the Vicars on land first, because they teach the beginnings of it.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_sleepe: [The sleeper does not wake. Whoever keeps this bell would send you to a Vicar on land first.]
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_tidewa: No Vicar yet? Find one on land. They teach the first steps. I keep passages, not lessons.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_veiled: New to the blood? A Vicar, on land. Go there first.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.guardian: Blood-workers. Their Vicars teach it. Outposts. Not here.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.mnemonist: If you are looking for where to start, ask the Vicar. I come in a little later.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.scout: Blood-workers. Their Vicars teach it. Ask one. Not me. Not now.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.vicar_path: You will not begin here, I am afraid. Every one of us started at a Blood Temple, with its Hermit. Find a temple, speak with the Hermit who keeps it and follow the Hermitage's path from there. If it goes well, come back to me and we will talk about what comes next.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.votary_wayfa: Wait, you haven't met the Vicar yet? He explains the Covenant way better than I would, so talk to him before you set out again.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.voyager: You found a ship before you found an outpost, then. Ask a Vicar ashore who we are and where you ought to start.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.zealot: The Harbingers keep the stain and call it a covenant. Their Vicars explain it at the outposts, if you go asking. So why do you want to know?
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.acolyte.the_l: Have you ever felt the Lady near?
Once, I think, by the water at dawn when I couldn't sleep, though I can't always tell if what I felt was peace or just being tired.
I didn't tell anyone, because it felt like it was only for me. I'd like it to stay between us, if that's all right with you.
There's something the Acolyte hasn't told the others.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.acolyte.the_p: I think so. I came for the soup, if I'm honest, and stayed for the people who make it, though I'm not sure I believe all of it yet. How are you holding up?
The Acolyte talks easily, but not yet about themself.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.alchemist.fai: What's the worst result you've ever had?
A control sample that kept growing after I'd sealed it. I logged it, burned it, and logged the burning.
I still don't know what it was. I'd take a wrong answer over none, and I've got neither. Pass me that rack.
The Alchemist keeps a notebook they never open in front of visitors.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.alchemist.the: How did you end up at this bench?

Bad luck and good handwriting. I labeled a rack properly once, in front of the wrong Vicar, and I've been labeling racks ever since. The bench is the only thing in this outpost that does what I tell it.
Bring the Alchemist enough samples and they might talk about something other than samples.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.artificer.fir: What was the first thing you made?
A rack hook, bone and iron. It held, and that's all I asked of it. Still the best thing I've made.
The Redwright doesn't talk about his own work to strangers.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.artificer.the: Why won't you fit gear that hasn't answered?
Years back I fitted a set because someone promised me they'd wear it in. Lovely work. They never did, and the first time they took it into the dark, it didn't know them.
They came back without the set. So now I see the work worn in before I fit anything.
Keep trading with the Redwright and you might hear why he inspects so hard.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.cicatrix_anch: [The Vein-Mason turns one wrist to the light. The scars there run like a riverbed.] My own. I carved them badly first.
See the ridge, where it healed thick? The blood would not cross it. I cut the next one around it, and that one carried.
The Vein-Mason's own scars are not for strangers.
Why live out here, away from the outposts?
A current needs banks that stay put, and the outposts never do.
The Vein-Mason says little. A few more trades, and perhaps a little more.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_acroba: Off a barn roof, when I was small. Landed wrong, got up and went straight back up the ladder. Still doing that, really.
The Acrobat talks in falls. Trade a while and you'll hear the first one.
Do you ever go up without a net?
Once, because I didn't stop to think. I caught the rope about a hand's width off the ground.
I laughed for an hour after, and then I shook for two. Now the net goes up before I do, every single time.
There's a fall the Acrobat doesn't joke about.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_beast_: A one-eyed dog that wouldn't come to anybody. She came to me after a month of my sitting still. That's where the empty cage started.
The Beast Tamer talks about animals. Earn their trust and they'll talk about themselves.
Have you ever lost an animal to the show?
A peacock spider, a little thing no bigger than my thumbnail, and she danced better than any of us.
Too many eyes on her, too many nights in a row. She'd stopped lifting her flaps weeks before the end, and I kept putting her on.
There's an empty cage the Beast Tamer won't explain to strangers.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_fire_e: How did you learn to breathe fire?
Slowly. One second of flame and three of breath, over and over, for a whole winter, and by spring I had one good second.
The Fire Breather counts everything. Their own story too, if you count with them.
Have you ever been badly burned?
Once. Four seconds when I meant three. I count out loud now, so the crowd hears it.
One. Two. Three. Stop. I still say it under my breath whenever I hold a torch, lit or not.
The Fire Breather keeps one count to themselves.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_knife_: Nobody. I taught myself, badly, and the Strongman will tell you I still throw like a sailor. He's wrong. Sailors are better.
The Dagger Thrower will argue with anyone. Trade with them and they'll argue about themselves.
Once. Knives fly straight. It's always the people that bend, and that night I bent.
She forgave me years ago and I never have, and we still argue about which of us is right.
There's one throw the Dagger Thrower doesn't laugh about.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_ringma: Where did you get the hat?
Same way you'll get it, if you've the stomach. Learn every act. Hold every eye. Take it off a head that can't hold the ring.
The Ringmaster sells you a show. The man behind it costs more.
Do you think about the understudies on the carousel?
Every night, when the horses come round. I put them on there myself, and if I had it to do over I'd put them on again.
You're waiting for me to look sorry, and I won't, so stop waiting. Go and stand by the carousel for one full turn and count them yourself.
There's one subject the Ringmaster won't play to the crowd.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_stilt_: Could you have stopped the carousel?
I saw it start. I was up high, and I came down too slowly.
So now I watch the carousel, every turn of it, and I count the horses. I will not be slow a second time.
The Stilt Walker watches the carousel more closely than the crowd.
What do you see from up there?
The whole crowd. I look for the small ones first, because they are the easiest to lose among all those legs.
The Stilt Walker sees a great deal and says little of it.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_strong: Your turn. What's yours for? Think it over first, because I'd rather wait than hear a lie.
The Strongman has a question for you, when he trusts you.
How did you get so strong?
Carried my father's anvil round the yard every day till it felt light.
The Strongman doesn't talk to people he doesn't know.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_thread: One entry, in red, near the front. I wrote it the night I joined.
I put a little against it after every show. It has never come near balancing, and I keep paying.
There's one entry the Threadkeeper won't read aloud.
What do you keep in that ledger?
Who owes, who is owed, and who has stopped paying attention. The third column is the one I check twice.
The Threadkeeper keeps accounts. Yours is still short.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.circus_unders: Second gravedigger, three seasons running, and I never flubbed a line. The lead flubbed plenty, bless him, and I covered every one.
The Understudy remembers every name on every bill. Ask nicely, and often.
Do you remember the missing performers?
Every one of them: their names, their cues, and which side of the stage they'd wait on.
I say their names before each show, in the wings, where nobody hears. Somebody ought to give them their call.
The Understudy has a list of names they don't read to strangers.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_bellwar: Do you ever wish you could sleep too?
Every night. Someone must stay awake.
When the bell wakes one to keep it, I will sleep. One keeper awake is enough.
The Bellwarden has kept watch a long time.
Long enough, if nobody wastes. I count them each morning. I have never counted short.
The Bellwarden counts everything. Some counts are private.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_gardene: Which bed did you plant first?
That one by the steps, with the crooked edge. I was so proud I slept beside it. Have you eaten? Sit, I'll tell you the rest over a bowl.
The Gardener loves to talk about the beds, once you've shared the table a while.
Does it hurt when visitors leave?
Every time, love. We feed you, you get your color back, and then you're gone up the water.
I know you have to. I just set out one more bowl than we need for a while after. Habit.
Something about leaving sits heavy with the Gardener.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_host.ow: Do you have a room of your own here?
Why would I tell a guest that? Because you never asked my name, I suppose.
Yes. Behind the second screen. You won't see it. Do you mind that?
Even the Host keeps one door closed.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_host.th: Does it matter whose hand? Many. Mine, a little. I won't ask whose ink you'll bring, either.
The Host gives a room, not answers. Not yet.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_linesma: Someone who's let go since. That's allowed, you know. If you'd like, I'll show you the knot they used. It still holds.
The Linesman offers lines freely. The story of the first one, less so.
Have you ever let go of a line?
Once, when I was young and the pod was pulling somewhere I didn't want to go.
I came back on my own, later. They'd left my place open. If you ever let go, it'll be open for you too.
Bring line for the camp a while, if you want to hear what letting go is like.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_marrow_: Will you root here one day?
I've picked the spot. Near the third rib, where the plumes come up thick.
Don't look like that. It's a plan. I'll still be of use.
The Marrow-tender has already picked where to root.
How long have you worked the fall?
Since the ribs were still white. The hook's older than me. It belonged to someone who's rooted now, over there.
The Marrow-tender talks over the work. Bring the fall something and the talk goes further.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_nursery: Were you raised in these cups?
In the cup by the big boulder, they tell me, though I don't remember any of it.
Now I keep that cup clean for whichever young one comes next. Someone did the same for me, once.
Ask about the tender's own start, once trust has grown.
How many young are in the cups now?
More than last season, if you count the small one in the far cup. I count them every time the school comes around the loop. Will you help me count the far side?
The tender is busy. Help the nursery and there'll be time to talk.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_offerin: How long is the walk down to the vents?
Long enough to prepare on the way down. I carry the food, the heads take it, and I climb back up.
The Offering-bearer talks about the walk down only with people the Kindling know well.
Do you hope to be worthy one day?
Every bearer hopes to keep a head. A lifetime of preparation is what it asks.
I will not waste my lifetime. Do not waste yours.
The Offering-bearer keeps a hope that no visitor hears.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_tidewar: Have you lost anyone in the passages?
One. The swell took them. I was late.
Never late since. I test every way first now. I'll get you through. That's a promise.
The Tidewarden will say this once, and only to someone trusted.
Where did your sounding pole come from?
Last warden's. Found it in the passage. Kept it. That's a promise to them.
The Tidewarden keeps watch. Not stories. Not yet.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.guardian.the_: Where did you learn to fight?
On the line. Nowhere else. Strike to stop. Then stop.
The Guardian doesn't talk. Not to strangers.
Why do you hold the line?
Someone stood here for me once. Took a blow I'd earned.
Owe them. Can't pay them. Hold the line instead.
Trade with the Guardian long enough. They may say why they hold.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.hermit.the_he: Why did you give your heart away?
I was dying anyway. Left in my chest, it would have gone into the ground with me. Out on the Display it might wake somebody's blood, and I get to sit up and talk to visitors in the meantime.
It is there to be taken. I would not mind if someone took it soon. Some nights it is the only sound in the building, and I have grown tired of listening to it.
Share bread with the Hermit a while longer, and he may speak of the heart on the Display.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.hermit.the_vi: How long have you kept this vigil?

[He glances at the candle stubs lined up along the wall.] Long enough that the dust knows my shape. I stopped counting years a while ago. I count visitors instead, one candle each. There are not many candles.
The Hermit counts something under his breath when you bring bread.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.mnemonist.fir: What was the first memory you heard?

It was a faded memory on my first shelf. All it had left was how to wait, the way a heron waits at the edge of the water. I listened to it every night for a month, and by the end I could wait like that too.
Trade with the Mnemonist and they may tell you what they heard first.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.mnemonist.wha: My own voice, for a while. So many lessons were talking in me that none of the voices was mine. In the end I wrote myself up like any other memory, and filed it.
That file is on the lowest shelf, where I can reach it without getting up. I take it out more than I'd admit.
The Mnemonist keeps some files closed to strangers.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.monolith.the_: What does my blood tell you?
Blood does not lie about its weight. Yours is heavier than the last time. That is all it says, so far.
Tithe to the stone a while, and it may say what it reads in you.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.monolith.wher: §7[The stone is warmer where your blood went in. It stays warmer.]§r Nothing given here stays here.
It goes down. There is a great deal of down. Something there has been told your name.
Give the stone enough, and it may say where your blood goes.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.scout.anyone_: Is there anyone I should tell?
My sister. At the Church. She mends the robes.
Tell her I finished, stranger. Tell her it mattered. Not about the cold.
Some things she'd only say to someone she trusts.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.scout.why_sco: Why did you come down here alone?
I asked for it. Nobody else would. The Church needed eyes down here. I'm good at watching. Quiet, patient. That's all.
She's still writing. Bring her paper and she might talk.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.vicar.doubt: Do you ever doubt the Covenant?
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.vicar.doubt.l: Do you think a Vicar who never doubts has been paying attention? I doubt every night, and every morning the evidence is still on the desk where I left it, and I go back to work.
We have no warrant for certainty. What we have is the record, and on most days I find it is enough.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.vicar.doubt.t: Trust comes slowly with the Vicar, and his doubts come last of all.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.vicar.the_rec: Who kept the record before you?
Another Vicar, and one before them, back to Erythravane, who held the office first. Each of us copied the last one's hand until the ink stopped belonging to anyone in particular.
Some nights I read a page and cannot tell whether I wrote it, and I am less and less sure it matters which of us did.
Tithe to the Vicar a while, and he may tell you who kept the record before him.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.votary_wayfar: What don't you tell the captain-scholar?
That I'm scared, all the time. I write it down anyway, like 'Afraid. Water too still.' It helps, I think.
So please don't tell them, okay? They'd just say fear's an observation too, which, fine, it is.
Some of the Wayfarer's notes are about things they haven't told the captain-scholar.
What did you hope to see out here?
Honestly, I wanted to see a whale without a harpoon in it. The captain-scholar said that was a good enough reason. Was it, do you think?
The Wayfarer will tell you anything, once they know you.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.voyager.the_c: How long has the Cog been at sea?
Longer than the hull would like. We've replaced every plank at least once, so a sharper scholar would ask if it's still the same ship.
Trade with the Voyager and they'll tell you about the ship, eventually.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.voyager.the_w: Why don't you hunt the whales?
Because the first one I watched turned its eye on the boat and held it there long enough that I wrote three pages before I remembered to breathe.
Whatever you see the first time, write it down before you decide what it meant. And nobody aboard lifts a harpoon at one.
The Voyager has an opinion about whales they keep for colleagues.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.zealot.the_on: Have you lost anyone to the stain?
My brother. He told me it was only curiosity. I believed him for a year, which was a year too long.
So when I ask you why you're here, I'm not being cruel. I'm asking the question I never asked him.
Some answers the Zealot only gives to people who've earned them.
hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.zealot.why_ch: What brought you to the Church?
A fever that wouldn't break, and a woman who sat with me until it did. She asked me what I wanted to be cured of. Do you know what you'd answer? I didn't.
The Zealot asks the questions. Trade long enough and they might answer one.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.acc: All right. Say yes and my expertise goes into your pool. Every drop I put in has the Order's craft behind it, so spend it carefully.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.con: You want my blood pledged to yours? The Lodge does teach that shared knowledge flows best through shared veins, and I've never managed to test it properly.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.already_membe: This Harbinger has already pledged their blood to your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.expel.success: %s has been released from your bloodline covenant.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.acc: Call it covenant, then. One lesson, carried in more than one body.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.con: A bloodline is a kind of memory too, kept by several people at once. Bind me into yours and my blood joins its shared pool, 1,000 mL more for the line to draw on.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.no_bloodline: Found a bloodline with the Degree 5 Bloodline Founding rite before you try to recruit others.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may dismiss pledged members.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_member: This Harbinger is not bound to your bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.confir: You are accepted into the bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.pledge: Pledge your blood to my cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.releas: Our pact is ended. Withdraw from my bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.outpost_alrea: This outpost has already given your bloodline one voice. Leave the rest of us free to carry the cause outward.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.release.promp: Ending the pact takes me out of your bloodline. If that is what you have decided, say it plainly.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.success: %s has pledged their blood to your bloodline, adding their vitality to the shared pool. If they die, the pool loses it and their recruitment slot opens again.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.type_already_: A Harbinger of this calling has already pledged to your bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.accept: Very well. We give a covenant one voice from each outpost and no more, so that the cause spreads without the lodge emptying itself. Accept me, and I will be this outpost's voice in your line.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.conside: You would have me bind my blood to yours? At your Degree I owe you respect, and, I confess, obedience as well.
hemomancy.dialogue.reward_not_delivered: No reward was delivered. Check the requirements or reopen the conversation near the speaker.
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.go_in_pe: §7[You take the notes and step away.]
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.take_not: I'll take them. They'll be used.
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.what_did: What did you notice about them?
hemomancy.dialogue.ui.no_topics: No topics are available right now.
You're already carrying this observance, and your book shows what's left to do. Come back when you have the offering ready.
I'll enter this observance in your book, with its offering and its reward. Only take it if you mean to finish the work.
The work's done. Give me the offering and I'll mark the observance fulfilled.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.about_th: Have you heard of any path beyond the seven degrees?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.absorpti: How do I absorb enough blood?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.ask_abou: Teach me how to shape blood into things.
Who else keeps to the sea?
I want to ask about something I found.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.claim_fi: I have completed the first bloodcraft lessons.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.consecra: Who prepares the Armature for consecration?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.first_bl: What followed my First Bloodcraft assignment?
How do I finish my first bloodcraft lessons?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.fungal_s: Where should I survey the gardens?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.iron_blu: Give me the Hematic Iron blueprint.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.liber_bl: Give me the Liber Sanguinium blueprint.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.open_blo: Open my eyes to the blood-script.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.projecti: How do I condense a formation, and make Venous Stone?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.purifyin: I know what I am doing.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.report_v: I have a Voyager observation to report.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.rooted_v: How do I begin a Cardinal rite?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.seek_vei: Who teaches the old scarring rites?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.tell_me_: Tell me about the Sanguine Brotherhood.
Tell me about the Hematic Covenant.
Tell me about the Crimson Lodge.
Tell me about the Incarnadine Fane.
Tell me about the Founding Fane.
Tell me about the Hematic Order.
What do you know of the Saints?
Is there something the Order has never said aloud?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.voyager_: Can you give me a vessel bearing?
Where can I meet a Voyager?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_deg: What does the next degree require of me?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_do_: What do you make of what I have become?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_is_: What is the purpose of this Outpost?
hemomancy.dialogue.votary_wayfarer.optio: Are you afraid of the sea?
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.ask_ab: What are you studying out here?
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.court_: How would I find the Lighthouse Garden?
