hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.record: I noticed how the reef answered the current.
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.relay_: Could you draw me another Relay Chart?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_a: Tell me about the Altar of Cleansing.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_c: What is the Rite of Clarity?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.accept_: I wish to join your church.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.ask_abo: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.how_cra: How do I make hemolytic solution?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.not_int: I have no interest in your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.take_vo: I wish to take the vows.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.task_pa: I will bear a Pallid Icon.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.task_st: I will gather the Still Waters.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.tell_me: Tell me more about the Unstained path.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.vow_cle: I have completed the clean labor.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.vow_sti: I have gathered the Still Waters.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.reject_respons: Then walk your road. Every rite you perform drives the stain deeper. What do you think you're buying with it?
hemomancy.drudge.memory_unsupported: This memory cannot be installed in a Drudge.
hemomancy.guardian.ambient.line1: §7[The Guardian holds still and meets your eyes for a moment.]§r Stand your ground. Keep your hands clean.
hemomancy.guardian.item_hint: Pick it from your pack. I'll say if it belongs in the field.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.absoluti: Absolution Dagger. Issued to every pledged Unstained at Clarity Ascension. Last resort. Mercy. Self-defense.
Hemolytic treatment is built in. Don't waste a temporary coating on it.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.bow.line: Bow. Keeps the blood at a distance. Good for that alone.
Shoot what you have. Plain arrows do. Keep the quiver full.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.crossbow: Crossbow. Hits hard at distance. Slow reload. That's the price.
Pick your shot before the line closes.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.golden_a: Golden apple. Concentrated restorative. Not one of ours. It works. I've eaten one when the standard field medicine ran out.
Carry proper Unstained field medicine for wounds and blood exposure. The apple's for when you're badly hurt and out of options.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.hemolyti: Hemolytic plating. Four solutions, cured into one sheet. Disrupts blood-magic on contact. We line gear with it for afflicted ground.
Raw solution breaks down on cloth or plain metal. Plating holds the lytic compound for good. Unstained armor and shields need it.
Hemolytic solution. Breaks down blood-matrix corruption. Carry it for treatment and for the gear that takes it.
The Absolution Dagger doesn't need it. Its treatment is permanent.
Hemolytic vial. Solution in brittle glass. Throw it. It shatters and purges blood-taint.
Know what you're throwing at. Then spend the dose.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_che: Plain iron. Stops ordinary blows. Does nothing against infection.
Keep it maintained. Until proper Unstained armor is ready.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_swo: A blade works. Arm's length is dangerous near infectious blood.
Keep distance. Keep discipline. If the weapon takes a sanctioned treatment, apply it.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.lethean_: Lethean brew. Pale distillate, run through the Pallid Retort. Stronger than dew. The Altar of Cleansing takes it as an offering.
Careful with it. Dew takes your chosen manipulation. Brew takes every one you know. Don't spill it.
Lethean Dew. Bottled water in a Stillwater Condenser, Ghost Pipe nearby. Not gathered off a holy dawn.
Carry it sealed. First rule of field medicine. Don't contaminate the medicine.
Lethean Poppies. Said to bloom where Our Lady walked. Find them, and she's been there first.
Mark where they grow. The Zealots upstream need to know where clean ground is.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.liber_im: The Liber records the path. Every Guardian swears to understand it. Many of us walked it.
Read its First Steps. Then approach the Podium.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.minecraf: Serviceable. Keep it clean. Keep your reach. Open blood only with cause.
Against active infection, distance and restraint count. Not decoration.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_dis: Pale distillate. Lethean Dew and a Lethean Poppy. Or Ghost Pipe through the Pallid Retort. Goes into pale silver and brew.
You won't need it in a fight. Zealots ask for it. Carry it when they do. Otherwise leave it to the ritual work.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_sil: Pale Silver Bell. One chime. Silver Ward on you. Nearby hostiles weakened.
Ring it once, and mean it. Panic tells the line nothing.
Pale Silver. Consecrated Copper and pale distillate. No ore to mine. Iron won't stand in for it.
Guard it. Every ingot is somebody's finished ritual work.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pallid_i: Pallid Icon. Consecrated copy of the river relic. Not the original. We carry it as our emblem.
It calls up a brief apparition. Ask what you need. Then keep watch.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.shield.l: Shield. Stops force. Nothing special against blood.
Keep it between the wound and your face.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.silthmer: Silthmere Glaive. Sanctioned for the reach. The edge matters less. Keep infectious blood away from your hands.
Hold the line. Give the wound room.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.sporitic: Harbinger work. Fungal support smoke, paid for in blood.
Keep it off a clean line. The fumes serve the fungus. Not us.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unknown: Not my work. Ask someone else.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unstaine: Unstained armor. Fieldwear for anyone who stands close to active corruption.
Keep every seal sound. Color doesn't make gear clean. You do.
Unstained guardwork. Built for a clean defensive line.
Raise it early. Let it do its job.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.warhamme: Hammer. Hits hard. Keeps the wound closed. That's why we reach for it first.
Strike to stop. Save what you came to contain.
hemomancy.hematic_salvage.first_drop: The torn iron comes away red, as if it remembered a deeper ore.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.hint: The Rite of the Crimson Lodge is next. Before you try it, find the Vein-Mason. They will have you carve their pattern at the Cerebral Scarring Station and then teach you at their Brazier. You will find more room for manipulations in you now, too, and more of the skill tree open.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.line1: §7[The Hermit looks at you for a long moment, then nods, as if you have answered a question]
hemomancy.hermit.adept.line2: An Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood, and still talking sense. That is rarer than the Vicars let on. You will want a clear head for scarring.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_crafting: Take a knapper to the Cerebral Scarring Station and set a blank scar in front of you. Carve the pattern into it. Each scar wants materials of its own tendency, so bring the right ones. Then take the finished scar to the Vein-Mason. Their Brazier lesson is where it actually opens in you.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_intro: Scars, then. One does not look like much, a few marks cut into stone. Set one in yourself and it lays new veins and nerves through your mind along those marks.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_lore: The straight lines become veins and the curves become nerves. Your mind grows along them the way a wound knits along its stitches. Things you could never reach before come up through the new channels, ideas and tendencies both, and some of them stay.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.final_words: §oThe same as before. I sit across from the heart and I wait for whoever wants it. It is easier, knowing someone got as far as you did. §4Thank you for stopping.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line1: §4[For a while the Hermit says nothing. He presses both hands over the hollow in his chest and bows so low it is nearly a fall.]
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line2: §oNobody told us what to say to someone like you. Whatever the Hermits were taught stops at the seventh Degree. So I will just say I am glad you stopped here. §4Go well.
hemomancy.hermit.archon.line1: §4[The Hermit gets down onto one knee. It takes him a while]
hemomancy.hermit.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. I did not think one would ever stand in here. I have a long memory and a heart nobody has come for. Ask for the memory and it is yours.
hemomancy.hermit.archon_wisdom.prompt: Ask, Archon. I will tell you what I remember.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.hint: The Bloodline Covenant comes next. Raise a Fane of your own, or stand in your line's Fane and give your own blood to its Bloodwell. The Vicar can tell you the rest of it.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. Your blood is so loud in here that I can no longer hear my own heart on the stone. You know more of this than I ever did.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.hint: Go to the Mnemonist and learn the Somatic Loom. You weave memories of blood on it into new manipulations, and it is slow work. When you are ready, the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood will make you an Adept.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.line1: Louder than a Votary. An Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane, then. Has the Mnemonist sat you down at the Loom yet?
hemomancy.hermit.manip_lore: When I was young we called them tricks, and the Vicars hated it. You teach your blood a shape, over and over, until it holds the shape without you. Then set it at a Mnemonic Reliquary, or you will have nothing to cast.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.hint: Ask the Vicar for his four proofs if you have not heard them. Your ledger keeps the count. The one people get stuck on is the cauldron: project your blood into it and collect the Sanguine Formation that condenses there. Then go back to him.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.line1: §7[The Hermit tilts his head, listening to something you cannot hear]
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.line2: A Neophyte of the Crimson Veil. I can hear it from here, quick and uneven. Mine sounded the same before I cut it out.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line1: An old Harbinger who ran out of years. When I felt the end coming I walked out here, laid these stones one at a time and put my heart on the Display. Our old ones have done it that way for as long as anyone remembers. We guard the heart, and we point whoever takes it toward the Order.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line2: Nobody takes that heart without my blessing, and I give it to each person separately. Ask when you have decided. Once it is yours, §ocome back to me before you leave, and I will tell you where to go.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.heart_lore: Mine. I cut it out when I came here, and it has gone on beating on the Mortal Display ever since. Once I give you leave, touch it, and it will fasten itself to you as the Charm of Vascularium. Your blood wakes after that. Then go and find the Vicar. The charm still comes off, if you change your mind, right up until he initiates you.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line1: §7[A hooded man sits facing the Mortal Display, a hollow open in his chest. On the stone, something is beating. His crimson eyes move to you]
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line2: I am the Harbinger Hermit. I keep this temple, and I tell whoever finds it what that is on the stone.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line3: It is my heart, on §cthe Mortal Display§r, and while it beats there I cannot die. With my blessing you can take it, and your blood will wake. Initiation into the Order is a separate step, taken later with the Vicar, if you want it.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.hint: Only the Rite of the Hematic Order is left. An Archon comes out of it, and the old books say an Archon is the blood itself. I have never met anyone who called it easy, so prepare before you begin.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.line1: Sanctified. So the Bloodline Covenant took you. We were taught the next rite by name only, and I have little to add to the name.
hemomancy.hermit.temple_lore: My temple, such as it is. Every Hermit builds one, and I built mine slowly. The north wall still leans. The Focus in the floor watches the heart while I sleep, and nobody works rites on it. Initiation is the Vicar's business, if that is what you came for.
hemomancy.hermit.tendency_lore: Every manipulation pulls your blood one way, and many pull a little in a second direction underneath. Master them and your blood starts leaning that way by itself, and toward the tendencies that run beside it.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.farewell.li: §7[The Hermit's outline wavers. You can see the wall through him now, and red light is leaking out of his chest]
That was the last thing I had to do. I am glad somebody came while I could still talk. The Order can teach you the rest. §4Goodbye.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.guidance: Follow the waybill. It will take you to one of our outposts, and the Vicar there will want to see you. You have the blood now, whatever you decide. If you would rather not join, tell him so. He has heard it before.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line1: §7[The Hermit's hand goes to the hollow in his chest and stays there. He is smiling]
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line2: There. I felt it go. That is your pulse in the Charm of Vascularium now, yours and a little of mine.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line3: I do not have long, so let me tell you where to go while I still can.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.hint: The Alchemist teaches you now. Finish your first separation and your first ordinary Alembic distillation with them. After both, ask them for Concentrated Blood, inject it and sleep.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.line1: §7[The Hermit turns his head toward you before you have spoken]
hemomancy.hermit.votary.line2: A Votary of the Hematic Covenant, by the sound. Your pulse has stopped hurrying.
hemomancy.initiation.accept: I choose to remain. Initiate me.
hemomancy.initiation.ask: I wish to be formally introduced to the Harbingers.
hemomancy.initiation.awakened: The concentrated blood has settled into your circulation. You wake as an Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane.
hemomancy.initiation.blood_already_carri: You already carry a vial of Concentrated Blood. Inject it the way you would a blood shot.
hemomancy.initiation.blood_rest: Inject the Concentrated Blood the same way you would a blood shot, then let it settle. A night's rest will do more for it than standing here waiting.
hemomancy.initiation.bloodline: Your blood has settled into %s. You belong to this bloodline now.
hemomancy.initiation.cannot_attach: The heart cannot attach while your vascular scar is occupied or you already bear awakened blood.
hemomancy.initiation.offer: Before I receive you into the Order, look at the charm. It has not settled, so I can still take it off and send you on your way. After the reception it will be too late for that.
hemomancy.initiation.officiant_busy: %s is already receiving someone else. Wait for that initiation to finish, then ask again.
hemomancy.initiation.reason: I ask everyone. A Harbinger who never really wanted it is no use to us, and in my experience is often worse than one made by accident. If you would rather be free of it, tell me now.
hemomancy.initiation.released: The Vicar works the unsettled charm loose and draws it out. Its pulse stops in his hand. You are free.
hemomancy.initiation.remove: Remove the charm. I want to be free.
hemomancy.initiation.replace: Give me a vial of Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.initiation.welcome: You are a Neophyte of the Crimson Veil. Take this Sanguine Conduit. The Vicar has four first bloodcraft proofs for you, and your ledger will record them in whatever order you finish them.
hemomancy.item.sanguine_conduit.place_lo: Your blood has not yet earned the authority to claim this ground.
A pulsing instrument of the Order. You need higher initiation to learn its full use.
Drive it into the ground as an oath-post for your covenant.
Right-click a surface to plant. Breaking it recovers the conduit.

hemomancy.jei.craft.steps.self: Lay its floor and any structure it needs, seat the medium, light the braziers, plant the Living Staff and carry the rite to its ascension.
hemomancy.jei.craft.steps.working: Lay the floor, build the subject beside the Focus, seat the medium, light the braziers, then feed the subject.
hemomancy.jei.craft.steps.world: Lay its floor and any structure it needs, seat the medium, light the braziers, plant the Living Staff and hold the rite until the world answers.

hemomancy.jei.craft.tip.focus: Center of the floor; begin the rite here

hemomancy.jei.craft.tip.subject: Subject block; build beside the Focus, swallowed by the rite

hemomancy.jei.crucible.enzyme.tip: Feed aligned enzymes until the culture holds %s enzyme power.
hemomancy.jei.crucible.immature.tip: Grown in Phase I, then matured in Phase II

hemomancy.jei.distillation.catalyst.kept: Stays in the still; not consumed
hemomancy.jei.distillation.humor.cost.ti: Drained from the Retort's white humor tank.
hemomancy.jei.distillation.humor.yield.t: Fills the Retort's white humor tank instead of draining it.
hemomancy.jei.distillation.vessel.tip: The distillate is drawn into this vessel.
hemomancy.jei.enzyme_fruiting.blood.tip: Drawn from the Lantern over the whole fruiting.
hemomancy.jei.enzyme_fruiting.culture.ti: Stays in the Lantern; only blood is spent.

hemomancy.jei.incubator.time.tip: Gestation pauses whenever the incubator runs dry.
Rest the graft in an Iron Brazier

hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.fragments.t: Each enzyme is one engram fragment the weaver must thread home.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.0.des: Any Somatic Loom can weave this.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.1.des: Needs a Ganglionic Loom: a harness set at the Rite of the Ganglionic Weave.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.2.des: Needs a Cortical Loom: a crown set at the Rite of the Cortical Weave.

hemomancy.jei.white_humor_purification.h: Drop the item into White Humor; each source purifies up to 32 items.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.follow: §b§oPurity is the first descent. Below it the current runs on, into clarity. Clarity is a second gift, if you would have it.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line1: §b§oYou are clearer now, like water once the silt settles. The old stain fades faster than it grew.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line2: §b§oI have watched others come this far. Most falter here. With the blood quiet, its absence feels almost pleasant. A quiet pool can still hold a current.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line1: §b§oThe Harbingers will call you a traitor. Let them. You betrayed corruption. It was the first honest thing you have done.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line2: §b§oYour hands are almost clean. Finish the work.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is as cold as ever, but it no longer sounds far away. It could be standing at your shoulder.]
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal1: §b§oI was old when the first blood-temple was raised. I will be here when the last one crumbles. The blood-cult forgot to bury me.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal2: §b§oDo not try to understand me yet. Purify yourself completely. Then we will speak properly.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line1: §b§oYou are doing well, child. I feel the corruption thinning.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line2: §b§oThe blood lets go slowly. So does ice on a riverbank. But it lets go. Continue.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.reveal: §b§oI am what remains when a river has washed a stone clean. I have had many names. The Unstained call me Our Lady.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood seduces quietly. It feels harmless. Still water feels harmless too. Give it time and it drowns you.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line2: §b§oA clean body begins with clean intent. When you go without the blood, let it be your choice.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.follow: §b§oEvery Unstained before you asked why they were chosen. I did not choose you. You chose yourself when you turned from the red tide.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.line1: §b§o[A voice moves through the stillness without hurry, the way water finds its level.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.follow: §b§oLet the Verdigris Aura weaken the blood-touched. Clarity can cut as well as see.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line1: §b§oThere. You can see the shape beneath the surface now.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line2: §b§oClear sight will not make the world kinder. It lets you name its cruelty precisely.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v1.line1: §b§oYou have begun to sense blood-work in others. That will serve you. Few things are more dangerous than a hemomancer unaware of being watched.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line1: §b§o[Something settles over your shoulders like a cold, wet shawl, and it is oddly comforting.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line2: §b§oGo on as you have. Keep the rites. Keep the offerings at the Altar. The sight widens with each one.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.reveal: §b§oI am older than the hemomancy you left behind. I was here before the fungus came. I have watched ever since, without hurry.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.line2: §b§oAll of it, from the surface to the root. The blood-cult, and the fungus under it. And the world under both, still breathing.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth1: §b§oI am the stillness of an untouched lake. No one has stirred it in centuries. Life still comes from it, slowly. My voice is that water, finally clear.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth2: §b§oYou waded through blood and fungus to here. This is the far side of both. Stand on this shore and know it. Now you hear me as clearly as I speak.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line1: §b§oThe Harbingers will call it betrayal. The fungus will call it a loss. Both of them are right about that. Neither of them can unmake it.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line2: §b§oYou stepped outside the story written for you. Very few ever find the edge of it. I am glad, child, that you did. I have waited long to say so plainly.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.line1: §b§o[She does not move. Cold comes off her like the air over a winter lake, and she seems entirely satisfied. Her voice is as close as your own breath.]
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth1: §b§oYou have earned the last truth. I am not here to save you, and I never was. I could not do it if I tried. What lives in the fungus is larger than I am.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth2: §b§oI am here because this is where water rests after a flood. You came to me when you had finished drowning. Rest here, where my voice runs clear.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.line2: §b§oThe crimson tide is gone from you entirely. You stand on the far shore of the blood-sea.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite1: §b§oThere is a deeper sight, if you want it. The Unstained call it Clarity.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite2: §b§oYour purity is complete. First, Closed Vein. Let your body return to its mortal baseline. Only then prepare the pledge.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line1: §b§oYou are fully purified, child. I find that I am pleased. It has been a long while since I watched anyone finish this road.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line2: §b§oRest first. Then Closed Vein. Then Consecrated Copper, laid at the Podium. Come to Clarity Ascension as a pledge.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice has risen above a whisper. It seems to come from the walls, the floor and the air in your lungs, and it sounds like someone who has waited a very long time.]
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.rite1: §b§oFirst close the old current with Closed Vein. Then offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium. Then arrange the Rite of Clarity Ascension. It is the Church's pledge.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not lie to you. The final clarity changes things. Some who reached it called me something other than a patron.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow2: §b§oContinue anyway. I would rather you stand in cold truth than float in a warm lie.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line1: §b§oThree-quarters of this road is behind you. Most turn back here, and not because they falter.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line2: §b§oThey see the end of the path. It asks more than they hoped to give.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line1: §b§oYou have become very hard to deceive. The Harbingers would pay a great deal for that.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line2: §b§oThe blood-cult keeps away from clarity. Let its Neophytes see the Order as it is. The Order would not survive the sight.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is still and precise as a knife on glass.]
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal1: §b§oYou ask what I am. I will answer truthfully. The Unstained believe things about me that are not so.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal2: §b§oI am no goddess and no patron. I am the cold this world kept before the fungus came. The blood-cult would rather I stayed buried.
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.follow: §b§o[The sensation passes as quickly as it came. Only the cold remains, along with the faint smell of still water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.line1: §b§o[A chill settles over you, still as a frozen lake. Somewhere, very far away, you hear running water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v1.line1: §b§o[The air around you goes quiet, and for a moment the blood in your veins weighs less.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.follow: §b§o[The feeling draws back like a tide going out and leaves you unsure whether you were comforted or unsettled.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.line1: §b§o[Your skin prickles. Something is watching you the way deep water watches, without malice and without hurry.]
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow1: §b§oFight them or flee them. That choice is yours. I will not make it for you.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow2: §b§oThis much I will tell you. You are harder to hurt than you were. Silver Ward protects you. It also tells anyone watching that you have chosen a side.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line1: §b§oHalf of the clarity path lies behind you. You have begun to see through walls. Your eyes still stop at the stone. The rest of you does not.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line2: §b§oSooner or later the Harbingers will come to reclaim you. They always do. You will know them before they speak.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood-cult sees only the blood. It would have you believe the world is that simple. You have begun to see what the blood was meant to hide.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line2: §b§oBeneath the blood lies the fungus that feeds it. I think you have begun to suspect it.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.follow: §b§oClarity is a lens. You carry it and never set it down. Even at the path's end, you will see more through it.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.line1: §b§o[The cold presence feels almost warm now, the way the first autumn frost makes you glad the fire is lit inside.]

hemomancy.ledger.recall.no_lodge: Your bloodline has no Founding Fane. Complete the Rite of the Founding Fane to establish one.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.not_leader: Only the bloodline leader can move the recall point.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.out_of_range: Stand inside your Founding Fane to set the recall point.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.point_set: Founding Fane recall point moved to where you stand.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.success: The blood pulls you home to the Founding Fane.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.already_near: All recruited Harbingers are already nearby.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.no_bloodline: You have no bloodline. Found one by rite or join a covenant first.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.no_npcs: Your bloodline hasn't recruited any Harbingers yet.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.not_in_lodge: Stand inside your bloodline's Founding Fane to summon your recruits.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.searching: Calling your sworn recruits from their outposts. Stay inside the Fane.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.success: Summoned %s recruited Harbinger(s) to your side.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.unavailable: Some sworn recruits did not answer. Check their outposts or try again later.
hemomancy.lethean_tide.end: §b§lThe Lethean Tide sweeps the sky clean. The Blood Moon is gone.
hemomancy.living_staff.bond_unlocked: A Living Staff answers your blood.
hemomancy.loom.tier_required.1: This memory is too refined for this loom. It needs a Ganglionic Loom.
hemomancy.loom.tier_required.2: This memory is too refined for this loom. It needs a Cortical Loom.
hemomancy.machine_access.locked: Craft a %s yourself to use it.
hemomancy.machine_access.no_loot: The %s comes apart without yielding its workings.
hemomancy.manipulation.absolute_stillnes: Channels a freezing field that slows hostile projectiles, smothers fire and drives Rime into nearby enemies. Each pulse freezes the blood of enemies already at three Rime for further damage.
hemomancy.manipulation.activation_potent: Charges a radial electrical discharge. Charge strengthens damage; confirmed hits interrupt actions for 10 ticks without slowing movement. Water, iron and copper carry current.
hemomancy.manipulation.axonal_transducti: An enabled passive draws you into any touching Synaptic Node for 150 mL. Hold forward to travel toward your view along connected nerves; backward travels away. Release to stop and aim to choose a fork. Sneak to bypass entry or travel slowly. Another node releases you. No travel upkeep or duration limit.
hemomancy.manipulation.black_veil_covena: Raises a black veil of synthetic darkness for thirty seconds, Obscuring those caught inside as it falls. While you stand within your own veil you gain Resistance and fire protection at the cost of weakness. Cannot be recast while the veil stands.
hemomancy.manipulation.blackhearted.desc: While enabled with active blood and sufficient Mortem alignment, converts most Wither harm into recovery until necrotic saturation ruptures.
Readies the staff to draw blood from valid targets.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_aneurysm.de: Ruptures the nearest visible hostile vessel: a monster, a mob hunting you, or a player you may harm. Consumes Sanguine Pressure for up to 2 additional damage per level, scaled by charge. Fails without cost if no hostile is in reach.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_binding.des: Binds one target in place with living blood; it cannot step away while the binding holds.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_cloud.desc: Hurls a blood cloud that settles over the ground and wounds creatures beneath it. Its first touch on each creature builds Sanguine Pressure; later touches only wound.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_eclipse.des: Obscures enemy perception beyond four blocks. Close defense remains possible; Illumination pierces school concealment.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_lattice.des: Spreads an aimed binding lattice through a packed group of nearby creatures.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_needle.desc: Hardens blood into iron barbs and looses them in a rapid volley.
Scatters a broad fan of blood needles across a wider area.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_needle_lanc: Fully charge to forge the volley into three barbed iron needles that pierce several bodies and briefly pin what they strike.
Readies the staff to feed blood into structures and machines.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_rush.desc: Floods your body with quickening blood for eight seconds, increasing speed and attack speed and healing half a health point each second.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_shot.desc: Fires a condensed blood projectile at the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.bloom_of_rot.desc: Erupts Putriciel's bloom through every body you may harm within eight blocks, dealing 3 damage and Necrosis. It also poisons you.
hemomancy.manipulation.canopy_mortis.des: Carries Lignum Mortis between trees through touching leaves without harvesting leaves. Release or complete the selection to harvest.
hemomancy.manipulation.carrion_communion: Drains up to four blood-bearing enemies afflicted by Necrosis, Wither, Poison, Blood Loss, Insatiable Hunger or Grave Debt while channeled, restoring half the health actually drained.
hemomancy.manipulation.cauterizing_rebuk: Burns Poison, Wither, Necrosis and Blood Loss out of your body at one health apiece, then flares at enemies within four blocks with fire damage and Searing, without setting them alight.
hemomancy.manipulation.chain_blood_bindi: Chains a shorter binding from the first victim into nearby creatures.
hemomancy.manipulation.conductive_mark.d: Marks a preferred discharge target for twelve seconds. Later allied Ductilis, Lux or Ferric hits arc into nearby enemies. The mark itself does not electrify terrain.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_axe.desc: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Axe.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_blade.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Blade.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_claws.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into living claws.
Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Crossbow.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_flail.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Flail.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_sickle.de: Calls Vesper's disciplined refusal into the shape of a Living Sickle.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_spear.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Spear.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_staff.des: Conjures a Living Staff into your hand.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_torch.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Torch.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_coronatio: Prepares up to eight retaliatory blood lances for twenty seconds. Full charge strengthens their damage and lets each pierce an additional target. Cannot be recast while the crown still holds lances.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_flame_con: Places crimson flame where the blood points.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_tithe.des: Borrows 500 blood into the shared reserve for thirty seconds. Spent reserve incurs double blood repayment and six health damage; unused blood is reclaimed.
hemomancy.manipulation.cruor_javelin.des: Hurls a shaft of frozen cruor at the creature you aim at, dealing freeze damage and driving two Rime levels into it, or three if it is wet from water or rain.
hemomancy.manipulation.cryogenic_pulse.d: Releases a cold pulse that deals freeze damage to nearby enemies and builds Rime in their blood.
hemomancy.manipulation.deadly_gaze.desc: Lifts what you look at; a full charge interrupts and slams the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.eclipse_well.desc: Creates a charged well of darkness that pulls enemies inward, keeps them Obscured and bites the Obscured each second. A fully charged well collapses as it ends, flinging non-boss enemies at its heart elsewhere, as a chorus fruit would.
hemomancy.manipulation.endless_hour.desc: Defers lethal damage at one health point for ten seconds. The unpaid damage returns as one hit when the hour ends or you leave the world. Armor, effects and absorption do not soften it, but a Totem of Undying or Phoenix Debt can still answer it.
hemomancy.manipulation.expansive_blood_c: Hurls a larger blood cloud, four blocks in radius, that briefly blankets a wider area.
hemomancy.manipulation.expulsive_updraft: Launches you only a little way but bursts outward, scorching nearby enemies with fire and Searing and throwing them aside. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.exsanguinate.desc: Executes a visible, badly wounded blood-bearing enemy and restores 250 blood only on a kill. Bosses cannot be executed outright: the drain against them is capped at twelve health points, scaled by Crimson Mastery.
hemomancy.manipulation.ferric_rampart.de: Raises a rigid five-block-wide, three-block-high iron wall for ten seconds. Blocks bodies; your own and your allies' projectiles pass through, while all others are destroyed. Requires clear, supported ground. Magnetism family level 1.
hemomancy.manipulation.ferric_spikes.des: Raises five blood-iron blades for six seconds. Obstructs movement and deals 3.5 Ferric damage on contact, scaled by Crimson Mastery and applying Lodestone, at most once every ten ticks per enemy. Requires supported ground. Magnetism family level 2.
hemomancy.manipulation.fruiting_contagio: Every nearby enemy already carrying Necrosis is wracked and withered, and its rot spreads Necrosis to other enemies close by. Fails if no rot has taken root.
hemomancy.manipulation.funeral_bell.desc: Releases a charged deathly pulse, consuming Necrosis to release its stored damage early. Wither, Poison, Blood Loss, Insatiable Hunger and Grave Debt each deepen the toll; all but Grave Debt are spent. Everything scales with charge: a partial toll releases only that share of the stored Necrosis, and the rest still releases when Necrosis ends.
hemomancy.manipulation.furnace_veins.des: Channels a close heat field that burns enemies, thaws allies, and grants allies fire resistance.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_grasp.des: Freezes source water along an aimed path and adds two Rime levels to targets wet from water or rain. Dry targets in the path take light freeze damage and one Rime level. Rime slows movement, not attacks or casting.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_rampart.d: Raises an aimed ice wall for twelve seconds, or a surrounding ice shell while crouching.
Rakes the creature before you with a short slash of shadow and leaves it bleeding. It bites deeper while you are unseen or standing in darkness; Illumination strips that edge.
hemomancy.manipulation.grave_debt.desc: Marks a target with a debt that bursts at low health and refunds blood if death claims it.
hemomancy.manipulation.guided_blood_shot: Steers a blood shot toward the creature nearest your aim.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_beacon.de: Creates an aimed rally zone that mends allies a little and steadies them with brief Resistance each second, while Illuminating any creature or player inside that you may harm.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_flare.des: Strikes the creature you aim at with a short Lux ray and Illuminates it, exposing concealment and preparing Lux follow-ups. Fails without a visible target.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_impressme: Interrupts one blood-bearing creature and leashes its nerves to yours, impressing it into defending you and your allies for a time.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_mortar.de: Fully charge to lob one heavy blood shot in an arc before it bursts across a small area.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_rebuke.de: Jolts a command down a blood-bearing creature's nerves: it stops what it was doing, drops its target and flees for eight seconds.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_riposte.d: A clawed blood-arm erupts from your back and slaps across your front. Hits from ahead within the swing are turned aside: melee attackers are stunned, projectiles are swatted away, and a successful parry cuts the cooldown short.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemolymphal_pulse: Sends a sensory impulse through nearby blood-bearing bodies you could harm, revealing them and marking wounded targets. You, your allies and your pets are not revealed. Does not electrify terrain.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemorrhage.desc: Inflicts twelve seconds of Blood Loss on the nearest visible enemy and seeds Necrosis in the wound for Mortem follow-ups.
hemomancy.manipulation.insatiable_hunger: Bites a target for 2 damage that seeds Necrosis, then curses its recovery, reducing healing and turning food into gnawing hunger.
hemomancy.manipulation.iron_choir.desc: Channels Resistance and three projectile interceptions per paid pulse. Iron plates intercept hostile shots and strike back at their owners, and each pulse looses a blood needle at the nearest visible hostile within ten blocks.
hemomancy.manipulation.iron_retort.desc: Raises a brief iron guard that cuts incoming melee damage and lashes back at the attacker.
hemomancy.manipulation.ironhearted.desc: Fully charge to store up to two Iron Hearts (4 health) for ten minutes. Stored hearts take damage first; active Thorn, Anvil, and Crucible scars expand capacity.
hemomancy.manipulation.lignum_mortis.des: Threads blood through connected wood and fungus. Release to harvest marked blocks; a completed selection automatically harvests and ends the channel.
hemomancy.manipulation.lingering_blood_b: Forms a longer-lived binding around one creature.
hemomancy.manipulation.living_circuit.de: Links up to three nearby teammates with traveling nerve impulses, granting speed and haste and arming their next hostile strike with Conductive Mark. Each pulse arcs from every linked body to the nearest visible hostile within four blocks. With no teammate in reach, the circuit runs through you.
hemomancy.manipulation.lodestone_collaps: Charge to magnetize a point ahead. Every enemy in reach with a clear line to the point is dragged into it and crushed; walls shield. Lodestone and deep Rime in their blood collapse for extra damage, and a full charge pins them.
hemomancy.manipulation.lumen_suture.desc: Sutures the nearest wounded ally with light: heals one heart, grants brief absorption, and clears Blindness, Wither, Necrosis and Obscured. Falls back to yourself.
hemomancy.manipulation.osseous_bloom.des: Crystallizes the blood of every enemy within six blocks, dealing a quarter of its current health as freeze damage and building Rime. Best as an opener, not a finisher. Boss damage is capped at twelve health points. Fails without cost if no enemy is in reach.
hemomancy.manipulation.penumbral_drift.d: Channels a swift Veil that repeatedly sheds ordinary enemy attention. Bosses retain their target. Attacking ends the drift, but that first blow, melee or otherwise, lands as an ambush for half again its damage and leaves the victim Obscured.
hemomancy.manipulation.phoenix_debt.desc: When enabled with active blood and sufficient Flammeus alignment, arms a shared Last Rite and pays blood to survive lethal harm and erupt in cleansing flame. It shows ready, and fires, only while you hold enough blood for its price.
hemomancy.manipulation.prismatic_reproof: Projects a cone of Lux for 4 damage, or 8 against a previously Illuminated target. Consumes Illumination without reapplying it.
hemomancy.manipulation.pursuing_blood_cl: Creates a compact blood cloud that slowly follows nearby enemies.
hemomancy.manipulation.pyretic_forge.des: Smelts held items with fevered blood.
hemomancy.manipulation.radiant_wake.desc: While held, radiance holds you aloft: falling turns into a glide along your gaze. Each pulse mends you and nearby allies, bites enemies already Illuminated, and leaves nearby enemies Illuminated.
hemomancy.manipulation.rimebound_sentenc: Deals charged frost damage, up to 12 at full charge. Full charge establishes three Rime levels and temporarily encloses the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_halo.des: Suspends five blood shots around you to seek nearby hostiles one at a time. Passive animals, pets and villagers are ignored.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_ignition: Scorches every body within five blocks with superheated blood and sets it alight for two seconds. Wet, rimed, fire-immune or fire-resistant bodies are not set alight.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_magnetis: Raises an anchored iron pillar for six seconds, pulling enemies inward and pinning nearby bodies. When it falls, it slams every enemy it pulled within three blocks for 4 Ferric damage, or 6 if Lodestoned. Ductilis can energize the pillar to relay shocks into nearby enemies.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_marionet: Channel a mobile blood tether for up to 8 seconds. Aim at an enemy to attack or reachable ground to move. One blood-bearing mob, at most 80 maximum health; 8-block acquisition and 16-block tether. A Blood-Bound creature is released from its binding and taken. Hematic Rebuke family level 2. Base cost: 50 mL per second.
Cheaply repairs the damaged gear held in your hand.
Seeds a broad, stationary storm cloud whose blood lightning strikes the nearest creature beneath it each second, without igniting the world.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_ward.des: Channels a reactive electrical sheath. Incoming damage consumes its protection pool and jolts any direct attacker; later paid pulses slowly replenish it. A ward recast within five seconds of lapsing resumes its depleted pool; after longer it starts fresh.
Superheats the air beneath your feet, launching you upward and scorching nearby foes. Needs footing: ground, water or a ladder.
hemomancy.manipulation.searing_lash.desc: Cracks a whip of boiling blood against the creature you aim at, scalding and igniting it and laying a long Searing that primes Vitric Combustion for its full detonation bonus.
hemomancy.manipulation.soaring_updraft.d: Launches you faster and higher, carrying some of your forward momentum. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.sovereign_instinc: When enabled and struck while at least four blood-bearing enemies target you, turns commandable attackers (80 maximum health or less) on one another for five seconds. Bosses only feel its pressure; larger bodies are unaffected. Requires active blood and Ductilis alignment.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar.des: Manifests the Blood Avatar around your own body while you sustain it, turning aside a quarter of incoming harm. The void, /kill and starvation pass through it.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_arm: Manifests an armored torso with greater protection and the avatar's striking arms.
Manifests the avatar's arms, strengthening your blows while it shelters you.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_com: Manifests the complete Blood Avatar at its greatest protection, strength, and speed.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_leg: Manifests the avatar through its legs, increasing movement and step height.
hemomancy.manipulation.suspended_updraft: Launches you into a brief levitating pause before slow falling takes hold. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.synaptic_jolt.des: Shocks a nearby target and interrupts actions for 10 ticks without slowing movement. Can energize water, iron, copper or an owned Ferric construct.
hemomancy.manipulation.synaptic_storm.de: Chains charged electricity between up to eight enemies, prioritizing conductive targets. Paralysis lasts 10-60 ticks; players are capped at 20 ticks and bosses are slowed. Ordinary hops reach five blocks, conductive hops eight.
hemomancy.manipulation.thread_ripper.des: Fully charge to cut an aimed tether: frees a Circus captive, unravels a weakened hostile puppet, or wounds and silences a healthier one. It also unravels a Vex, or a summoned or bound creature owned by someone you may harm, at any health; an unraveled Drudge drops its Blood Memory. Tamed animals, mounts and bosses are spared.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_rend.desc: Tears open every Obscured enemy before you at once. The shadow already clinging to them is spent for extra damage and leaves them bleeding. Fails if nothing ahead is Obscured.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_reversal.d: Reverses backward into a nearby dark space and Obscures enemies left behind.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_step.desc: Steps to a safe, supported shadow beside or above the targeted block.
hemomancy.manipulation.unclosing_eye.des: Persistently strips nearby concealment with Seraphae's unforgiving sight.
Scans nearby ore veins and reports their count plus the nearest ore and its coordinates.
hemomancy.manipulation.vital_effusion.de: Spends blood to stir living growth in nearby plants.
hemomancy.manipulation.vitric_combustion: Detonates superheated blood. Consumes remaining Searing heat for up to 4 additional damage.
hemomancy.manipulation.void_shroud.desc: Veils you in shadow for five seconds with speed and night vision. Attacking breaks the Veil, and Illumination exposes it.
hemomancy.manipulation.white_verdict.des: Fires a piercing beam whose reach, width and damage grow with charge, up to 12 damage. Deals 50% more against a previously Illuminated or concealed target, never twice. Consumes existing Illumination.
hemomancy.manipulation.worked_lignum.des: Extends Lignum Mortis into tagged worked materials such as wooden planks. Release or complete the selection to harvest.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.awakened: Vesper's memory settles into your Living Staff bond.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.rite_guidance: Place this in an Iron Brazier, then channel Blood Absorption through a Living Staff.
hemomancy.milestone.adept_ascension.desc: Ascend to Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. The blood has taken root.
hemomancy.milestone.altar_blessing.desc: Receive the one-time blessing of Our Lady at an Altar of Cleansing
hemomancy.milestone.apotheos_ascension.d: Ascend to Apotheos of the Hematic Order. The final hush opens.
hemomancy.milestone.archon_ascension.des: Ascend to Archon of the Hematic Order
hemomancy.milestone.first_manipulation.d: Use a blood manipulation for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.first_morphling_bond: Equip a morphling companion for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.first_rite.desc: Complete a cardinal rite for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.illuminatus_ascensio: Ascend to Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge
hemomancy.milestone.initiate_ascension.d: Ascend to Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane
hemomancy.milestone.our_lady_of_still_wa: Obtain the Icon of Our Lady
hemomancy.milestone.sanctified_ascension: Ascend to Sanctified of the Bloodline Covenant. The network grows.
Accept formal initiation from the Vicar
hemomancy.milestone.votary_ascension.des: Ascend to Votary of the Hematic Covenant
hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.li: I can tell you what the instruction means, and which tendency leads it. The tissue that must carry it is the Anchorite's business.
Match an active cerebral scar to the Noetic Memory's primary tendency. Then change the arrangement, and show that the new route still carries the instruction.
hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.pr: The Anchorite sent you because the memory and the scar have to agree. Hear me out, then go back and prove both routes.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.famil: You have found the Chamber on your own already. Come with me once, awake, and look at whatever you missed in the dream.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.first: You may not remember being there. I can take you to the Chamber long enough to look around with your eyes open.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.rules: The glimpse lasts two minutes. You can tend the Arbor and move the temporary item copies around, but you can't drop items, build or begin an ordeal. Your original inventory and equipment come back exactly as they were. Coming home finishes the lesson. It won't attune you to the later rite.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.start: The Mnemonist leads you into the Chamber.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.unava: The guided visit cannot begin yet. Finish any item transfer. Then return with active blood, and no other visit or projection underway.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line1: That is your Chamber of Will. In the first Degrees, ordinary sleep may give you a minute or two there.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line2: While you are there you can walk about and tend the Arbor. Whatever you move or leave behind stays in the Chamber after you wake.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line3: At the third Degree, build a Somnolent Seat. Then you can visit on purpose and stay longer, and the Chamber keeps anything you build there.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.rite: At the sixth Degree you attune yourself through the Rite of the Chamber of Will. Early dreams, guided glimpses and Seat visits never give you that right for good, however many you take. You can work the rite without me there.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.seat.control: Outside the Chamber, sneak-use your Somnolent Seat to go straight in, or sleep in it through a normal rest and enter on waking. To start home, use the paired Seat beside your Arbor and no other.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.seat.duratio: An un-attuned Seat gives five minutes at the third Degree, ten at the fourth and twenty from the fifth on. The return is timed, whether you went straight in or slept first.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.support: Longer visits give you time to get real work done. If a Mnemonist serves your bloodline, they can help you prepare for them and make sense of what you find. You don't need one for the Seat or the later rite.
hemomancy.mnemonist.circus.discovered.li: So you have found the pavilion. You saw for yourself that the acts are the practice, all of it, out in front of everybody.
Next time, watch who starts an act and who answers it. Their manifestations take shape in the back-and-forth.
There is a company of Harbingers who work through performance. They call themselves the Circus, and under their pavilion every body practices something different.
Don't take the show for an invitation. Between them the whole troupe can make one intention real, and that is where the danger is.
hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line1: There's almost nothing left in you to hear. It's a bright quiet, and it hurts.
hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line2: Ask if you need to. I kept your entries, and the path you left is still on file. I will not hand its living lessons back to you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line1: A crude memory is an early echo, rough at the edges. Use one and pay its blood cost, and the manipulation goes in with the other lessons you know.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line2: If you have an empty active slot, the new lesson files itself there. If every slot is full, it waits in your library until you learn to do the arranging yourself.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line1: The Dendritic Distributor saves named arrangements of the Noetic and Thelemic memories you know, though it can't teach you a new one. Blood Absorption and Blood Projection are fixed, so they stay out of custom patterns.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line2: Saving or overwriting a pattern costs 100 mL of blood and 25 raw XP, and renaming or applying one is free. You get three pattern slots until Synaptic Memory adds more.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line3: When you apply a pattern it checks your current capacity and the memories you know, then replaces your active arrangement. Any running Thelemic memory the pattern leaves out gets switched off.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line4: You make one as a Working on a greater Working floor. Frame Infested Venous Stone with four Iron Bars and hold a Sanguine Formation. Offer a Tendon Line and a Ferric Binder, and feed it 500 mL of blood.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_hint: Show me what you're carrying and I'll sort it for you. Some of it will have a memory in it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.crude_m: Blood Rush. I hear somebody running from something in it, and the panic is what makes it fast.
An early lesson in movement, and it costs more blood than it feels like it should. Watch your reserve while you run.
Blood Shot. You squeeze and let go, and a line of blood flies out of you. Lessons don't come much simpler.
It won't take before your initiation. Afterwards, an empty active slot picks it up by itself.
Deadly Gaze sends your intent out through the eyes before your hand has moved. An ugly little lesson, and a useful one.
A crude lesson can still do harm. Be careful what you teach your blood to hate.
Glacial Grasp, a Congeatio lesson. It slows the world long enough to look at a mistake properly.
It's cold to hold, and it means you no harm. Use the stillness it buys to get yourself out of trouble.
Hematic Flare stretches your blood thin and white with Lux, and whatever was hiding from you stands lit.
It shows everything while it lasts, you included, so don't light it if you'd rather not be seen.
Hemorrhage, under Mortem. A small opening, then it keeps insisting, which is how most endings I've heard began.
Use it with restraint. Once your blood picks up a cruel habit, I can't file it away for you.
Sanguine Ignition, filed under Flammeus. Listen to it and you hear a fever in the moment before it catches.
It's an eager lesson, and it will make you feel more skilled than you are.
Sanguine Mending repairs you. It's a Ferric memory, and like most of them it takes its payment before it mends anything.
The wound closes, and your reserve pays for it.
When you cast Void Shroud the dark comes in close around you, and you breathe quietly under it. I keep it with the Tenebris lessons.
It hides you from enemies. Don't stay under it so long that you lose track of yourself.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.enthral: Enthralling Filament is a restraint fiber. Peacock Spiders, surface Hemojellies and Blood Drunk Puppeteers supply it. The Somatic Loom weaves it into memory, and the Spindle stores its tension for a Crossbar.
Hold on to it. You may study the fiber at the second Degree. Your first true string waits until I've taught you how a memory is prepared.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.hematic: A blank Hematic Memory. Hold it to your ear and you'll hear nothing, which is right for a blank.
The Loom can weave a lesson of your choosing into it, once your Degree and your materials are both ready.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.living_: This is a limb-pattern, a shape for the staff to grow. The staff still answers only through the manipulations you know.
Do the matching deed, then craft the graft and burn it in the Brazier while your staff drinks the memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.memory_: Axonal Transduction comes from the Naeglerophaeon's ganglion. It's a memory of going into the signal itself. At the sixth Degree, absorb it in the Iron Brazier, then recall and enable it with your usual manipulation controls. It requires sixty-five Ductilis alignment.

Touch a Synaptic Node and your body goes into the nerves joined to it. Forward carries you on, backward retraces the run, and you take a branch by looking into it. Another node reforms you. Sneak to pass a node untouched, or to slow your signal. Each entry costs 150 mL, and staying in the network costs nothing.
Black Veil Covenant raises a chapel of dark blood and branching veins around you, Tenebris you can actually see for once.
Inside its sphere the shadow is real enough to trip over, so walk carefully.
Blackhearted teaches your heart to feed on the death that was meant for it. It's one of the stranger Mortem lessons I keep.
There's a limit to it. Once the vessel saturates, the debt breaks inward and the lesson goes quiet.
Blood Binding is simple restraint. It treats another body as so much blood that has been taught to stay put.
The tendrils start at your feet, so keep your footing. They hold the target just as still.
This Blood Rush has been refined. It has fewer burrs than the crude shard and spends its lesson more cleanly.
Keep the crude one on file anyway. It's what taught your body how to begin.
A refined Blood Shot. It throws the same first line of force as the scraped shard, with the rough edges taken off.
Full memories keep their rank gates, so the crystal may be ready before you are.
Cauterizing Rebuke is Flammeus used as medicine, if you can stand the smell of burning.
It burns venom and rot out of the caster. Then nearby enemies get the same treatment.
Conductive Mark leaves a patient sign, bright enough for allied blood-work to find.
Ductilis, Lux and Ferric blows can catch the mark and leap from it into nearby enemies.
Cruor Javelin carries its own Congeatio cold along with it, and throws it.
Whatever it strikes stiffens, which leaves it easy work for iron.
This Deadly Gaze was shaped on purpose. The crude one was scraped out of somebody's old panic.
Refining steadies a memory. This one is steadier now and every bit as ugly.
Ferric Rampart gathers your blood into overlapping iron plates.
Learn its memory after the first level of Sanguine Magnetism. The wall needs firm ground under it, and room to stand up in.
Ferric Spikes. Cast it and rusted blades come up out of a line of blood.
The second level of Sanguine Magnetism steadies their shape. Ductilis can carry a current through the summoned iron.
Fruiting Contagion takes rot that has already taken hold and makes it bear fruit.
Something has to be dying already. All it does is hurry the rot along.
A full memory crystal, made on purpose. It's stable enough for proper loadout work.
Carry one because you mean to use it. Refined memories hold their shape longer than crude shards.
Glacial Rampart takes Congeatio cold and stands it upright on a spine of blood. It sounds like frost settling.
It puts a wall between you and harm, though not for long, so use the time it buys you.
Gloam Laceration is a Tenebris knife, the kind you keep somewhere dark.
It bites deepest from a shroud or true darkness. What it opens keeps bleeding after.
Grave Debt is Mortem bookkeeping. It writes a ledger against somebody's living balance.
When the vessel runs low, it bursts. If it dies while it still owes, death may return a measure of blood to the creditor.
Cast Hematic Beacon and you carry a signal fire under your skin.
Allies inside it hold steadier, and every enemy inside it stands lit for the covenant to name.
The full Hematic Flare. This Lux strikes first, without waiting for anything to show itself.
It brands hidden things and burns whatever it catches, so being hidden ends up hurting them.
Hematic Impressment writes borrowed loyalty straight into someone else's pulse.
Only one vessel at a time can bear your command, and stronger blood sheds it sooner.
Hematic Rebuke sends a command down another body's nerves, and that body feels fear before anyone has drawn a blade.
It cannot command bloodless bodies, or greater wills.
Hematic Riposte raises a limb your body never grew, and it answers faster than the hand you own.
It guards only what you face, and only for a heartbeat. Mistime it and the blood is spent on air.
Insatiable Hunger, from the Mortem shelf. It turns appetite against the very thing that ought to remedy it.
Healing thins out under it, and food only makes the ache worse.
Iron Retort folds Ferric patience up and saves it for one answer.
The guard takes the first bite and dulls it. Then it answers through the attacker's own opening.
Ironhearted has your Ferric blood build a second pulse and shut it in an iron cage.
Hold the memory steady until the metal closes. The borrowed heart is spent before yours.
Lodestone Collapse makes a point ahead of you into the lodestone and calls every enemy near it home.
They come in together and are crushed together, unless a wall shields them. Any iron already in them is spent on the blow.
Lumen Suture. Lux can light a room, or it can set a needle of light exactly where you need one.
A pale thread closes the pain, and blindness is cut out of the wound as it goes.
Prismatic Reproof judges a threat and splits it into every color it tried to hide.
It hits harder on prey already exposed by Illumination. The judgment uses up that light.
Radiant Wake is Lux stretched thin enough to bear your weight. It won't lift you, and it won't let you fall either.
Whoever stands near you stays mended, and everything hostile stays exposed. Up there, the price is that everybody can see you.
Sanguine Magnetism is a Ferric lesson. When I play it back I hear iron sliding toward one spot.
A pillar rises, and hostile bodies are dragged in close enough to hold still.
With Scalding Updraft your blood holds a gust of hot air from under your own feet until you need it.
It throws you farther than your legs can, but it needs footing to push from, so cast it standing on something.
Searing Lash runs Flammeus heat along something you can swing, which is how heat travels best.
What it strikes is marked for a greater burning, so only lash something you are willing to finish.
Most Ductilis lessons move a body. Synaptic Jolt stops a nerve, which turns out to be just as easy.
It's a short bolt that interrupts and staggers the struck vessel, and for a moment it can't answer cleanly.
Umbral Rend closes a hand on what the dark is already holding. Tenebris has to lay the dark on first.
If there's no shadow on them yet, there's nothing to tear, and you'll have to wait.
Umbral Reversal lets you step back out of a chase and into the dark, once the chase has grown too certain.
It needs darkness to land you in, or a Veil willing to pretend the world has no light. Whoever stood close is left obscured.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.minecra: Ordinary pages. Every archive starts with them. A mundane store of knowledge, and still useful.
Bring me enough of them and I can index blood-memory properly. Without paper I'm guessing.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.mnemoni: This blueprint is blank, waiting for a spatial memory. Manipulation lessons won't go on it.
Someone pressed a rite into this page: its distances, its order, how the parts relate. It's a good map. The rite's authority stays with the rite, so the page won't let you skip any of it.
A blood structure, fixed into something you can carry. It will guide your hand while you build, and you will still have to understand what you are building.
A Mnemonic Reliquary. You arrange your Thelemic and Noetic Memories in it, within one active loadout.
With it you choose which of the lessons you know sit nearest the surface. Anything new still comes from a memory item first.
You can't build a Reliquary until the third Degree. Until then, let your first bodily lessons settle into whatever slots are open.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.naegler: It still conducts, I can hear it from here. Once the Loom wears the Cortical crown, set this beside a blank Hematic Memory in the Somatic Loom. Prepare four Neurotic enzymes and project 600 mL of blood. The weave yields Axonal Transduction, a memory of the sixth Degree.

Lay Nerve Fibers or Bundles in one unbroken run, with Synaptic Nodes at the entrances and exits. Cut the run anywhere and the signal stops. Leave room beside each node for the body to reform. If you still carry a dormant Synaptic Step, you can dismantle it to get this organ back.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.orb_of_: A fixed eye for a room built out of memory. Every sky it shows comes from a place its owner actually reached.
Throw it off the Chamber floor and the fall changes the remembered perspective. Afterwards the Orb returns to whoever owns the cell.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.salt_st: The salt has got into this. Hold it still while I read. Current marks, specimen counts, and a prayer someone said before the descent.
The last line asks the reader to use what they learned, if they fail to surface. 'That is what remains of us.'
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.scar_pa: Nothing is written on this motif yet. The Effigy hasn't persuaded any blood to leave a route on it.

This motif carries several routes you already know. Put it in an empty Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, then hold Blood Absorption on the offering. The commit costs 50 mL and replaces your active cerebral loadout.
One scar route, written out in full. You carve from it at the Cerebral Scarring Station.
A scar pattern schema. It's instruction written for flesh, with the tendency and the threshold marked on it.
A pattern has no power of its own. It hands the blood a grammar. Whether the blood can speak the sentence is up to the blood.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.somatic: That's a Somatic Loom. Tendency inputs, blood and a pattern go in, and a blood memory comes out, woven on purpose.
The crude shards you've used so far were echoes you happened across. At the Loom you get to say what you want made.
The Somatic Loom won't open to you before the third Degree, so scraped echoes will have to carry you a little longer.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.unknown: I can't hear a lesson in that, unless it's smart enough to keep quiet.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.claime: The crown went to you already, and a loom can only wear so much mind. The folding for a second one is in what I taught you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.prompt: Ask me for the crown when you want it. It lets the loom think the whole memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.ready: That memory stood taller for you than it does for most people. The Rite of the Cortical Weave wants the crown and five more offerings. Then the loom sees the whole of what it recalls.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.requir: You need to have woven a Magister's memory on a Ganglionic Loom yourself. Then at the sixth Degree, with your blood awake, the crown lets the loom carry a Perfectus memory at full stature. You needn't have taken my harness for it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.title: The Cortical Crown
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.clai: The harness is on your record already. Once a loom has learned to feel it keeps the knack. Should you need another, bind the nerve the way I showed you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.prom: I have the harness that lets the loom hear its own engram. Say the word.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.read: You threaded a memory home and it held. Here is the harness. Set it with five more offerings at the Rite of the Ganglionic Weave.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.requ: Weave one memory home at a Somatic Loom first, with every fragment threaded, and keep your blood awake. At the fifth Degree I'll give you a harness of nerve, and with it the loom can hold memories a Magister made.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line1: This is the Somatic Loom. Here you stop scraping shards out of old places and start weaving memories on purpose.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line2: Pay its blood and an engram opens around the Loom, an eight-pointed star with the memory's fragments waiting at its points. Each fragment is a piece of something an earlier Harbinger knew. Use your staff to thread every one home along the star's lines, and never let two colors cross.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line3: Some fragments are false, because failures get kept as carefully as lessons. Rest your eyes on a fragment and it shows you its memory. A false one shows you somebody else's, and its beat is out of step with the loom.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line1: Hematic Memory is instruction kept in blood, the kind a person can repeat. I have never found a whole life on my shelves.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line2: Some lessons you understand as a pattern and project through a manipulation. Others are prepared in the body, and the body acts them out when its vessels answer.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_practice.line: Pick the exact Loom recipe before you pay any blood. The blank vessel and the catalyst decide what the weave becomes. The enzymes you have stored won't choose it for you.
The Reliquary arranges the Noetic and Thelemic memories you know inside one active capacity. Swap the active set as often as you like and you lose nothing you have learned.
hemomancy.mnemonist.mnemonic_doctrine.li: Mneme keeps. Nous knows. Thelēma acts.
In plainer words: memory keeps the trace, the intellect sees the pattern in it, and the will acts it out. Noetic and Thelemic practice are two ways of working the same substrate.
They're working labels. We would drop them tomorrow if they stopped predicting things correctly.
hemomancy.mnemonist.morphling_puppet_int: The organism you've taken in feels projected will as a foreign tension. It worries at that tension like something to eat.
The puppet's imposed will pushes back. Its repeated intent scatters the organism's attention, and its feeding rhythm falters. I can hear them both stumble.
You may keep both, and I won't tell you otherwise. Each one simply works less efficiently while the other pulls at it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line1: There you are. I can hear a few crude echoes in you already. So you're a Neophyte now.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line2: The crude memories left in old places still work. Use one and pay attention to what it does to you. When you reach the second Degree, come and tell me, and I will let you choose one on purpose.
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line1: §7[The Mnemonist takes their fingers off their wrist and folds their hands in their lap.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line2: I can hear you working the lessons loose. Ask me what you like and I'll answer, but I won't press another memory into a wound you're trying to clean.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line1: The Mnemonic Reliquary holds lessons you have already lived through. Treat it like a shelf you keep tidy. You still learn each lesson from its memory first.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line2: It sorts your Noetic and Thelemic Memories into one active loadout, which decides what sits near the surface. Everything else stays in you, further down the library.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.eightfol: At the fifth Degree, the Rite of the Eightfold Script rules its lines in red, as old scribes marked a line to find again. Then one inscription can be singled out and raised above the rest.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.material: It's a Working, made on a greater Working floor. Build the station around an Enchanting Table with Sanguine Glass and Hematic Iron Blocks, and hold a Ferric Binder. Offer an Enzyme Primer, a Blood Crystal Shard and a Lapis Block, then feed it 500 mL of blood.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.palimpse: I gave you the burin once, and I don't hand out the same edge twice. Shape the next one yourself.
The burin that writes over what was written is on my desk. It's yours if you want it.
You picked out a line and it stayed picked. Take the burin and five more offerings to the Rite of the Palimpsest, and cut that line in deeper.

Learn ordinary inscription first, then single out an inscription at an Eightfold Scriptorium yourself. At the seventh Degree, with your blood still awake, the burin can cut into the line the quill marked. You don't need to have taken my quill.
At the seventh Degree, the Rite of the Palimpsest scrapes the page back to whatever is still remembered underneath. Then the chosen inscription can be cut in deeper than ink would ever go.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.role: The Loom weaves memories for you to learn from. The Scriptorium inscribes equipment, and it is an optional workshop. The Woven Vessel doesn't need it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.rubricat: That quill went to you already. If you lose it, cut another the way you learned.
When you want the quill that marks one line in red, ask me for it.
You've written at a Scriptorium, and I have a note of it. Take this quill to the Rite of the Eightfold Script with five more offerings.
At the fifth Degree I'll lend you the quill the old rubricators used, once you've written something at a Scriptorium. Keep your blood awake until then.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line1: Your active mnemonic slots hold the Noetic and Thelemic lessons you keep near the surface, where you can reach them in a hurry. You know more than will fit in them.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line2: At first a crude lesson may drop into an empty slot on its own. Later the Reliquary lets you choose which lessons sleep close to the pulse.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line1: I can put one crude memory in your hand for the field, and only one, so choose with some care. Whatever you have already learned stays with you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line2: Choose by instinct: reach, motion, or gaze.
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A robed Harbinger presses two fingers to their own wrist, listening to a pulse you cannot hear.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line2: You aren't initiated, so there's nothing in your blood for me to hear yet. Come back after your initiation, and I will teach you to listen without drowning in it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.votary.line1: A Votary now, so I owe you a crude memory. Pick one for reach, motion or gaze and take it into the field. The Reliquary comes later, for arranging what you know.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line1: Your crude lessons have started talking over one another. Scraped shards won't teach you much more.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line2: From here you weave the lesson you want on the Loom, thread by thread. The finished crystal teaches it to you by itself.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven_vessel.archive: Bring me the blank vessel with a book, ink and paper, and I will start an index entry for its first lesson. You still do the weaving yourself, at the Loom.
Make one blank Hematic Memory from four Sanguine Formations, four Blood Stained Stones, and one Neurotic Enzyme.

Find Blood Stained Stone in a Hermitage Remnant, or make each one from Venous Stone, a Sanguine Formation and redstone. Four crafted stones bring the blank to eight formations in all. Chicken blood can yield Neurotic Enzyme, though some spins yield Vivacious instead.
hemomancy.monolith.archon.press_again: §7[The stone is fever-hot now. Holding your palm against it hurts.]§r Press once more and this stone breaks open. Is that what you came for?
The cube separates from the Lodestone without breaking it. For a moment the hollow it leaves gives off a low, warm hum.
The rack has been taught to hold blood. The Vicar taught it ceremony. No one has taught it silence.
Take this small weight from me. Offer it at a lit brazier in the Rite of the Monolithic Armature. Then the consecrated frame will remember armor no voice should wear.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.bind_throne: Bind a Covenant Throne to your Fane, and sit in it. I want the covenant to have a seat.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.chamber_retur: Your own rite opens the Chamber of Will. Use a Grand Threshold floor, with an echo shard in the brazier. Go in. Come back out. A guided visit does not count.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.complete_vigi: Summon a recruited Vicar to the Fane with your ancestral ledger. Give them a rite station for the Covenant Vigil. Keep them there to the end. An interrupted vigil earns nothing.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.found_bloodli: The stone reads no line in you. Perform the Rite of Bloodline Founding at Lesser Communion. Blaze powder goes in the brazier. The rite founds the line. An unsigned ledger founds nothing.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.found_fane: The line is founded. The ground is not. Perform the Rite of the Founding Fane at Grand Dominion. Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus. A Nautilus Shell in the brazier. Bind a Bloodwell and Stakes. If the line already has a Fane, stand inside it. Project into its Bloodwell yourself.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.past_the_seed: You have already carried a Seed out of a stone like me. I set no more conditions. Press further if you want another. It will not change what you are.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.perform_blood: Line and Fane stand. One condition remains. Perform the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant, and the sixth Degree opens.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.perform_hemat: You came back. You sat. You kept the Vigil. I felt each of them. Perform the Rite of the Hematic Order.
hemomancy.monolith.counsel.press_further: I have no more conditions to set. Press further and I open. The Qliphoth Seed is inside me. It is not handed over. You will take it yourself.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line1: I have been waiting for you. Someone like you would not do. It had to be §oyou§r.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line2: §7[The stone is hot under your palm. Deep inside it, something shifts its weight in a space too small for it. You hear it more than feel it.]
§7[The stone is faintly warm where you touch it. That is new.]

Illuminatus. The Lodge's gates stand open, and the Vicar no longer walks ahead of you. The stone will counsel you from here. Under your feet the mycelial network whispers of dormant power. The stone believes you are beginning to hear it.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.sanctified.l: §7[Under your palm the stone is warm and gives a little, like skin over muscle.]

Sanctified of the Covenant. The Loom taught you to make memory on purpose. Now I would have you enter the inward room. Your own rite opens the Chamber of Will. There, memory, scar and will become architecture.
hemomancy.monolith.item_hint: Bring it close. The stone weighs what you carry, and says little.
