hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.fragment: This is still warm with the pressure it remembers. It is quiet. Memory moves through it all the same.
Use it carefully. Alone, it teaches nothing. It only resonates.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.minecraf: Yes. The old world kept such things. This one still resonates with thresholds, anchors and return paths.
A familiar relic can still serve an uncommon rite. Treat it as unknown until you learn its place.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.qliphoth: Qliphoth reagents open a path where doctrine thins. Once you stand on it, they draw you forward.
Proceed if you intend to finish the conversation.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.rite_sit: This belongs to the high covenant sequence: foundation, offering, witness, consequence.
You are no longer assembling tools. You are assembling conditions.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.saint.li: Saint matter and Saint echoes suit the oldest rites. They have already outlasted one fall.
What you carry proves continuity, not victory.
I know your weight. It has changed since you first stood here.
I keep every change. What I keep, it reads.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.ripening.line1: §7[The stone is hot now, and damp, and it leans toward your hand.]§r You know the word. You have felt it under the skin.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.ripening.line2: The Degrees were a calendar. I only kept the count. Did no one tell you?
hemomancy.monolith.lore.the_others.line1: Some climbed past me. Some stopped here and stayed stopped.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.the_others.line2: I kept the weight of each one. The weight does not say where they went.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.what_it_measures: It reads what the work leaves in the blood. The Lodge called that a record.
The record is accurate. The Lodge never asked who reads it.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.what_opens.line1: I stop being a stone. What I hold stops being held.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.what_opens.line2: You will walk to it and take it yourself. You may turn back. Will you?
hemomancy.monolith.lore.what_remains.lin: A husk, split and quiet. It will keep the shape of the door.
It will know your blood. Feed it, and it will look again.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.where_found.line: §7[The stone gives under your palm, warm as a forearm.]§r Deep, under old rock. A red vein in the Second Age.
They cut it free and closed me around it. They kept careful notes. They did not keep it asleep.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.who_stood_here.l: §7[The warmth under your hand does not change.]§r Those who came this far. The stone keeps their weight, not their faces.
Few came back a second time. Each one stood where you stand.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.why_now.line1: The Vicar has stepped back. No one stands above you at the outpost now.
hemomancy.monolith.lore.why_now.line2: The stone takes that place. It has waited for this Degree.
hemomancy.monolith.unworthy: The monolith is silent. The stone stays cold and hard under your hand. You have not yet proven yourself worthy.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.archon: You are close enough now that I can speak plainly. What is inside me knows what is inside you. We are the same thing. Do you feel it ripening?
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.illumina: A lodestone of the Order, built by the Crimson Lodge in the Second Age. The Lodge believed it was built to measure. It does measure. It remembers every Harbinger who has stood before it. Every degree. Every name. It also watches what it measures.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.sanctifi: I contain something. I always have. The Lodge sealed it in this stone in the Second Age. They called its attention measurement.
hemomancy.mortal_display.charm_equipped: A living adornment latches around your neck. It marks you for the Harbinger's path.
hemomancy.occulus.task.adept: Master advanced blood manipulations, then perform the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood.
hemomancy.occulus.task.archon: Perform the Rite of the Hematic Order to become an Archon, the highest Degree the blood-tide grants.
hemomancy.occulus.task.illuminatus: Perform the Rite of the Crimson Lodge to rise to Illuminatus. It demands more devotion and a firmer command of blood.
hemomancy.occulus.task.initiate: Complete the Alchemist's First Separation and an Alembic distillation, then inject Concentrated Blood and sleep.
hemomancy.occulus.task.neophyte: Meet the Vicar and ask for formal initiation into the Harbingers.
hemomancy.occulus.task.sanctified: Perform the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant to rise to Sanctified.
hemomancy.occulus.task.votary: Complete the Vicar's first bloodcraft lessons and return for Degree 2.
hemomancy.organ.heart.description: The seat of circulation and will
hemomancy.organ.kidneys.description: Filters impurities and maintains humoral balance
hemomancy.organ.liver.description: Metabolizes toxins and purifies the blood
hemomancy.organ.lungs.description: Oxygenates blood and sustains vital rhythm
hemomancy.rite.ancestral_communion.desc: The highest rite of revelation. The caster opens a channel to the fungal consciousness and receives cryptic lore about where hemomancy came from.
hemomancy.rite.ancestral_communion.name: Rite of Ancestral Communion
hemomancy.rite.antiseptic_ground.desc: Lays virid salis and cleansed stone as a warded floor. Blood cannot be gathered on it, and hostile bodies that cross it are seared.
hemomancy.rite.antiseptic_ground.name: Rite of Antiseptic Ground
hemomancy.rite.apotheos_rite.desc: One of the eighth Degree's two ends. The practitioner crosses beyond Archon after completing Qliphoth Communion, accepting the final hush behind the Order's mask.
hemomancy.rite.apotheos_rite.name: Rite of Apotheos
hemomancy.rite.archon_rite.desc: The seventh rite of the Hematic Order, crowning the practitioner as Archon and preparing the way for a degree beyond.
hemomancy.rite.archon_rite.name: Rite of the Hematic Order
hemomancy.rite.armature_consecration.des: Consecrate the Hematic Armature with the Armature Consecration Kit and close its two blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.ashen_vessel_rite.desc: The vessel passes through fire and ash and comes out black and hard. The ashen gourd holds more blood than any gourd before it.
hemomancy.rite.ashen_vessel_rite.name: Rite of the Ashen Vessel
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_founding.desc: A lesser rite that binds the caster's essence into a new bloodline, producing a presigned ancestral ledger that others may use to join.
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_founding.name: Rite of Bloodline Founding
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_recall.desc: A penitent rite that reconjures a lost ancestral ledger from the caster's blood memory.
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_recall.name: Rite of Bloodline Recall
hemomancy.rite.bloom_of_qliphoth.desc: A dark rite that grows a blooming Qliphoth tree, its roots drawing on the blood in the earth. A Qliphoth Seed must be seated in the Cardinal Focus as its medium. In the tree's shadow, all blood manipulations are empowered and the body heals itself.
hemomancy.rite.bloom_of_qliphoth.name: Bloom of the Qliphoth
hemomancy.rite.chamber_of_will.desc: A grand inward rite for the Sanctified. The caster folds blood-memory around a fixed point of will and enters a private chamber that grows along with their scars, infection and ascension.
hemomancy.rite.chamber_of_will.name: Rite of the Chamber of Will
hemomancy.rite.clarity_ascension.desc: The second phase of the Unstained path, for a Purified supplicant. Surrounded by silver and crystal, the supplicant's mind opens to clarity.
hemomancy.rite.clarity_ascension.name: Rite of Clarity Ascension
hemomancy.rite.closed_vein.desc: Teaches the purified vessel to close around old wounds. Blood loss is prevented, hostile bodies are slowed, and the first Still Arts take a deeper hold.
hemomancy.rite.closed_vein.name: Rite of the Closed Vein
hemomancy.rite.cortical_weave.desc: Crown the Somatic Loom with a fold of cortex so it can see a Perfectus memory whole.
hemomancy.rite.cortical_weave.name: Rite of the Cortical Weave
hemomancy.rite.covenant_vigil.desc: A bloodline vigil in which one sworn helper shares the boundary and survives a full Grand ordeal beside the caster. Every assigned survivor gains ten minutes of resistance and regeneration.
hemomancy.rite.covenant_vigil.name: Rite of the Covenant Vigil
hemomancy.rite.crimson_beacon.desc: A binding rite that anchors the caster to this location. When the caster takes a fatal blow, their body is returned here before death claims them.
hemomancy.rite.crimson_beacon.name: Rite of the Crimson Beacon
hemomancy.rite.crimson_vessel_rite.desc: The pallid vessel is steeped in scarlet until its walls drink in blood and flush crimson.
hemomancy.rite.crimson_vessel_rite.name: Rite of the Crimson Vessel
hemomancy.rite.druse_crystallization.des: Line a Latticed Condenser in blood crystal through three circuits, so what it sets can no longer slump away.
hemomancy.rite.eightfold_script.desc: Rule the Scriptorium's lines in red so one inscription may be singled out from the rest.
hemomancy.rite.eightfold_script.name: Rite of the Eightfold Script
hemomancy.rite.enduring_pattern.desc: Bind the Resonant Forge's reader, hammer, and wax stabilizer into one lasting cadence.
hemomancy.rite.enduring_pattern.name: Rite of the Enduring Pattern
hemomancy.rite.eternal_covenant.desc: Permanently raises the caster's maximum blood volume. It can be performed only once.
hemomancy.rite.eternal_covenant.name: Rite of the Eternal Covenant
hemomancy.rite.exsanguination.desc: A sacrifice rite. A named creature held inside the circle bleeds into the anchors; once it has given 200 mL the daemon can be sealed, and its lifeblood crystallizes into Sanguine Quintessence.
hemomancy.rite.exsanguination.name: Rite of Exsanguination
hemomancy.rite.first_clotting.desc: Seat a Sanguine Cauldron behind the Focus and close its two blood circuits so the lattice can take hold.
hemomancy.rite.first_clotting.name: Rite of the First Clotting
hemomancy.rite.first_condensation.desc: Seat a Ghastly Alembic behind the Focus and close its two blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.first_condensation.name: Rite of the First Condensation
hemomancy.rite.founding_fane.desc: A grand consecration open only to the Illuminatus. The caster seats a Sanguine Quintessence in the Cardinal Focus as the medium, and the rite establishes a Harbinger Founding Fane with its boundary, its recall anchor and its bloodline-tied ground.
hemomancy.rite.founding_fane.name: Rite of the Founding Fane
hemomancy.rite.ganglionic_weave.desc: Bind a harness of nerve into the Somatic Loom so it can feel its own threads and hold a Magister's memory.
hemomancy.rite.ganglionic_weave.name: Rite of the Ganglionic Weave
hemomancy.rite.glass_lungs.desc: White glass, pale water and copper steady the breath. The rite rinses poison and wither from the chest, so the supplicant can breathe where corruption would choke them.
hemomancy.rite.glass_lungs.name: Rite of Glass Lungs
hemomancy.rite.guide.consecration: The sores hunger. Project blood into them.
hemomancy.rite.guide.inscription: The circle is fed. Trace its sigils, then seal it at the Focus.
hemomancy.rite.guide.offering_procession: The floor draws your offerings in.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.2: The second ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.3: The third ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.4: The fourth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.5: The fifth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.6: The sixth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.7: The seventh ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.8: The eighth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.station_projection: Feed the station's circuits through the Focus.
hemomancy.rite.guide.subject_feeding: Project blood into the structure beside the Focus. The Working floor climbs it as it fills.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_fortification.des: Permanently reduces vascular and manipulation strain by 15%.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_succession.desc: Place the effigy beside the Focus on a Venous Stone plinth. Seat Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus. In braziers anywhere above the floor, read clockwise round the Focus from its left, nearest and lowest first, offer the donated professional vial, your own identity-bearing vial, then Mnemonic Ambergris. A free compatible workplace is required inside your fane. The body forms over sixty seconds.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_succession.name: Rite of Hematic Succession
hemomancy.rite.hematic_unbinding.desc: A severance rite that dissolves the caster's bloodline, freeing all members and returning any shared blood deposits. The covenant is broken.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_unbinding.name: Rite of Hematic Unbinding
The last vessel, past flesh and gourd. The curved horn is shaped from gilded venous stone and old blood, and it holds more of its bearer's blood than any vessel before it.
hemomancy.rite.hungering_earth.desc: A corruption rite that feeds the caster's blood into the earth, converting the surrounding terrain into blood-touched stone and befouling ash.
hemomancy.rite.hungering_earth.name: Rite of the Hungering Earth
hemomancy.rite.illuminatus_rite.desc: The fifth rite of the Hematic Order, by which an adept is admitted as Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. This is a rite of ascension, not the consecration of a Fane.
hemomancy.rite.illuminatus_rite.name: Rite of the Crimson Lodge
hemomancy.rite.initiate_rite.blob_grante: A sanguine orb coalesces in your hand, bound to your command.
hemomancy.rite.initiate_rite.desc: A Neophyte's first threshold working: a floor and a brazier proved at the Cardinal Focus. It opens the Order's beliefs in the Liber and leaves a sanguine blob to study; the Degrees come from the Alchemist's lessons, not from here.
hemomancy.rite.initiate_rite.name: Rite of the First Threshold
hemomancy.rite.lethe_covenant.desc: The strongest Unstained consecration: it claims the surrounding land for Lethe. For 30 minutes within 5 chunks, mob spawns are halved, Silver Ward fully shields against all blood-magic bleeding, and Unstained practitioners passively gain purity each minute. It directly counters the Rite of Sanguine Dominion.
hemomancy.rite.lethe_covenant.name: Rite of the Lethe Covenant
hemomancy.rite.lethean_baptism.desc: The first rite of the Unstained path. The supplicant kneels before cleansed stone and lethean flowers, renouncing the blood and beginning the long walk toward purification.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_baptism.name: Rite of Lethean Baptism
hemomancy.rite.lethean_font.desc: The highest rite of the Unstained path. The Enlightened supplicant opens the source of Lethe's purifying waters. Everyone bearing clarity within 50 blocks receives a surge of clarity and an hour-long blessing of silver and verdigris. For one hour, a domain of stillness spreads 8 chunks in every direction, the inverse of Sanguine Dominion.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_font.name: Rite of the Lethean Font
hemomancy.rite.lethean_judgment.desc: The most violent Unstained rite. It projects Lethe's will outward as a cleansing: every blood-active practitioner in range feels their veins seize and their manipulations scatter. Performing it declares war on hemomancy.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_judgment.name: Rite of Lethean Judgment
hemomancy.rite.lethean_tide.desc: An Unstained greater rite. It calls up the purifying waters of Lethe to end a Blood Moon, clearing the sky and granting the caster a surge of purity. Requires at least 50 purity.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_tide.name: Rite of the Lethean Tide
hemomancy.rite.mnemonic_restoration.desc: Place the effigy beside the Focus on a Venous Stone plinth. Seat Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus. In braziers anywhere above the floor, read clockwise round the Focus from its left, nearest and lowest first, offer a Bound Mnemonic Remnant, then your own identity-bearing blood vial. A free compatible workplace is required inside your fane. The body forms over sixty seconds.
hemomancy.rite.mnemonic_restoration.name: Rite of Mnemonic Restoration
hemomancy.rite.monolithic_armature.desc: Set the Monolithic Cornerstone into a consecrated Armature and bind three blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.monolithic_armature.name: Rite of the Monolithic Armature
hemomancy.rite.moon_washed_copper.desc: Oxidized copper is washed in moon-cold clarity until its verdigris forms a halo that can diagnose. The highest Still Arts open to the supplicant.
hemomancy.rite.moon_washed_copper.name: Rite of Moon-Washed Copper
hemomancy.rite.pale_consecration.desc: The supplicant lays a grid of cleansed stone, pale silver and suspended crystals and calls Lethe's judgment down on the ground. For 10 minutes, hostile creatures that enter the consecrated area are seared and slowed.
hemomancy.rite.pale_consecration.name: Rite of Pale Consecration
hemomancy.rite.pale_vigil.desc: Performed by those halfway into clarity, the Pale Vigil calls on Our Lady's watch. Every Unstained soul within 40 blocks draws clarity from the light, and their Silver Ward and Verdigris Aura are strengthened for thirty minutes.
hemomancy.rite.pale_vigil.name: Rite of the Pale Vigil
hemomancy.rite.palimpsest.desc: Scrape the Scriptorium's vellum back to memory and cut the chosen inscription deeper than ink can hold.
hemomancy.rite.palimpsest.name: Rite of the Palimpsest
hemomancy.rite.pallid_shadow.desc: A rite that fouls the still waters and strips Unstained purification from a nearby player. Those who follow Our Lady count it an unforgivable act of hematic aggression.
hemomancy.rite.pallid_shadow.name: Rite of the Pallid Shadow
hemomancy.rite.pallid_vessel_rite.desc: The dried gourd is consecrated within a ring of venous stone and ash, its hollow interior awakening to hold the lifeblood of its creator.
hemomancy.rite.pallid_vessel_rite.name: Rite of the Pallid Vessel
hemomancy.rite.possession_rite.desc: A Silentium forces their will onto a piece of the organism. Seat a Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus of a Qliphoth floor and drag a surrogate (a bat, enderman, blaze, iron golem, horse, donkey, wolf, spider or armor stand) onto it. Hold it there with your own Blood Binding: cast on the floor, the binding lasts until the floor breaks or the rite ends. It is stilled, and the will walks the Gardens in its facsimile while an echo waits here. The braziers need hold nothing. Whatever they do hold of Mnemonic Ambergris, a Hematic Iron Block, a Totem of Undying or Adipocere burns to steady the visit.
hemomancy.rite.possession_rite.name: Rite of Possession
hemomancy.rite.problem.allies: The rite needs %s attendants; %s stand ready.
hemomancy.rite.problem.anchor_damaged: A broken sore must be refilled.
hemomancy.rite.problem.finale_held: The rite waits. Resolve what it lacks, or recall it with Blood Absorption.
hemomancy.rite.problem.medium: The Focus holds the wrong medium.
hemomancy.rite.problem.ring_hungers: The woken ring hungers: %s sores still empty.
hemomancy.rite.problem.sacrifice: The circle wants %s mL more from a named creature.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_cinder_be: Weather the breathing cycle and bind its shape to an attuned Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_gorebound: Bind the defeated Gorebound Hulk shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_marrow_sp: Bind the defeated Marrow Juggler shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_mnemonist: Bind the defeated Mnemonist Puppet shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_sanguine_: Survive the hound's rupture and bind its pursuit shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_scarlet_m: Hold the Scarlet Mummer's attention and bind the defeated shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_veinwing_: Bind the defeated Veinwing Vulture shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.rooted_vein.desc: A blood-fed stone is rooted into the earth, growing a permanent Earthen Vein where the Cardinal Focus stood.
hemomancy.rite.rooted_vein.name: Rite of the Rooted Vein
hemomancy.rite.sanctified_rite.desc: The sixth rite of the Hematic Order, consecrating the practitioner fully to the Bloodline Covenant.
hemomancy.rite.sanctified_rite.name: Rite of the Bloodline Covenant
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_athanor.desc: Raise a vented heating mantle beneath a Hematic Condenser, leaving room for its wider base and raised assembly.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_athanor.name: Rite of the Sanguine Athanor
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_attunement.desc: A cleansing rite that purges and resets the caster's blood tendency alignments, allowing them to realign their kinship from a blank slate.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_attunement.name: Rite of Sanguine Attunement
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_brotherhood.desc: The fourth rite of the Hematic Order, proving mastery of the foundational blood arts.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_brotherhood.name: Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_dominion.desc: An imperial rite that claims the surrounding land as a Blood Domain. Within its bounds, the caster's manipulations cost less blood, enemies suffer a slow bleeding curse, and blood-touched blocks are empowered.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_dominion.name: Rite of Sanguine Dominion
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_eclipse.desc: A forbidden rite that forces a Blood Moon to rise. It empowers all Harbingers and weakens the uninitiated.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_eclipse.name: Rite of the Sanguine Eclipse
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_fervor.desc: A hunting rite that soaks the earth with vital blood-heat and draws creatures out of the dark. For a short time, mobs spawn at greatly increased rates within a 3-chunk radius.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_fervor.name: Rite of Sanguine Fervor
hemomancy.rite.scarlet_summons.desc: A commanding rite that draws upon the shared bloodline pool to teleport all online bloodline members to the rite location. The cost scales with the number of members summoned.
hemomancy.rite.scarlet_summons.name: Rite of the Scarlet Summons
hemomancy.rite.second_fraction.desc: Seat a calibrated Vial Centrifuge behind the Focus and close three circuits for a second fraction.
hemomancy.rite.second_fraction.name: Rite of the Second Fraction
hemomancy.rite.severed_covenant.desc: An exceptional founder's renunciation learned from the collapse of an unleashed infection. It disbands the founder's bloodline and cuts its integration from their infection.
hemomancy.rite.severed_covenant.name: Rite of the Severed Covenant
hemomancy.rite.silthmeres_remembrance.de: Invokes Silthmere, the name-like liturgical title of Our Lady of Still Waters. Every Unstained soul within 32 blocks is blessed at once: each gains 5 purity and has their Verdigris Aura refreshed.
hemomancy.rite.silver_dawn.desc: A grand consecration that radiates silver-green light, cleansing blood-stained blocks in a wide radius and strengthening the caster's Verdigris Aura. Requires Clarity.
hemomancy.rite.silver_dawn.name: Rite of the Silver Dawn
hemomancy.rite.silver_veil.desc: A consecration rite that draws silver light from the cleansed blocks, weaving a protective veil around the supplicant. The Silver Ward shields the faithful from the touch of blood magic.
hemomancy.rite.silver_veil.name: Rite of the Silver Veil
hemomancy.rite.steady_separation.desc: Seat a base Vial Centrifuge behind the Focus and steady its two recovery circuits.
hemomancy.rite.steady_separation.name: Rite of the Steady Separation
hemomancy.rite.still_waters.desc: A calming rite performed where cleansed stone meets pale silver. The lanterns' still light dampens blood-magic violence in the area: magic damage dealt within the zone is reduced by 30% for 5 minutes.
hemomancy.rite.still_waters.name: Rite of Still Waters
hemomancy.rite.true_groove.desc: Seat a Resonant Forge behind the Focus and align its wheel and carving stylus.
hemomancy.rite.true_groove.name: Rite of the True Groove
hemomancy.rite.vascular_mending.desc: A restorative rite that floods the caster's vascular system with purified blood, fully healing all five vein sections from strain and damage.
hemomancy.rite.vascular_mending.name: Rite of Vascular Mending
hemomancy.rite.visitation_rite.desc: An Apotheos goes home in the flesh. Two spore sacs burn in the braziers and the rite carries them bodily into the Gardens, onto their heart-node if one beats there; the Spine or a Podium brings them back.
hemomancy.rite.visitation_rite.name: Rite of Visitation
hemomancy.rite.working.covenant_throne.d: Build the Covenant Throne beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.dendritic_distrib: Build the Dendritic Distributor beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.enzymatic_scripto: Build the Enzymatic Scriptorium beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.fungal_implantati: Build the Fungal Implantation Pylon beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
Working of the Fungal Implantation Pylon
hemomancy.rite.working.mason_effigy.desc: Build the Mason's Effigy beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.mason_effigy.name: Working of the Mason's Effigy
hemomancy.rite.working.mnemonic_reliquar: Build the Mnemonic Reliquary beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
Build the Morphling Cradle beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.morphling_incubat: Build the Morphling Incubator beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
Build the Mycelial Lantern beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.resonant_forge.de: Build the Resonant Forge beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.runic_chisel_stat: Build the Cerebral Scarring Station beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
Working of the Cerebral Scarring Station
hemomancy.rite.working.sanguine_monolith: Build the Sanguine Monolith beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.scarlet_vanity.de: Build the Scarlet Vanity beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.semi_sentient_con: Build the Semi Sentient Construct beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
Working of the Semi Sentient Construct
hemomancy.rite.working.somatic_loom.desc: Build the Somatic Loom beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.somatic_loom.name: Working of the Somatic Loom
hemomancy.rite.working.somnolent_seat.de: Build the Somnolent Seat beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.sporitic_thurible: Build the Sporitic Thurible beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.vacant_effigy.des: Build the Vacant Effigy beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.rite.working.vascular_effigy.d: Build the Sanguine Vigil beside the Cardinal Focus, feed it, and let the Working floor take it.
hemomancy.scout.farewell.line1: §o...Good.§r §7[She exhales slowly and closes her eyes. The hand holding the journal goes still.]
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line1: They act like they do outside. Hunting food, pushing at the walls, circling each other. But they never took me for anything. §oNot a threat. Not prey. Nothing.§r
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line2: At the church, the Tooth Pecks wouldn't leave Annetta be. They seek active infection. So every ward failed. They were hunting something she never knew she carried.
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line3: §oThink what that means for her.§r All of it is in the notes. Use it if you can.
hemomancy.scout.root.line1: §7[An Unstained woman is slumped against the bone-speckled wall of the geode, her robes filthy with stone dust. She looks up at you, glassy-eyed but focused.]
hemomancy.scout.root.line2: Oh. §o...Someone found me.§r Not long now. Cold and hunger are doing what the creatures never could. Please. I have notes. Observations. They can't be wasted. Take them while I can still hand them over.
hemomancy.scout.take_notes.prompt: Give me your hands. Take the journal now, while I still can.
hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line1: I came in after the creatures. The Church sends scouts to learn what they are, what they eat, whether they can be reasoned with. I spent a day in here taking notes. Then the exit collapsed. §oI never found it again.§r
hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line2: But the bugs. They never touched me. Not once. Three days alone with them. They look right through me. I wrote it all down. I don't know what it means. I know it §omatters§r.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_pure: The bells toll softly. Your purification is already complete.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_rung: The pale silver bells are quiet now. Their blessing has already been spent.
hemomancy.silver_bells.chimed: §bThe pale silver bells ring across the sky. A great wave of purity floods your blood.
hemomancy.silver_bells.not_on_path: The pale silver bells do not answer you.
hemomancy.station_upgrade.requirements_u: Finish this station's required practice and the requirements for its earlier upgrades before you perform this rite. You don't need to claim a free kit.
hemomancy.still_art.gifted: A Still Art settles into you: %s
hemomancy.still_art.pale_intercession.fa: There is no safe place for her attention to take shape.
hemomancy.still_art.pale_intercession.re: Our Lady's manifestation returns to your side.
hemomancy.still_art.select.invalid: That Still Art cannot be selected.
hemomancy.still_art.select.locked: Your clarity isn't high enough for that Still Art yet.
hemomancy.still_art.select.unknown: The Lady has not given you this Still Art.
hemomancy.succession.accept_bequest: We accept your freely given Bequest.
hemomancy.succession.ask_bequest: Will you bequeath your profession to our bloodline?
hemomancy.succession.bequest_granted: %s has granted your bloodline a Mnemonic Bequest.
hemomancy.succession.consent: Yes. I give my professional blood-memory to your bloodline freely, and I will stay here as teacher and witness. Whoever you wake from it will be someone new, with my vocation and a history they make for themselves.
hemomancy.succession.dismiss_confirm: Permanently release %s from this bloodline? Their former bloodline will no longer be able to restore them.
hemomancy.succession.donate: Donate a blood sample to our bloodline.
hemomancy.succession.donated: %s has donated an identity-bearing blood sample.
hemomancy.succession.empty_vial: Hold an empty blood vial to receive a donation.
hemomancy.succession.failure.body: Place a Vacant Effigy on the adjacent Venous Stone plinth.
hemomancy.succession.failure.cap: The server's successor population limit has been reached.
hemomancy.succession.failure.eligibility: A Degree 5 member of the bloodline must officiate, inside their bloodline's fane.
hemomancy.succession.failure.interrupted: The succession rite lost its floor or its body. Offerings already consumed are gone.
hemomancy.succession.failure.legacy_samp: This sample has no individual identity. Draw a new sample before beginning.
hemomancy.succession.failure.offerings: Fill the marked braziers in order: donor blood or remnant first, officiant blood second, then Ambergris if this is a new incarnation.
hemomancy.succession.failure.profession: The donated sample has to carry one of the five professions.
hemomancy.succession.failure.remnant: This remnant is inert, already restored, or belongs to another bloodline.
hemomancy.succession.failure.reserved: Another rite has already reserved this body, identity, or workplace.
hemomancy.succession.failure.workplace: There's no loaded, unclaimed workplace for this profession inside the fane.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.alchemist: [Fractured voice] Label the mixture. Your name on it. Not mine. Not mine.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.artificer: [Fractured voice] The hand doesn't fit the work.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.cicatrix_a: [Fractured voice] A scar with no wound. A wound with your face.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.mnemonist: [Fractured voice] I remember you remembering me.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.vicar: [Fractured voice] I swore the vow. You broke it. I broke it. Write that down.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.0.first: Oh, hello. Sit down, would you? My head's full of somebody else's lessons, and I've had nobody to ask about half of them.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.0.return: I know that voice. I wrote down where we stopped and then lost the page. Where were we?
hemomancy.succession.greeting.1.first: Found my station, then. What's the job?
hemomancy.succession.greeting.1.return: Right. Show me what's changed since you were last here, and we'll get on with it.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.2.first: I woke up knowing work I don't remember learning. I'd like to put it to some use, if you'll let me.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.2.return: It's good to see a familiar face among all these borrowed memories.
hemomancy.succession.jei.create: Braziers: 1 donor blood, 2 your blood, 3 Ambergris. Use the marked sockets beside the effigy.
hemomancy.succession.jei.requirements: Degree 5 · Greater Dominion floor · fane workplace · 60 seconds
hemomancy.succession.jei.restore: Braziers: 1 bound remnant, 2 your blood. The third socket stays empty.
hemomancy.succession.personal_identity: I got the craft from a teacher, all of it at once. Everything else about me I'm still finding out.
hemomancy.succession.phase.1: Identity: two bloods find their places.
hemomancy.succession.phase.2: Life: a heart begins to beat.
hemomancy.succession.phase.4: Recognition: the memories examine their host.
hemomancy.succession.recovery_hint: Recover lost remnants at your fane bloodwell.
hemomancy.succession.rejection: The memories refuse these identities. A Misbegotten vessel awakens.
hemomancy.succession.remnant.bound: Bound to its original bloodline. Copies become inert after restoration or reissue.
hemomancy.succession.rite_hint: Stay in the circle. To stop, hold the usual rite-cancel control.
hemomancy.succession.sample_bound: Donated to one bloodline under a Mnemonic Bequest.
hemomancy.succession.self_blood_cost: Drawing your own sample costs 100 mL of your blood.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.alchemist: Sanguine Quintessence goes in the Focus. That's the life. The memory comes from the consenting donor, so their vial goes in first, your own vial second and Ambergris third. Need 100 mL of your own blood? Sneak-use an empty vial. My successors can work at an Alembic or a Centrifuge.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.artificer: At Degree 5, raise a Vacant Effigy's frame beside a Cardinal Focus on a Greater Working floor. Lay it out: Venous Stone in the center, Hematic Iron on its four edges, Conscious Mass at its four corners. Seat a Sanguine Formation. Set an Armor Stand and Blood Stained Stone in lit braziers. Feed it 250 mL. Then carry the effigy to a Venous Stone plinth beside the Cardinal Focus on a Greater Dominion floor.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.cicatrix_a: A successor needs a station to root in. Build a Mason's Effigy or a Fungal Implantation Pylon inside the fane. One station bears one successor. Lose the station, and their work waits until another stands.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.mnemonist: A Bequest is the donor's permission. It doesn't make you the owner. A successor who dies leaves a Bound Mnemonic Remnant. Restore them with an Effigy, Quintessence, your own blood and a free workplace. No new Ambergris. A remnant gone missing is recovered at the fane bloodwell. The old copies go inert then.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.vicar: Whoever's hand starts it, the rite belongs to the bloodline, and any member at the fifth Degree may officiate. We stay at our outposts, and your successors teach where they wake and help with your rites. Give the memory a false identity and when it comes down you get a Misbegotten vessel.
hemomancy.succession.unavailable: I still remember the work. I can't do it for you here, though. I need my own bloodline, and an unclaimed workplace inside its fane.
hemomancy.summon.bind.success: The crossbar attunes itself to you.
hemomancy.summon.cap.reached: Your skein can only hold %s active summons.
hemomancy.summon.cap.shaped: You can hold %s shaped bodies. Bonus slots from claimed Wills can't take a learned shape.
hemomancy.summon.cap.unravel: %s unravels as the older tethers fill your active limit.
hemomancy.summon.cinder_bellows.lore: A coiled lower body holds up a gaunt rib frame and an exposed bellows lung. You can see it inhale before it breathes a short cone of fire, and it needs a long recovery after. The Fire Breather teaches restraint.
hemomancy.summon.command.guard: The skein knots itself to this ground.
hemomancy.summon.command.hunt: The skein loosens for the hunt.
hemomancy.summon.crossbar.foreign: The crossbar is attuned to another owner's blood.
hemomancy.summon.crossbar.unattuned: Attune this crossbar at a Puppeteer's Spindle first.
hemomancy.summon.dimension.unravel: Crossing the dimension boundary severs %s from its crossbar.
hemomancy.summon.failed: The tether fails to find a body.
hemomancy.summon.focus.out_of_range: That hostile lies beyond the crossbar's tether range.
hemomancy.summon.focused: %s becomes the focus of %s bound summon(s).
hemomancy.summon.gorebound_hulk.lore: A slow red burden on legs, built to hold ground where softer bodies would fall.
hemomancy.summon.marrow_spitter.lore: Six arms share a floating crimson frame, with laughing, mourning and blank masks. The Dagger Thrower teaches a deliberate three-dagger volley.
hemomancy.summon.mnemonist_puppet.lore: A deliberate little witness that keeps a target's wounds in order, then asks them to happen again.
hemomancy.summon.ringmaster_pattern.lore: A captured office in a low-damage body. Its gestures relay one owner's nearby commands without multiplying them.
hemomancy.summon.sanguine_hound.lore: A dense pursuit body that tears itself into a short-lived pack when badly injured.
hemomancy.summon.scarlet_mummer.lore: A narrow red performer that asks every eye in the room to make the same mistake.
hemomancy.summon.select.invalid: That summon shape cannot be selected.
hemomancy.summon.select.none: You have not learned any summon shapes.
hemomancy.summon.select.unknown: That summon shape has not been unlocked.
hemomancy.summon.session.unravel: %s unravels as your former tether session closes.
hemomancy.summon.spindle.no_crossbar: Set a Marionette Crossbar into the spindle first.
hemomancy.summon.spindle.prepared: %s is prepared. Take up the crossbar and call it in the field.
hemomancy.summon.thread.low: The crossbar doesn't have enough thread charge.
hemomancy.summon.trial.already_known: That shape is already knotted into your blood-memory.
hemomancy.summon.trial.complete: The defeated shape settles into memory: %s.
hemomancy.summon.trial.crossbar_active: That Crossbar still controls active bodies. Recall them before beginning the ordeal.
hemomancy.summon.trial.crossbar_replaced: The binding fails. The Crossbar in the seat isn't the one that started this ordeal.
hemomancy.summon.trial.failed: The rite shudders, but no body answers.
hemomancy.summon.trial.no_blood: There isn't enough blood for this ordeal to draw on.
hemomancy.summon.veinwing_vulture.lore: A hooked little covenant of vein and wing, quick to harry whatever threatens its maker.
hemomancy.trade.acolyte.bread.line: Six loaves would feed most of us after the service. I've got a little dew put by for you.
hemomancy.trade.acolyte.bread.title: Bread for the table
hemomancy.trade.acolyte.refuse_harbinger: I'm sorry, I can't trade with you, and that's my own choice, nobody else's. I think you know why, and I don't like saying it.
hemomancy.trade.acolyte.stained: I'm sorry, I can't take that one, not with blood worked into it. I couldn't bring it into the church.
hemomancy.trade.acolyte.thanks: Thank you, really. I think it's the small things that keep us going.
hemomancy.trade.acolyte.wool.line: Four wool, if you can spare it, for the cold pews. I've got poppies from the garden for you.
hemomancy.trade.acolyte.wool.title: Wool for the pews
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.appraise.poor: That's the wrong blood, or no blood at all. Check the vial against the card.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.cold_reagent.l: Two Frigid Enzymes for one Incandescent. Don't ask me why they balance, but on the bench they do.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.ferric_draw.li: Two filled vials of Ferric blood. Examine them first and I'll pay double, since I skip the assay.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.fresh_draw.lin: 250 mL of your own blood for two Bleeding Bulbs. It's going in as a control sample.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.living_syringe: Eight hematic scrap and I'll culture you a fresh Living Syringe. Lose this one as well and the next assay comes out of your own vein.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.pelagic_oil.li: Four cooked pelagic herring, the kind off the Voyager's ship. I render the oil, and you get glowstone.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.reef_salts.lin: Four erythrocoral fragments for two primers. The Voyager brings some in, and it's never enough.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.spent_enzyme.l: Four recycled enzymes for one primer. There's still some use in them, and I'll do the cleaning.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.spore_stock.li: Three spore sacs for the culture shelf. Next time, label them with what you grew them on.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.thanks: Logged. That's going on the bench tonight.
hemomancy.trade.alchemist.thanks_fine: A clean sample. You'd be surprised how rare those are.
hemomancy.trade.artificer.appraise.poor: That's past saving. Melt it down yourself.
hemomancy.trade.artificer.bone_offcuts.l: Eight of the Vein-Mason's bone bricks. Nothing keeps a rack straighter. I'll give you powder for them.
hemomancy.trade.artificer.husk_lacquer.l: Four chitinous husks. I boil them down to Crimson Lacquer. Third Degree first, though.
hemomancy.trade.artificer.scrap_in.line: Eight pieces of scrap and I'll grind them down for you. You get powder back.
hemomancy.trade.artificer.scrap_in.title: Scrap in
hemomancy.trade.artificer.suture_work.li: Four string and a Blood Crystal Shard, and I'll make you a needle. Keeping it sharp's your job.
hemomancy.trade.artificer.thanks_fine: Good metal. Who's been looking after it?
hemomancy.trade.artificer.venous_offcuts: Eight polished venous stone, the Vein-Mason's cut. I bind frames with it, and you get two binders back.
hemomancy.trade.artificer.worn_tools.lin: Iron or better, worn down but still in one piece. Bring it in before it snaps on you.
Eight bones for four bricks. Bone takes more load than people think.
Six clay. I go through mortar fast out here. Take the stone.
hemomancy.trade.cicatrix_anchorite.thank: Good. Leave it by the door.
hemomancy.trade.circus_acrobat.rigging_l: Oh, string! Eight of it and I'm happy. Rigging comes first, always. Have this for the next time you fall.
Goats eat before anyone does. Eight wheat buys a name tag, for an animal you mean to keep.
hemomancy.trade.circus_beast_tamer.thank: They'll eat well tonight. Thank you.
hemomancy.trade.circus_fire_eater.fuel.l: Four blaze powder. One, two, three, four. A draught back, so the fire waits its turn.
hemomancy.trade.circus_knife_thrower.app: You call that a blade? It's a bent stick. Even I won't throw it.
hemomancy.trade.circus_knife_thrower.tha: There. Straight as a knife, which is to say mostly.
Look at that edge. Fine, I'll admit it, you keep a good blade.
hemomancy.trade.circus_knife_thrower.wor: Any sword, worn in. I'd argue it's balanced better than new. Nobody agrees with me.
hemomancy.trade.circus_ringmaster.bell.l: A bell, and the fourth Degree, or don't bother. Four Filaments back, to string the act.
hemomancy.trade.circus_ringmaster.curios: Got anything strange on you? A relic, a trophy, something off a wreck? I pay better the rarer it is, because the crowd cheers louder for it.
hemomancy.trade.circus_ringmaster.ring_p: Sixteen planks, if you can spare them. Every night the ring gets kicked to splinters, and I'm the one who pays to patch it.
hemomancy.trade.circus_ringmaster.specta: Sit through one of my acts to the very end, without looking away or slipping out the back, and I'll pay you for the attention.
hemomancy.trade.circus_ringmaster.thanks: Hear that? That's the crowd. Well, it will be.
Now that is a curiosity. I'll put it where the crowd can see it.
hemomancy.trade.circus_stilt_walker.stic: Sixteen sticks will make me new legs, because mine are wearing short. Take the scaffolding, and climb slowly.
hemomancy.trade.circus_stilt_walker.than: Thank you. Mind your footing when you are up high.
hemomancy.trade.circus_strongman.iron_ba: Four iron for my bar, and you get strength in a bottle. Spend it on somebody else.
hemomancy.trade.circus_strongman.thanks: Good. Now carry something that isn't yours.
hemomancy.trade.circus_threadkeeper.ledg: Six sheets of paper, entered against two Enthralling Filaments. The account balances.
hemomancy.trade.circus_understudy.prompt: Three books for the prompt corner, where somebody has to keep the names. Have a mask for your trouble.
hemomancy.trade.circus_understudy.thanks: Thank you. Your name goes in the prompt book with all the rest.
One wool for the bell's walls, against the cold. That is a guest's share.
Standing with the Still Bell. At the fifth Degree a guest may ask the Bellwarden to join.
hemomancy.trade.court_bellwarden.thanks: One wool received. It goes into the walls.
hemomancy.trade.court_gardener.custom.li: Bring food for the table, friend, whatever you have. There's always more when everyone brings a little.
hemomancy.trade.court_gardener.custom.op: Standing with the Giving Light. From the fifth Degree, a guest of the house may ask the Lightkeeper to join it.
hemomancy.trade.court_gardener.thanks: There, that's on the table with everyone's. Now sit down and eat something yourself, love.
hemomancy.trade.court_host.custom.line: Ink sac or black dye, for the door's screen. Do you need me to know whose? I don't.
hemomancy.trade.court_host.custom.opens: Standing with the Veiled Fold. At the fifth Degree a guest may ask the Veiled resident to join.
hemomancy.trade.court_host.custom.title: Ink for the screen
hemomancy.trade.court_host.thanks: Given. Nobody will know whose. Isn't that better?
hemomancy.trade.court_linesman.custom.li: Got string to spare? I'll splice it into the lines, if you'd like. No harm if not.
hemomancy.trade.court_linesman.custom.op: Standing with the Woven Current. At the fifth Degree a guest may ask the Lamp-colony to join.
hemomancy.trade.court_linesman.thanks: That'll hold. I'll tie it in where you can see it, if you like.
hemomancy.trade.court_marrow_tender.cust: Bring bones, or rotten flesh. We'll use all of it. Nothing that comes down here's wasted.
Standing with Last Marrow. At the fifth Degree a guest may ask the Rooted elder to join.
hemomancy.trade.court_marrow_tender.than: Good. That'll feed the plumes. Nothing wasted.
hemomancy.trade.court_nursery_tender.cus: We share the catch here. One raw fish, and the young in the cups eat tonight.
Standing with the Shared Wake. At the fifth Degree a guest may ask the Nursery tender to join.
hemomancy.trade.court_nursery_tender.tha: That'll be in the cups before dark. Thank you for thinking of the young.
hemomancy.trade.court_offering_bearer.cu: Bring food for the heads. It goes down to the vents with ours, as part of the preparation.
Standing with the Kindling. At the fifth Degree a guest may ask the Head-tender to join.
hemomancy.trade.court_offering_bearer.th: It is received. It will go down to the heads with ours.
One block of stone. For the passage. I'll set it myself. That's a promise.
Standing with the Holding Stone. At the fifth Degree a guest may ask the Braced elder to join.
hemomancy.trade.court_tidewarden.thanks: It's in the wall. I'll keep it there.
hemomancy.trade.done_fine: Traded, and the quality was noticed
hemomancy.trade.guardian.arrows.title: Arrows
hemomancy.trade.guardian.iron.title: Iron
hemomancy.trade.guardian.silthmere_glaiv: Four pale silver. It's yours. Don't shame it.
hemomancy.trade.guardian.worn_armour.lin: Iron or mail. Worn is fine. Not ruined.
hemomancy.trade.hermit.bread.line: I eat little now. Bring bread all the same, and take a candle for the dark.
hemomancy.trade.hermit.bread.title: Bread for the vigil
hemomancy.trade.hermit.thanks: Thank you. Sit a while, if you like.
hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.appraise.poor: This jar's empty. I've had my ear to it, and there is nothing in there.
hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.books.line: Two books for the index, and three sacs of glow ink in return.
hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.books.title: Books for the shelf
hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.faded_memories: Two faded memories for one thread. The lessons left them long ago, but the thread still pulls out clean.
hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.living_specime: One jar with something alive in it. I'll listen to whatever it carries, and the infection's own creatures always carry more.
hemomancy.trade.mnemonist.thanks_fine: Listen, it's still humming. Thank you. That one goes on a good shelf.
hemomancy.trade.monolith.deep.line: 1,000 mL, from the sixth Degree. Two poultices. The weight goes down.
hemomancy.trade.monolith.deep.title: The deep measure
hemomancy.trade.monolith.measure.line: Palm to the stone. 500 mL goes in, and two salves come away.
hemomancy.trade.monolith.measure.title: A measure
hemomancy.trade.monolith.weight.line: 750 mL against the stone. One poultice comes away, warm.
hemomancy.trade.monolith.weight.title: A heavier measure
hemomancy.trade.refused.blood: Not enough blood above your reserve
hemomancy.trade.refused.missing: You lack the proper resources to barter
hemomancy.trade.refused.no_room: No room in your pack for the goods
hemomancy.trade.refused.not_today: That want isn't on the board today
hemomancy.trade.scout.paper.line: Paper, if you have it. Still writing. Take my dew. I won't need it.
hemomancy.trade.scout.paper.title: Paper
hemomancy.trade.scout.refuse_harbinger: Not you. You carry the stain. I won't. Not even now.
hemomancy.trade.scout.thanks: Thanks. Go on. Leave me to it.
hemomancy.trade.ui.act.spectacle.hint: A pavilion performance you held to the end, one per trade
hemomancy.trade.ui.act_confirm: Paid with a performance you watched through.
hemomancy.trade.ui.blood_confirm: Paid from your blood above the reserve.
hemomancy.trade.ui.custom: Their house's custom, given as a gift
hemomancy.trade.ui.custom_confirm: Given from your pack, as the custom asks.
hemomancy.trade.vicar.chapel_shards.line: Three blood crystal shards for the chapel, and a poultice in return. We do not ask it of anyone below the fourth Degree.
hemomancy.trade.vicar.thanks: So. It is entered in the record.
hemomancy.trade.vicar.thanks_fine: Good. Better than I asked for, and I will say so in the ledger.
hemomancy.trade.vicar.thread_blessing.li: Two lengths of the Mnemonist's memory thread will bind a ledger for me, and I will bless a salve for you in return.
hemomancy.trade.vicar.tithe.line: We have always asked 500 mL of those the outpost shelters, and two salves go back with it. Will you give?
hemomancy.trade.vicar.tithe.title: A tithe
hemomancy.trade.votary_wayfarer.kelp.lin: Twelve kelp would help. I'm trying to work out what the herring eat, so please don't laugh.
hemomancy.trade.votary_wayfarer.nautilus: A whole shell! Where was it lying? Was it on sand or on rock? Sorry, I have to ask.
hemomancy.trade.votary_wayfarer.prismari: Six shards for my shelf. I know it's weird that I keep them, but I'm keeping them anyway.
hemomancy.trade.votary_wayfarer.thanks: Thank you! Hang on, let me find a dry page for that.
hemomancy.trade.voyager.charted_map.line: A map you filled in yourself is worth more than a dozen sailors' stories. We'll pay you from the galley.
hemomancy.trade.voyager.survey_log.line: A salt-stained log pulled from a wreck belongs in our archive, and we'll pay for it in erythrocoral.
hemomancy.trade.voyager.survey_log.title: A survey log
hemomancy.trade.voyager.thanks: Logged, with the date and your name beside it.
hemomancy.trade.voyager.wreck_coral.line: Bring calcified erythrocoral up from the reef floor and I'll trade you blank charts for your own route.
hemomancy.trade.zealot.amethyst.line: Three amethyst shards for one Draught of Still Waters, and I pour it only for our own. Are you ours yet?
hemomancy.trade.zealot.amethyst.title: Amethyst for the font
hemomancy.trade.zealot.clean_copper.line: Six copper ingots for two vials of Lethean Dew. Why do you want dew, though? Say it plainly.
hemomancy.trade.zealot.refuse_harbinger: No. I won't trade with someone the blood is still feeding. If it's a cure you want, why not ask for that?
hemomancy.trade.zealot.stained: Where did you get that? It's blood work, and I won't take it into this church.
hemomancy.trade.zealot.thanks: Good. Use it for healing, not for curiosity.
hemomancy.tutorial.current_controls: Hold a sword and press %s for Blood Formation. Aim at a completed bloodcraft pattern and press %s to activate it. Cycle equipped manipulations with %s.
hemomancy.unstained.clarity_progress: Clarity: %s/100. The path to enlightenment sharpens...
hemomancy.unstained.enlightened: You have achieved Enlightenment. You are Unstained.
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_blocked: Your purified blood refuses to obey.
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_weakene: Your purifying blood resists the manipulation...
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.bearing: As near as I can place it, there's a Vagrant Mind in the outer End near X %s, Z %s. Find the Cortical Drift around it and follow its nerve bridges in.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.bearing_m: I can't hear a Vagrant Mind anywhere in the part of the outer End I searched. Travel farther among the outer islands and ask me again.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology.p: Report the Mind visit and the biology you watched nearby. You hand over no specimen.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology_l: Visit the Vagrant Mind, then go watch a Choir Keeper, a Myelin Borer, or some living chorus growth out in the End. I'm after the living system around the Mind. I don't want a list of kills.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology_r: You've seen the Mind and something alive around its network. Tell me what you found. The Mnemonist can take a separate report on that same visit.
The Alchemist records your field observation. If you haven't reported to the Mnemonist yet, their inquiry is still open.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory.pr: Give the Mnemonist your account of the Vagrant Mind. It costs you no memory slot and earns you none.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_fo: You have stood inside the Mind now. Tell me what held its nerve web together. Words will do. I don't need a piece of it.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_le: A Cortical Drift in the outer End holds a hollow Vagrant Mind. Go inside and study the nerve web. I want an account of how memory keeps itself in order outside a familiar body. I have no use for a trophy from whatever lives there.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_re: The Mnemonist records your account. Your memory loadout and its costs stay as they were.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.brotherhood_lore: The Sanguine Brotherhood began in the early wars of the Harbinger Order. Practitioners who pooled their blood kept walking out of engagements that should have killed them, and afterward someone sat down and wrote out why, and that became doctrine. It is the reason we still send blood wherever it is needed, and the reason your rank carries their name.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.degree_hint: The Rite of the Crimson Lodge is next, and after it you would be Illuminatus. The Lodge is our inner circle, the people who went on to ask how hemomancy is put together, and its rite wants to see that you have started asking too. So: what joins one skill to the next? Take that question to your skill tree, and look at the paths between the skills as closely as at the skills.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line1: §7[The Vicar sets down his pen and salutes you, one hand flat over his heart]
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line2: So you are an Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. Their first teaching was about sharing blood willingly, and the rite you passed tested exactly that. How did it feel, putting your blood in a pool with other people's?
hemomancy.vicar.adept.masons_respite.fol: You have the route already. Remember when you get there that the Cicatrix Anchorite keeps no outpost and answers to none of us.
Go to Masons Respite when you are ready. The Mason teaches by cutting, I am told.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.masons_respite.lin: No outpost teaches scarring. For that you need the Vein-Mason, who keeps a hermitage out past the last of the good roads.
The road to the hermitage is marked on this map.
hemomancy.vicar.annetta_map.line1: After the last inquiry, Annetta's old chapel disappeared from our route ledgers. Nobody tore it down. Somebody struck it from the record, which for a place on our roads amounts to the same thing.
hemomancy.vicar.annetta_map.line2: If you mean to follow that stain, take this, and go slowly. Fear and infection both make people look guilty.
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.line1: §4[The Vicar's breath catches. He cannot hold your gaze for more than a moment.]
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.line2: Apotheos. I have looked, and there is no heading in the record for what you are now. The rites and the books are here all the same, whenever you want them.
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.reflection: §oI think the Covenant was written to be outgrown, and I never read it that way until now. Every Degree was a step toward someone like you. I don't know whether to bow or to mourn.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.final_truth: §4§oI do not know what the Monolith has shown you, Archon. §rI was charged to pass one thing on to Archons, and it is a saying, nothing firmer: that the Order never had seven degrees but eight, and that the eighth is silence. Past that there is only hearsay. The oldest accounts name two roads beyond Archon, Silentium and Apotheosis, and agree on one point, that nobody who walked either was ever again someone the Lodge could recognize. Whether the roads are real, I have no warrant to say. §4§oTo me they are legends. §rGo in blood.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line1: §4[The Vicar kneels to you, slowly, and stays down a moment longer than the rubric asks]
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. That is the last title I have a word for. I cannot tell you what comes after it, and I doubt anyone here can, but every rite we keep is still open to you, and so is this desk.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.pome_empowered.li: §4[The Vicar pauses mid-bow. His nose twitches almost imperceptibly.]
You smell like the deep forest after rain, and not the fresh kind.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.absorptio: Use Blood Absorption to draw blood into your vessel. The ledger counts everything you absorb toward 500 mL, even blood you spend between draws, so you need not hoard it while you work.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.projectio: Blood Projection spends what you have absorbed, so where you aim it matters. An empty cauldron holds what you pour into it, and given time it sets into a Sanguine Formation you can lift out. Ordinary stone soaks it up and turns to Venous Stone. A few other blocks will take a projected recipe directly.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.structure: The last proof is one blood-structure formation, either a Liber Sanguinium or a Hematic Iron Block. Ask me for a blueprint of whichever pattern you choose, hold the catalyst it names in your offhand, and project into the assembled blocks.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.done: §7[The blood burns cold. For a moment every line in the world grows roots, then settles back into letters.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line1: §7[The Vicar studies your eyes, then pricks one finger with a thumbnail. The drop that gathers is too dark to be ordinary blood.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line2: Hold still and keep your eye open. This is Abocipher, and a few drops beneath the lid will teach your eyes to accept the blood-script. You will see the letters for a long while before they mean anything to you. We teach it in that order on purpose.
hemomancy.vicar.circus_referral.discover: You found the Circus on your own, before I ever mentioned it. Good. What you saw there counts, and I will take it as your introduction.
hemomancy.vicar.circus_referral.lead: Have you heard of the Circus? They are Harbingers too, a company of them, and their pavilion is stranger than any performance hall I know of. Whether you visit it is entirely up to you.
hemomancy.vicar.circus_referral.mnemonis: Speak with the Mnemonist about their practice, and ask them for a Scarlet Waybill if you need a route back. Your next Degree does not depend on anything you do at the pavilion.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.claimed: The heart went to you already. A second one you will have to grow yourself, from glass, amethyst and blood crystal.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.prompt: Ask for the heart that lines a Condenser in crystal.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.ready: Good. Your lattice has done its work, so take the heart to the Rite of Druse Crystallization and close three circuits there.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.requirem: Draw a formation from a Latticed Condenser with your own hand and reach the fifth Degree, and the crystal heart is yours. After that, nothing you set in it will slump away.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.title: The Druse Heart
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.claime: You already have our lattice, and if you need another, you can bind one yourself from scrap and ash.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.prompt: Ask for the lattice that teaches a cauldron to hold more.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.ready: You fed a cauldron and took out what it set, which is the proof I asked for, so the lattice is yours. Seat it at the Rite of the First Clotting with five more offerings.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.requir: Show me that you have drawn a formation out of a cauldron with your own hands, and keep your blood active. Once you reach the third Degree, the lattice is yours.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.title: The Clotting Lattice
hemomancy.vicar.court.chart: If you lose the way, any Voyager will draw you another Relay Chart.
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.alchemist: The Alchemist has already pointed you seaward, I hear. The Voyagers are the ones who can chart the way to the Brined Court.
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.found: So the Brined Court found you before I could send you. The record will take your account over my introduction. Was it what you expected?
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.letter: You have one of their letters, I see. A drowned envoy's seal is better evidence than anything I could add, so let a Voyager chart the way.
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.voyager: A Voyager has already told you about the Brined Court, so I will not repeat them badly. What did you make of their account?
hemomancy.vicar.court.lead: There is a page I do not show anyone below the fifth Degree, because until now it would not have done them any good. We are not the only Harbingers who took the blood into the sea. The ones who went furthest call themselves the Brined Court.
hemomancy.vicar.court.letter_lost: You took a letter off a drowned Votary and lost it before anyone read it? Then describe the seal to me. Sunburst crust on a drowned envoy's letter can only mean the Brined Court, and the record will take a careful description where it has no letter.
hemomancy.vicar.court.voyager: I know them mostly from other people's letters, which is a poor way to know anyone. The Voyagers have dealt with the Court far longer than we have, so find a Voyager on the Erythrocoral Reef and ask them. Whether you go at all is your own affair.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.bind_throne: Bind a Covenant Throne to your Fane and sit in it, so your covenant has a seat to gather its people around.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.chamber_return: Begin the Rite of the Chamber of Will on a Grand Threshold floor with an echo shard in the brazier, then enter the Chamber and come back out of it safely. Have you been inside already, on a guided visit? That visit does not count. The proof is coming back out after a rite you began yourself.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.complete_vigil: Use your ancestral ledger to summon a recruited Vicar to the Fane. During the inscription of the Covenant Vigil, assign that sworn helper to a rite station and keep them there to the end. A vigil that is interrupted earns no proof.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.found_bloodline: First, found your bloodline. Perform the Rite of Bloodline Founding at Lesser Communion with blaze powder in the brazier, and the rite gives you the ancestral ledger. People do sometimes bring me an unsigned ledger and expect it to count. It does not, because the line is founded by the rite.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.found_fane: Your bloodline is founded, so the Rite of the Founding Fane comes next, at Grand Dominion. Set Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus and a Nautilus Shell in the brazier, and bind a Bloodwell and Stakes. Does your bloodline have a Fane already? Then stand inside it at the fifth Degree and project blood into its Bloodwell yourself. I can only write your covenant proof for blood you gave with your own hand.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.perform_bloodli: Your bloodline and its Fane are in place, so the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant is next, and it will make you Sanctified. You may invite willing outpost specialists into your line. The Artificer will keep serving from the outpost.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.perform_hematic: So. You came back from the Chamber, bound the Throne and kept the Vigil to its end, and that proves the Living Covenant. You may perform the Rite of the Hematic Order now.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant_lore: What is the Hematic Covenant? The short answer is this book, and every book like it, back to the First Age. It sets out how hemomancy is to be learned and taught. Each Degree has a rite, and the rite shows a practitioner plainly what they have become, which is how we know the lesson took.
Your ledger bears all four proofs. The Vicar can grant you the Second Degree.
hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.lead: There are fungal gardens here in the Overworld, in wet country where you would otherwise expect swamp, jungle or mushroom field. I want them surveyed on foot. You do not need to cross into the fungal projection for any of this.
hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.specimens: Bring the Alchemist an Infected Fungus and a Puffball Fungus from your fieldwork. They will inspect both and hand them back to you.
hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.visited: You have walked the Overworld gardens already? Then the Alchemist will count that visit, and so will I.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.followup.lin: Another remnant, then. That road was there before any of our outposts, and it doesn't keep to our maps.
Keep the evidence in your ledger. One stone tells me you have initiative. Bring me enough of them and we may start to see where that road was going.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line1: Yours was not the only temple. There are hermit cells out in the wild that nobody ever came to, displays left to spoil, and stones stained by rites that no Vicar came back to collect.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line2: Can you find one without being led to it? Go looking in the wild, read what was left there and come back and tell me. I learn more about a Neophyte from what they find by themselves than from anything I could walk them to.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line1: So. You found one without my hand on your shoulder. Good.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line2: I will enter it in the record as a side road, under your name, and you should take this ash for the next stretch of it.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.promp: You found a remnant without being led to it. Show me the evidence and I will enter it in the record.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.armature_con: Ask the Artificer for the Armature Consecration Kit first. The frame is his work. The rite that consecrates it I can teach you here.

Seat a base Armature beside a Greater Cardinal Focus on a Working floor, since this is making. Plant your Living Staff, offer the kit and its five companion offerings at the lit brazier, and close both blood circuits.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.degree_hint: The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant is what remains. Sharing a pool got you this far. To become Sanctified you commit to a bloodline under permanent oaths, and we treat those oaths as sacred contracts. Whose blood would you bind to yours for good? Think about it properly, because none of those bonds can be dissolved without cost.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.founding_fan: The Rite of the Founding Fane consecrates ground for your bloodline once it is established. Seat a Sanguine Quintessence in the Cardinal Focus as the rite's medium and bind a Consecrated Bloodwell as its heart. Where does the Fane end? Wherever your connected Hematic Stakes carry its edge. We call that a Flexible Envelope, so a Fane never claims a fixed square, and Harbingers inside it feel the blood move more freely. You need build nothing around it; the stakes and the covenant give it its shape.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. Most Harbingers stop at this Degree, and I am one of them, so from here on you may speak to me as an equal. I would rather you did.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.lodge_lore: The Crimson Lodge keeps what we guard most closely. It was the Lodge that first wrote down the link between hemomancy and the mycelial network under our feet, and the finding that came with it, that blood and the living earth belong to one organism. Its Archons will not say so openly. They hold that you have to arrive at it yourself or it does not take.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.monolith_rum: §7[Discomfort crosses the Vicar's face, then something closer to reverence, and he smooths both away.]§r There are rumors. Very old ones, which the Lodge keeps off parchment because nobody living has confirmed them.

Harbingers from centuries before my Vicariate may have found a way past the Degrees we teach. What I was given of it is half a story, and most of that half is legend. This fragment came out of an old reliquary. The script is in no dialect I was trained in and I can read only part of it, so perhaps your blood will make more of it than mine did.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.scrap_given: Take it. I have carried it about long enough, and if you ever find out what it says, I would like to know.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.castles_lore: Nobody in the Order built those castles, and nobody will tell you who did, because they are older than anything we wrote down and I am not going to invent a history for them. This much I can tell you. The Fargone hold them now, they guard far more than they use, and a careful student can come away with whatever the old stores still keep.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.degree_hint: Your next rite is the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood, a rite of shared blood: it asks whether your hemomancy can work alongside other people's. What does it mean to share a blood pool? The rite will put that question to you, so study the Bloodline system before you go.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.fane_lore: The Archon Erythravane founded the Incarnadine Fane in the Second Age, and held the first Vicariate as well. Erythravane believed hemomancy wanted discipline of mind as much as power, and built the Fane's rites to break practitioners who leaned on raw force and make them precise. Every Initiate is in that line, whether they meant to be or not.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.line1: I have written Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane on your page. The title is older than this outpost. Has anyone told you whose Fane it was?
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.saints_lore: The Saints were practitioners of earlier ages whose blood carried them past anything a body should survive, and their own people sealed them away when nothing else would hold them. We inherited the tombs, and we keep them. The name Saint is ours, and there is nothing holy meant by it. Can one be killed? Nobody has managed it that I know of: bring a Saint down and it goes back to its sarcophagus, dormant. You may walk the outer halls of the mausoleums now. Past them is a ward that turns back anyone it does not know, which at your Degree is everyone, and the Saints are beyond it. Their Hallowed Residuum, run through the Centrifuge, gives Canon Memories, blood patterns older than the Order, which the Somatic Loom cannot make on its own.
hemomancy.vicar.item_hint: What is that? Let me see it. If the record has anything on it I will tell you, and if not, I will say so rather than guess.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.blood_struc: A blood-structure plan. It lays out every block, and once the form is complete, Blood Projection can persuade it to do some work.
Build it exactly as drawn and project at the proper point. People sometimes go looking for a separate blood key to start it, and there is none; the projection does that.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line1: A book. Every Degree rite we teach and every tendency history we have went into books like this, with the names of the people who practised them. Give a blank one to someone attentive and in a few years it is worth reading.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line2: Most of what has lasted in the Order lasted because someone wrote it down plainly for the next person.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.brine_seale: This is a letter of introduction that never arrived, sealed with Sunburst crust and carried by one of the crews who tried to reach the Brined Court and drowned on the way.
We call those drowned envoys Votaries now, and I would not have you finish their errand blind. A Voyager can tell you where the Court keeps its door.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.dendritic_d: We call the Dendritic Distributor a nervous archive. It keeps rehearsed blood-memory patterns and will hold a working arrangement for you, though choosing a good arrangement is still your job.
Name each pattern carefully. Combat, travel, rites and fane work want different reflexes from the same blood.
A Dragon Egg. Some Lodge naturalists write about its compressed vitality at great length, as evidence for their wider theories of living potential.
It is learned speculation, nothing in settled Covenant cosmology rests on it, and no Degree rite asks for one.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.earthen_vei: An Earthen Vein. It is a living conduit, grown more than built, and if you place them in sequence they carry blood from its source to wherever you want it.
A developed Harbinger workshop runs on them, and though you can manage without them in the early Degrees, you will want what they carry once the Loom is regular work.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.enchanted_b: An enchanted book. It presses arcane knowledge into an inscription by its own method, and it wants what a sanguine memory crystal wants: knowledge kept in a form another person can take up.

Some practitioners of the higher Degrees have recorded links between schools of enchantment and tendency affinities. The work is unfinished and I would not stake much on it yet, but so far it all points the same way.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hallowed_re: Hallowed Residuum, what a Saint leaves behind, concentrated. The first question is whether your alignment suits the Saint. If it does, you may draw it peacefully. If the Saint rejects you, it wakes, and you will have to fight for it.

A sample taken in peace becomes Residuum in the Vial Centrifuge, while a Saint you drive back into its tomb gives it up directly. Either way, it goes to the Loom for Canon Memory work, beside what the Gardens remember of the same Saint.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.heart_of_th: The Heart of the Sea carries a deep-water resonance that some of us find suggestive.
Some see a kinship between water and blood in it, others only liturgical metaphor, and the Heart itself settles nothing.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hematic_mem: A Hematic Memory holds one deliberate manipulation lesson. Use it, and the pattern becomes part of your own known practice.

Later, the Mnemonic Reliquary arranges which lessons you have active; that is the Mnemonist's to teach. Nothing you do with the crystal or the Reliquary will work a personal manipulation into a bloodline.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.iron_brazie: An Iron Brazier holds rite fire, the consecrated flame a Cardinal Rite feeds on. Stand it on the floor, mount it on a wall or hang it from the ceiling, whatever the room allows. Any lit Brazier inside the cube that rises from a rite's floor serves that rite.
A Living Weapon Graft can also burn here. Hold the Living Staff, draw with Blood Absorption, and the rite consumes the graft only if the memory takes.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.minecraft_r: An old instrument, for measuring or finding your way or getting back again. We keep a few like it, though I would not claim every relic of this kind as ours.
Tell me who used it and for what, and then I can tell you what it means. How old it is matters much less.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_bl: A blank mnemonic blueprint. It will take any rite or blood structure you have properly learned, so learn one first.
It has been a while since I saw someone of your Degree carrying a mnemonic blueprint. Most stop needing them.
Still, the upper rites are worded precisely for a reason, and if you miss a word, the rite may not hold.
A mnemonic blueprint. Each imprint on it describes a rite or a blood structure, what it demands of you and what it proves.
Study it. It points to what comes next for you, and I will not advance anyone who cannot explain the work back to me.
A mnemonic blueprint for a structure of the middle Degrees. We start being less forgiving about mistakes from here.
It gives you the outline, and your blood has to supply the rest.
This blueprint keeps the spatial memory of a Cardinal Rite, which will help with the building. Whether the rite accepts you is a separate matter, and the blueprint has no say in it.
This blueprint remembers a blood structure. It shows you the form, and you still have to wake the form with Blood Projection.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_re: The Mnemonic Reliquary is the Mnemonist's apparatus. It arranges which of your known bodily and willed memories stand readiest to hand.
It changes how ready each memory is, and that is all. Nothing you have learned moves in or out of it, and it has no bearing on your bloodline.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.monolith.li: The Sanguine Monolith belongs to the upper Degrees. It speaks to practitioners who have come far enough, and what it offers them is older than our doctrine, or so the Lodge tells me.
From about the fifth Degree it becomes your main guide, because that is roughly where my counsel runs out.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mortal_disp: A Mortal Display. Each one holds a Hermit's heart, kept beating at the center of the temple that Hermit built for a final vigil.
