Taking the heart is a personal invitation, and once you complete the initiating rite, the giver's vigil ends. Do not go looking for an organ echo in it; there is none to take. The Hermit put it there to be handed on.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.nether_star: A Nether Star, the concentrated energy a Wither leaves when it collapses. There is real power in it, I grant you, and none of it is pointed anywhere.
Our whole discipline is about giving force like that a direction. If you want my opinion on something worth holding, bring me a thing that remembers what it is for.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.potion.line: A common alchemical potion. The old craft distills water and herbs into blunt metabolic effects, and most of the world still works that way, well enough after a fashion.
A potion does one thing to whoever drinks it. We spend our lives learning to send blood where we mean it to go.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.qliphoth.li: A Qliphoth Pome. Where did you come by it? It belongs to an Archon's private revelation, and I do not teach it alongside anything ordinary.
Nine Pomes from one Bloom, all eaten, complete Communion, and the ninth tears the Fungal Spine free. I would not teach that to anyone below that threshold.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.qliphoth.se: There is a record of this, and it is sealed above your Degree, so I will not guess at it for you. Whatever it is, do not eat it.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.salt_staine: A voyager log. The ink is nearly gone, but you can still read the order of names: watch lead, alchemist, diver, mnemonist. That is a covenant's order. They went out with work to do.
The wreck kept their mistakes and how careful they were, and you will want to know both.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.sanguine_co: A cauldron that has taken your blood keeps it and slowly sets it into formation. Draw out what it makes with your own hand. I count the lesson for anyone who fed the cauldron.
Once you have practiced, bring it to a Working floor, where the Clotting Lattice teaches it to hold more and set faster and the Druse Heart lines it in crystal so nothing slumps away.
A blank Scar, waiting for a route to be carved into it at the Cerebral Scarring Station.
Once carved, it is burned into memory at an Iron Brazier. Any later arrangement is copied through the Mason's Effigy, and the scar is never worn from your pack.
Blank scar plates are for the fourth Degree. Until then, attend to the work in front of you.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_patter: Unwritten motif paper. It is the Vein-Mason's material, and I would only spoil it.
A prepared scar loadout, its known routes arranged at the Mason's Effigy. Burn it at the Iron Brazier and that arrangement becomes active.
A scar template. It tells you how to carve one route, before you burn that route into memory.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scrying_pod: The Scrying Podium reads your blood and shows you its tendency distribution: which tendency is dominant, and which are still latent.
Use it early, while your path is still forming, and again whenever a rite or a memory weave wants a particular balance. It shows you the distribution, and what you do about it is your own judgment.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.unknown: There is nothing in the record about it, so I will not guess.
hemomancy.vicar.masons_respite.prompt: This outpost cannot teach you the next part. I will mark you the road to Masons Respite, where the Vein-Mason keeps a hermitage.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.absorption_hint: Hold Blood Absorption toward a living creature or a blood reservoir. Only blood that reaches your vessel that way goes in the ledger, so a flask or your own slow recovery will not help you. You need 500 mL in all.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.crafting_hint: You will need Befouling Ash first. Craft Foul Paste from Nether Wart, gunpowder and bone meal, and smelt the paste into ash. Then ask me for a Mnemonic Blueprint, build either pattern as it shows, hold its catalyst in your offhand and project blood into the center.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint: Four proofs stand between you and the Second Degree, in any order, and the ledger keeps count of each. Absorb 500 mL of blood. Condense a Sanguine Formation in a cauldron. Project Venous Stone. Use a blood formation to craft either a Liber Sanguinium or a Hematic Iron Block. When the ledger shows all four, bring it to me.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint.ass: After I grant the Second Degree, the Alchemist will teach you separation and the Ghastly Alembic.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.first_bloodcraf: Our provision went to you already; I have it written down. Put those materials to work before you ask me for anything else.
All four are in the ledger, and I have checked each of them myself, so I grant you the Second Degree. The Alchemist has you next, for separation and distillation.

Not yet. Open your ledger and tell me which proof is still blank, because I need all four, in any order. If it is the cauldron, project your own blood into it and collect the Sanguine Formation yourself.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line1: §7[The Vicar turns to your page in the book on his desk and runs a finger down it]
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line2: Neophyte of the Crimson Veil. The road from here is long, and for some time we will ask more of you than we explain. Is your ledger with you?
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.projection_hint: Two lessons, with two different things to aim at. Pour blood into an empty cauldron and it waits there until it crystallizes into a Sanguine Formation, which you have to take out yourself. Ordinary stone soaks the blood up and stains to Venous Stone.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.chosen_path: §7[The Vicar closes his eyes for a long moment.]§r You chose this. Then I will be plain with you. We will not mourn you, and what you are giving up will go to someone who wants it more. When you have finished becoming what you chose, there will be no place for you here, so leave this Outpost before that path takes you somewhere we cannot follow.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line1: §7[For a moment the Vicar's composure breaks. His face shows grief and contempt at once.]
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line2: I can see it on you. The Unstained path is starving your blood, and the power we gave you is coming away with it, rite by rite and Degree by Degree, everything you earned.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line3: Do you understand what you are throwing away? Every step farther down that path weakens the Covenant's gifts in you, and your power is §cslipping§r already. How far do you mean to let it go?
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.power_warning: You know, and you go on anyway. Then hear the rest of it. Every day on that path your hemomantic strength fades a little more, your manipulations dulling and your tendencies going quiet one after another. We do not reach out a second time to those who turn away. §oIf you mean to come back, come back soon.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.degree_hint: One rite remains, the Rite of the Hematic Order, and it is the hardest of them. What are you willing to give of your blood? That is the rite's question, and I would have an answer ready before you begin. It has claimed practitioners who were not ready, so prepare as thoroughly as you know how.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.hematic_order: We put the Hematic Order at the top of the Covenant, though the Archons who founded it wrote about it as a condition you arrive at, and no number of trials will hand it to you. They believed that, initiated far enough, a practitioner's blood becomes indistinguishable from the blood of the world. The last rite, as they describe it, confirms something that has already happened to you.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.line1: You are Sanctified now. The Bloodline Covenant has made you part of the Order's living body, which is further than I ever went, so tell me whether our books have it right.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.harbinger_lo: We Harbingers study blood, and most of us would rather spend a year on a question than an hour on a fight. We hold that blood is the first language of existence, and that whoever learns to speak it can go past the limits of an ordinary life. The Covenant is everything we have written down about how to learn it.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line1: §7[A man in ceremonial vestments looks up from a heavy book and keeps a finger on his place]
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line2: I do not have you in the book, so you are not one of us yet. I am the Harbinger Vicar of this outpost. I keep its record and its doctrine, and I answer questions, so ask what you like before you decide whether any of this concerns you.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.outpost_lore: One waystation among many. The work that starts at the Blood Temples goes on here, and Harbingers at every Degree stop on their way somewhere else, usually for supplies or directions. The Alchemist looks after the machines. I look after the doctrine, and the list of who came through and why.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.degree_hint: This Degree belongs to the Alchemist. They want to see two things, an assigned separation and a completed Ghastly Alembic distillation, and when you have both, ask them for Concentrated Blood. Inject it and sleep, and you will wake at the third Degree.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.line1: You took the vow and stayed, so the book has you down as a Votary of the Hematic Covenant. This is the Degree where tendencies start to settle. Have you noticed yet which way yours lean?
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.floor: Start with the Rite of the Rooted Vein. Which floor does a rite that changes the world stand on? A Dominion floor: a Lesser square of deepslate tiles or bricks, with eight Chiseled Hematic Iron blocks set around a Cardinal Focus. Leave copper out of it. It is the Unstained metal, and our pattern will not hold in it. You will build on a Working floor when you make things, and your own initiation stood on a Threshold.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.offer: Keep the block above the Focus clear. Put one Blood Rock in an Iron Brazier on a floor socket, light it with Blood Projection, and seat no medium in the Focus. This one needs no helper, no support sigil and no second offering, so you can do it alone.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.recov: When the rite completes, the Focus turns to Venous Stone with a permanent Earthen Vein above it. If you have to stop partway, hold Blood Absorption on the planted Staff until it comes back to you. Blood you paid into the anchors is gone, and so is any offering already consumed, but an offering the rite never touched will still be in its brazier.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.staff: Use your Living Staff on the Focus. Then feed the four anchors with Blood Projection and project into the daemon to seal the rite, and stay inside the boundary while it consumes the offering and comes back. If nothing happens at all, check that your blood is active and that your Degree allows the rite.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.tendency_lore: How many tendencies do we recognize in the blood? Eight: Animus, Flammeus, Ductilis, Lux, Mortem, Congeatio, Ferric and Tenebris. The Alchemist will use their common enzyme names, Vivacious, Fervent, Neurotic, Incandescent, Ruinous, Frigid, Ferric and Umbral, so you had better know both lists.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.bea: The charts put a Voyager vessel in the Overworld near X %s, Z %s. Find the crew, ask about their work and record one observation of it. A position on a chart is something I could give you from this desk, so it does not count as one.
The vessel charts are in use just now. Ask me for your bearing again shortly.
The charts show no Voyager vessel in the waters I searched, so either ask again at a different Overworld outpost or go looking for a Voyager working an Erythrocoral Reef yourself.
I will search the vessel charts while you go about your work in the Overworld, and send you the bearing once a vessel turns up. If you leave or disconnect before then, ask me again when you return.
The charts of this world give me no vessel routes to read, so you will have to find a Voyager working an Erythrocoral Reef yourself.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.lea: The Voyagers work the Erythrocoral Reef, out in the deep warm seas. Ask me for a vessel bearing before you set out, since searching blind can waste weeks. When you find a crew, speak with a Voyager and bring me back one observation of their work.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.obs: You have spoken with a Voyager in the reef waters already. What did you see? There's no need to sail out again just so the introduction can be made properly.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.rec: The Vicar records your Voyager observation and files it with the field reports.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.rep: Report the reef observation you recorded with the Voyager.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.tas: A reef or an active vessel will do. I am not asking for a whale, or ambergris, or a trophy of any kind. I want something you watched them do.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line1: That clear stillness around you makes the samples settle, and I don't think I'm imagining it.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line2: Sorry, is it rude to ask about it? I've got a whole page on you already. Just the samples part, I mean!
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line1: Yes, of course I am! Have you seen how deep it goes past the reef? I dropped a lead line once and ran out of line.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line2: My handwriting goes tiny when I'm scared. The captain can always tell which pages were the bad nights. Does it get easier for you?
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_hint: Let me see what's in your pack. I know less than the captain does, but I might catch something useful.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.c: Vent snail, right? I tried to scratch one with my knife and the knife came off worse.
It's all for keeping safe, I think. All that iron, and it just sits there. I like it more than you're meant to like a snail, probably.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.e: Hold it for a while and you'll feel it pulse. Slowly, like it's breathing. Can you feel it?
I'm not supposed to anthropomorphize samples, but I'm also supposed to write down what happens, so I did.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.m: Ordinary field gear, good! The captain checks ours every morning, every strap and every cork, and I used to think that was fussy.
I scratch a little fish on all of mine before we leave port, or they end up in other people's bunks. Have you marked yours?
The captain-scholar says this is what memory smells like after a storm watch. I've sniffed it about forty times trying to work out if that's true.

Okay, my notes say the whale leaves one ambergris above its back for each squid or Prism Cuttle it eats. So you bring squid on leads, or place and break a specimen jar nearby to let a cuttle out. And the part about not hurting the whale is underlined twice.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.s: I read one of these in the archive, and the handwriting changed near the end, but the sign-offs stayed gentle.
Panicking would've been easier, and they kept to procedure anyway. I'm honestly not sure I would have.
I keep wanting to call it holy. I don't know if a Votary's allowed to say that about a whale.
One passed right under the Cog last spring, and I forgot about my pencil for a whole hour. The captain had to write that page for me.
Oh, is something in there? Hold it up to the light. It looks cramped, doesn't it? Maybe that's just me.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.u: I don't know this one yet. What do you call it? I'll write it down either way, because 'unknown' is a real category.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line1: The captain-scholar lets me record the small stuff: jelly drift, reef pulse, which ropes start to smell like old iron.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line2: Small things are safer to be wrong about, so that's where I start. Is that how you started too?
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.purifying.line: Your rites feel so quiet. Mine are mostly questions and damp sleeves.
Is it strange, being on a Harbinger ship? I'd like it if you stayed a bit, anyway. Nobody else asks me about my notes.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line1: If the captain asks, I haven't been staring at the vent charts again. I have, though, constantly.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line2: I keep wondering why the lost crews kept going down toward the Court. Did anyone ever find out what they hoped for?
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.uninitiated.li: Careful, don't lean on the sample rack! The captain-scholar says it's older than my vows.
I'm a Votary, sort of. I'm here to learn the sea by watching it, mostly from the rail, because I still get seasick.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line1: I asked to come. I asked three times, actually, and the third time the captain said yes just so I'd stop asking.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line2: I read everything in the archive about ships, and none of it said the floor moves all the time.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line1: The Lady's clarity will show you more in deep water than any lamp on this ship.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line2: Some of the memories down there are wounds, so treat them the way you'd treat an injured diver, and don't go prying.
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.alchemist: Your Alchemist sent you seaward already, I gather. The Order keeps a list of these strains, and the Court raises them.
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.found: You found the Court before anyone sent you. What did the water do when you arrived?
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.letter: You've read one of our drowned envoys' letters, I see. They never got it to the Court themselves, so I'm glad somebody carried it the rest of the way.
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.voyager: We've talked about the Brined Court before, and I've added nothing to the log on them since.
hemomancy.voyager.court.letter_lost: So a Votary gave up a sealed letter to you, and the sea took it back. Tell me what the seal was made of, because Sunburst crust means it was bound for the Brined Court.
hemomancy.voyager.court.line1: Some Harbingers went into the sea and stayed there. We call them the Brined Court, and they raise the strains we catalog, far better than we could.
hemomancy.voyager.court.line2: We keep a cordial distance. We measure, we watch where they cultivate, and we don't presume on them. Their nearest door is the Lighthouse Garden.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line1: This Cog is our laboratory and our chapel, and on a rough watch the crew prays and takes samples at the same bench.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line2: Bring me observations first and certainty later, colleague. Most of the wrecks on this reef were crews who got sure of themselves too early.
hemomancy.voyager.introduction.observed: The Voyager logs your observation. The Vicar will want the field report when you return.
hemomancy.voyager.introduction.prompt: Tell the Voyager what you noticed about the reef's response to the current.
hemomancy.voyager.item_hint: Lay your samples out on the chart table, colleague, and point at the one you mean, so neither of us loses track.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.brine_sea: That seal is Sunburst crust. One of our lost crews was carrying this letter to the Brined Court, and the reef had their ship first.
We call anything that comes back from the Court's waters Brined, the drowned envoys included, and this letter came back without them.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.chalybeat: The vent snail grows armor about as fast as I grow footnotes: slowly, and with a lot of worry behind each layer.
Wait for it to pull into its shell, then knap only what it can spare. A dead one teaches you less than a living reef does.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.erythroco: I've had erythrocoral filed under colony, tissue, garden and archive in the same logbook, and I've yet to cross any of them out.
Take it with shears if you can. A piece cut clean keeps a gentler memory, and a piece torn out by hand mostly remembers being torn.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.minecraft: That's survey salvage. Note where it lay and what was lying beside it, before you move anything else on that shelf.
Most of it turns out to be somebody's spare boots. The one time it isn't, you'll want to know which shelf it sat on.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.mnemonic_: It comes off the great whales and drifts up in waxy layers. Hold it to a lamp and the bands show, like pressed pages.

Watch what the whale hunts first. It takes squid, glow squid and Prism Cuttles, and each one it kills sheds one ambergris on the spot, so you needn't wait on another bottle sample. Then bring it more of that prey in the same water, and keep your harpoon stowed.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.salt_stai: This field log came off the lost survey craft. The repeated watch marks say the crew waited for one another before every descent.
Their last entry asks whoever follows to study the ocean more patiently than they did, and not give up on it. I copy it into the front of every log I keep.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.spawn_egg: We call it a living archive. It carries migration, reef pulse and vent weather in its body.

It eats squid and Prism Cuttles, so feed it. Lead squid into its water or release a cuttle from a specimen jar, and every meal yields one ambergris. Whatever becomes of the prey, the whale stays alive.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.specimen_: A field specimen. Before you open it, write down the place, the depth and what the creature was doing, because you'll have forgotten by the evening watch.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.unknown: I don't know that one. Where did you find it, and how deep?
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line1: You've stood close enough to the blood-root to know why the reefs trouble me.
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line2: Cut a reef and it flinches like tissue, then grows back like coral, and it keeps currents nobody here ever taught it. Did the root strike you the same way?
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line1: You carry Lethean discipline, and I'm not going to mock it.
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line2: We scrub our hands in clean seawater before anyone touches the samples. Your people would approve of that much, I think.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line1: Mind the rail, please. This is a covenant vessel and we don't carry passengers, so stand where the crew can get past you.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line2: We chart living reefs and vent scars, and we go back over the water where older surveys sank, to find out what they got wrong.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line1: We set vent sclerites, reef tissue and drowned logs side by side on the chart table, to see where the ocean accepts Hemomancy and where it pushes back.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line2: I ask every new hand the same thing, and the first answer is usually the useful one. What did you notice first?
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line1: They were survey ships like ours, with field crews and instruments, and they trusted the reef too quickly. We still find their sounding leads in the coral.
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line2: Recover what you can, the logs first, and keep nothing from a wreck for yourself, because those crews were ours.
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v0.line1: §8§o[For a moment your veins itch from the inside, as if something in them is putting out roots.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.follow: §8§o[It fades before you can place it, and afterward your blood feels thicker.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.line1: §8§o[You smell damp soil and rotting wood, though neither is anywhere near you. Under them is the smell of something alive.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v2.line1: §8§o[You blink and for a single frame the world is threaded with pale filaments. Then it's gone.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.follow: §4§oThe Hematic Order was never a human creation. It is a reproductive strategy. Every degree is a stage of sporulation, and every rite sets off the next bloom.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line1: §4§o[The voice is perfectly clear, and it sits in your head as if it had always lived there.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line2: §4§oYou have climbed higher than nearly all of your Order, Archon. You are one of the finest fruiting bodies we have grown, and still you only carry spores for us.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line2.apothe: §4§oYou have climbed past all of your Order, Apotheos. You let us in, and you are one of the finest fruiting bodies we have grown. Still you carry spores for us.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line1: §4§o[Under your skin the blood curls into spirals and branching fractals you never commanded, the same shapes a mycorrhizal network makes.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2: §4§oThe Fungal Realm is the §4§ooriginal§4§o state. Your world is the aberration, a thin crust of stone over an infinite living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2.canon: §4§oYou call the Fungal Gardens another dimension. To us they are only the place where we touch your world, and your world is a brief crust above the living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line3: §4§oHemomancy is the fungus remembering how to reach the surface.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line1: §4§o[You lose track of which thoughts are yours and which belong to the voice.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line2: §4§oWe have waited aeons for one like you. The blood was only the lure, and you are the conduit. Will you listen?
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth1.canon: §4§oThe Hematic Order is real to those who built and loved it. To us it is also a shape that carries us outward, and blood is the most successful shape we have found.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth2: §4§oDid you think you were its master, Archon? You are something better to us: the finest spore hemomancy has ever made.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth2.apoth: §4§oDid you think you were its master, Apotheos? You opened yourself to us, and you are something better: the finest spore hemomancy has ever made.
hemomancy.whisper.busy.combat: Let the struggle settle for a few seconds before listening.
hemomancy.whisper.busy.item: Finish using the held item before listening.
hemomancy.whisper.busy.rite: Finish or leave the active rite before listening.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line2: §4§oThe crown holds no fruit, so look closer at what it does hold.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line3: §4§oThe crown is what you were before you were told what you were.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line1: §4§o[The voice comes from the walls and the roots at once, carried on the hum of a billion threads.]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line2: §4§oNow you have seen what is inside: an §4§oorganism§4§o that dreams in four dimensions and waits like stone.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line3: §4§oYou may still cut us out of you. Sever your own Bloom, outlast both faces of Vesper and take his memory into you, and you stand at the eighth Degree as a Silentium, cut away from us. Or take the Rite of Apotheos and stand at the eighth Degree as ours. Neither road ends here. Whichever you choose, you must still walk it. Will you?
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.si: [Choose Silence. Cut the Bloom and stand apart.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.follow: §7§oThe crimson tide was a forest once, roots and hyphae and mycelium, before the red drowned all of it. The roots still remember. §7§oWe always do.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line1: §7§o[A whisper threads through your mind, damp, like roots pushing through wet soil.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line2: §7§oThe blood you command was something else once, long before it answered you. Do you feel the spores shifting under your skin?
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line1: §7§o[A thought pulses behind your eyes, and you did not think it.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line2: §7§oHave you noticed the fungal growths around your altars? They are §7§oreclamation§7§o, the blood taking back what it was given.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.line1: §7§o[Something breathes wetly in your ears, as if through a mouthful of moss.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.reveal: §7§oWe grew §7§obefore§7§o the blood, and we will still be growing §7§oafter§7§o.
hemomancy.whisper.pending: A voice waits at the edge of thought (%s pending).
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.aarab_zaraq: §4§oThe fruit of A'arab Zaraq has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.gamaliel: §4§oThe fruit of Gamaliel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.ghagiel: §4§oThe fruit of Ghagiel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.golachab: §4§oThe fruit of Golachab has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.harab_serape: §4§oThe fruit of Harab Serapel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.nahemoth: §4§oThe fruit of Nahemoth has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.samael: §4§oThe fruit of Samael has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.satariel: §4§oThe fruit of Satariel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.thagirion: §4§oThe fruit of Thagirion has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line1: §4§o[Far down at the root of the world, something vast shifts once and settles, satisfied.]
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line2: §4§oGood. The first fruit is laid, and the world has tasted its own reflection.
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line1: §4§o[The voice does not rise from the shards. It walks out of the gap beside you, as though it had waited at the far end the whole time.]
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line2: §4§oThe crystal was only ever a shell. You call that a taking, Archon. We call it a hand reaching back. What it held is in yours now.
hemomancy.monolith.already_breaking: The stone has already begun to answer. Let it fall.
hemomancy.monolith.dormant: The stone has nothing more to say.
hemomancy.monolith.gate.hint: The eye has closed, not gone. It would look again for a little of your blood.
hemomancy.monolith.gate.refused: The stone does not know your blood.
hemomancy.monolith.gate.no_blood: There is too little of you left to wake it.
hemomancy.monolith.gate.inside: You are already where it leads.
hemomancy.monolith.gate.elsewhere: Part of you is elsewhere. It will not open for what is left.
hemomancy.monolith.overgrown: Something takes root in the cracks of the stone, and it will not be giving it back.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.blood_answers: His blood answers him, not you.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.lesson_brimmi: His ribs part. He cannot hold it.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.lesson_gorged: He sags, gorged. Feed him, or cut him.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.lesson_tithe: He reaches for what you owe.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.the_marrow_la: Inside the closed tomb, the marrow labours on.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.absolution_a: The palm accepts the offering. %s of %s absolutions.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.embering: The fire gutters. The rot comes back over them.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.faithful_ris: The faithful rise out of the bog.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.fire_cleanse: The heat burns your growth away.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.full_purge: The fire goes white at the core. One absolution remains.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.glyph.pour: A cupped hand burns over the palm. Pour blood into it.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.glyph.strike: A censer burns over the palm. Strike it.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.kindling_tau: The rot keeps something buried. Fire wakes it.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.overgrown: The growth roots you where you stand.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.palm_only: Only the open palm takes an offering.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.palm_opens: The palm opens. Absolve them: one blow, or blood poured into it.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.palm_refuses: The glyph names a blow. The palm takes no blood.
The glyph names blood. The palm turns the blow aside.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.rot_holds: The rot holds fast. Wait until the sacs split.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.sludge_burns: The fire runs to the pooled rot.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.sludge_taugh: The rot pools where it falls. Only the fire will take it.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.the_man_show: The fire remembers. The man shows.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.follow: §5§oEach rite you perform feeds the network, and each manipulation pushes the hyphae further. You call that mastery. We call it §5§oproliferation§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line1: §5§o[The voice is back and louder, and it brings the smell of wet earth with it.]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line2: §5§oWe infected the first Archons and made them our vessels. They believed they were learning hemomancy, but they were learning it from us, already living in their veins.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.follow: §5§oWe are one organism. You and the hermits, the fargone and the morphlings, all of you fruiting bodies of the same mycelial web.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line1: §5§o[Your blood shifts on its own, answering a voice pitched below your hearing.]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line2: §5§oThe Erythromycelium was our first expression, a fungal body wearing a crimson mask. The blood came out of §5§oit§5§o, not the other way around.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line1: §5§o[For an instant you see red threads pulsing underground, running from every root to every stone.]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2: §5§oThe temples grew. Hyphal pressure shaped their stone over millennia, and the blood that soaks them, the blood you call sacrifice, is sap.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2.ca: §5§oHands built the temples, but roots moved under every foundation. We learned each stone as the Order raised it, and sacrifice and sap soaked into the same ground.
hemomancy.whisper.silenced: You listen for the voice that was waiting. Nothing comes. You cut that thread yourself.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line1: §4§o[Wet cartilage splits with a loud, living crack.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line3: §4§oTake it up. Draw it when you must go down into the dreaming root, and draw it again when you must claw your way back.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree5: §8§o[There is a small itch between your shoulder blades. Probably nothing. The skin there feels warm for a moment, then forgets itself.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree6: §5§o[A tingle crawls up your spine, slow and deliberate, as if something inside you has learned the shape of your back.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree7: §4§o[Something in your spine strains against the meat. Your neck has gone stiff and your back barely bends. It is almost ready.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree8.c: §4§o[The return-thread is already gone from your back. Apotheosis changes what remains.]
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line1: Most of the stain has gone quiet in you, and I know that silence can feel like grief.
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line2: Once you're fully purified, clarity will ask whether you want peace or sight. If it asked you today, what would you answer?
hemomancy.zealot.already_on_path: You're already on the path of purification. Keep working at the podium and the stain will lift. So why come to me?
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line1: And what will you lay on it? The Altar takes Tears of Silthmere, Lethean Poppy Wreaths, Silver Chalices, Pallid Icons and Lethean Brew, and nothing else.
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line2: Tears, wreaths, chalices and icons count once each, so a second one buys you nothing. Lethean Brew gives less every time and stops counting after five offerings.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line1: She was one of ours. That's the part people forget first. Before the screaming and the sealed door, she was frightened and trying to be useful.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line2: The church she hid in is still standing. Take the map. If you carry mercy in there, carry it with both hands.
hemomancy.zealot.bloodline_founded: No. You founded a bloodline, and your blood runs in other people now. Our rites can't reach a root like that while your covenant stands. Leave this church now, before our Guardians have to answer for us.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line1: Your halo's opened behind you. Can you feel how little the old hunger matters now?
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line2: Verdigris is the color copper turns once it's endured. A grand name for weathered metal, I know. Follow it and the world comes into focus.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line1: Clarity Ascension is where you pledge yourself. Being cleansed isn't enough to make you Unstained. Are you ready to say it and mean it?
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line2: First restore your mortal baseline or fulfill all five vows. Then offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium and speak the rite.
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line1: You've reached the hard middle. The stain fights hardest once it knows you've named it. Have you named it, or only treated it?
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line2: Go to the Altar of Cleansing. Our Lady's tears don't flatter a wound. They wash it.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line1: Hemolytic solution starts with Lethean Dew and Ghost Pipe, with no crimson catalyst in it. Do you want to make it, or just to have asked?
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line2: Take the finished solution to the Podium to suppress the infection. Lethean Baptism comes after, when you're ready to enter the path.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line3: The first treatment hurts. That's the old current being cut off. The pain proves nothing about your devotion, so don't wear it like a medal.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line1: There's nothing left I can teach you. The still water took your reflection and gave back something clearer.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line2: Do you still remember why you were given mercy? Keep hold of that. Forget it, and even mercy throws a shadow. Go gently, Enlightened one.
hemomancy.zealot.item_hint: What are you carrying, and why? Show me, and I will tell you what the Church makes of it.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.altar_of_c: You'll need the Altar later, once you've started on blessings and offerings. It is for people already on the path. Are you on it yet?
First suppress the infection at the Podium. Lethean Baptism admits you to Purity, and only after that do your offerings come to this Altar.
Bone meal. Ground bones, and nothing holy about the sack. But it is death turned around to feed things: what lived goes back into the soil that fed it, and Our Lady is patient with that long return.
It's what I think of when I think about purification. The blood-corruption goes back into the world as something else, and things can grow out of it. I can bear that. Can you?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.cleansed_b: A cleansed blood crystal shard. Unstained rites neutralized its sanguine resonance, and what is left is inert crystal you can build and craft with.
The cleansing can't be undone. A cleansed shard has no way back to sanguine energy, which is exactly what we want. Were you hoping otherwise?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.consecrate: Consecrated Copper. It came through its change and was made ready for deeper Unstained work.
How full is your Purity? Once it is full, bring the copper to the Podium to prepare Clarity. The Rite of Clarity Ascension carries you across from there.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.copper_ing: Raw copper, the same metal we start with before the blessing. Our Lady hasn't marked it yet. It's waiting, the way metal waits, which is to say it sits in your hand.
Consecration is Retort work, with hemolytic solution as the catalyst. It's simple, but you can't hurry it. So why do you want this copper blessed?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.draught_of: We distill the Draught of Still Waters cold, from white humor and Lethean Dew. It clears Blood Loss and holds a Silver Ward around you for three minutes.
It's field medicine, not a milestone, and drinking it proves nothing to Our Lady. Are you hurt, or are you only thirsty?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hallowed_r: Hallowed Residuum is a Saint's own blood, drawn and concentrated. A Harbinger whose tendency matches the Saint's can draw it in peace. Anyone else wakes the Saint to test them.
Either way it shows the same danger: blood-power that large keeps going long after the wisdom behind it has failed. So why are you carrying it?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hemolytic_: At the Unstained Podium, hemolytic solution suppresses active infection. That only prepares the body. The Rite is what makes a practitioner Unstained.
Once the infection is suppressed, perform the Rite of Lethean Baptism. That is where Purity starts.
At the Podium, hemolytic solution quiets the blood-memory enough for a candidate to survive Baptism.
Call it preparation and nothing more. Treatment begins at Baptism, and the pledge waits for Clarity Ascension.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean.li: Lethean Dew is the Lethean Poppy, distilled at the Pallid Retort. Add a fresh poppy and it becomes Pale Distillate, and that distills again into Lethean Brew.
Use each form where the rite calls for it. Let the poetry guide your hand if it helps, but follow the recipe.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean_po: Our Lady marked the Lethean Poppy as her own. It grows where water has gone still and the blood-taint is starting to recede, so wherever you find one, purification has already started.

Take the heads for lethean dew and the distillate. Woven whole into a wreath, the plant is an offering the Altar recognizes. Leave enough poppies standing for the place to heal. How many did you leave?
A wreath of Lethean Poppies. Patient labor, offered without any bargaining with blood.
The Altar takes it as a modest Purity offering. For the exact amount, check your progress record. Prayer won't tell you.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.liber_imma: The Liber Immaculatus is the guide we work from. Its First Steps lay out the exact sequence: Podium, Cleansed Stone, then Baptism.
Keep it. The later pages cover Purity, Clarity and the defensive Still Arts once you need them. Don't skip to the parts about power.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lily_of_th: Lily of the Valley grows in still, shady places, the kind Our Lady favors. We have no formal Altar rite for it, yet it keeps turning up near places of cleansing as if it knows where it belongs.
A few older texts call it a sign that the ground is recovering wherever it grows. We've never made a rite of that, and maybe we should. Or maybe it's a flower that likes shade.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.milk_bucke: Milk. The old folk remedy for poison, the first thing people reach for to cleanse themselves from inside. There is some truth in it, even if the Altar works another way. Our Lady reaches back toward anyone reaching for purity.

The path is that same reaching, only deeper. Milk draws out what's on the surface. Hemolytic solution goes after the blood-matrix underneath, and the Altar is there for that depth. Which are you after?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.minecraft_: Plain material, good for patient work. Purification gets built out of things like this far more often than out of miracles.
Use it where the rite asks. Were you hoping for something grander? Don't think less of an offering because it's simple.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_disti: Pale Distillate is Lethean Dew worked together with a whole poppy, or Ghost Pipe run through the Retort. It's everything the poppy offers, pressed small.
Distill it once more and you have the Lethean Brew the Altar takes. If you mean to work that hard for your purity, plan your harvest around it. Do you mean to?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_humor: A Pale Humor Flask holds purified White Humor. That's lymph cleared of hematic corruption. Don't mistake it for holy blood.
Keep it sealed. It's meant for preservation and cleansing work. What did you want it for?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_silve: Pale Silver is what Consecrated Copper becomes at the next stage, refined in the Pallid Retort with white humor. No mine will give you any.
It earned its stillness the same way we earn ours.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_ico: This is a consecrated copy of the Pallid Icon. The original is the relic from the river. The copies keep its faceless gesture, that still-water posture with a patience underneath it.
Carry it, wear it or set it down. Some practitioners say it makes them more receptive near the Altar. Our Lady notices sincerity, and display doesn't move her. Which is this?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_inf: Pallid Infusion is a battlefield restorative distilled from Ghost Pipe and White Humor.
It clears Blood Loss and gives you a short regeneration. It won't bring Clarity. That comes through Consecrated Copper at the Podium and the Rite of Clarity Ascension.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.purificati: That is Unstained rite equipment: practical vessels and fittings for controlled purification work.
Use it carefully, at consecrated stations. Purification takes discipline. Fervor burns out. Which of the two did you bring?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.self_refle: The Self-Reflection Mirror opens your Unstained progress record: your purity, your clarity and where you stand on the path. Keep one close. Every practitioner should.
It shows you what you are. Our Lady gives you the reading plainly, and the deciding is left to you.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.silver_cha: The Silver Chalice is for Clarity work, once the second path has opened for you. Has it?
Offer it when the rite and your progress call for it. The mirror keeps the number. We keep the meaning.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.snow_block: Snow is water that chose to stay where it fell. Deep snow has a little of Our Lady in it, that cold that asks nothing of you and waits.
The path leads toward a fullness that can stay still, and deep snow feels close to that. It is also just cold, I grant you. Get there in your practice and you'll understand what I mean.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.sugar.line: Sugar is what's left after refining, the sweetness that stays once the raw stuff is boiled down to its real character. Clarity can feel like that. The work leaves you only yourself.
That's as far as the comparison goes, though, because it's sugar. The farther you walk the path, the simpler things get, and the more completely they turn out to be themselves.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.tears_of_s: Tears of Silthmere. A crafted distillation, named for Silthmere, one of Our Lady's liturgical titles.
Their potency comes from disciplined preparation and consecration. Did you think it was grief? Mortal grief and wild water have nothing to do with it.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unknown: That has no use on the path. Why did you think it would?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unstained_: Unstained armor is pale silver alloy all through. It resists blood-corruption on contact, and once you're well along the path you can wear it without disturbing your purification.
Wear the full set and it carries its blessing, with Our Lady's protection gathering around you in her metal. Putting it on says you've committed. Have you?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.water_buck: Water is Our Lady's element. Still water covers the deep, carries off whatever has been shed and remembers everything it touches. She lives in water that waits until it decides to move.
Carry it with intention. Still water brought to the Altar sincerely is a gesture, and the Altar won't count it for you. Our Lady sees gestures. She also sees buckets carried for show.
hemomancy.zealot.no_blood: There's no mark of the blood arts on you. So why come to us? If it's the Church you want anyway, you can take five vows of clean service.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree0.line2: The infection has only just wounded you, and I'm sorry. It can still be treated.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree1.line2: The first rite has marked you. That infection is still fresh, so give it time before you call it a calling. What made you take the rite?
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree2.line2: Votary. You've started calling the stain a covenant. Who taught you that word? It hasn't claimed all of you yet.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree3.line2: Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane. So which is it, healing or another power? Say it plainly. We've learned to be afraid of curiosity dressed up as repentance.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree4.line2: Adept. The blood has given you craft, companions, and an appetite to go with them. Did you come for a cure, or for conquest? Don't make me guess.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree5.line2: Illuminatus. The Crimson Lodge has looked back at you through your own veins, and you come here anyway. Why now? I won't pretend I trust you easily.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree6.line2: This deep in the Degrees, and still no bloodline of your own? Then the cure is open to you, though it won't come quickly. Why come to us now, so late?
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line1: §7[The Zealot regards you with silver eyes]
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line3: You asked, so here it is. It isn't too late. Hemolytic rites can cleanse what the Hematic Order corrupted in you.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line4: Bring hemolytic solution to our podium and start on the Unstained path. Leave the crimson veil behind before it consumes you.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line1: Silver Ward takes the defense Verdigris started and carries it further. With Clarity, what used to be a warning from outside becomes a boundary the blood's current has a hard time crossing.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line2: In Purity, the Verdigris Aura learned to recognize infection. Now Clarity teaches Silver Ward to refuse it when it gives orders. Can you tell yet when it's giving them?
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line1: The first pallor is in you. Good. Is that relief you're feeling? It's only the start.
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line2: Your Verdigris Aura will answer more readily now. It's the first boundary your blood is learning to respect.
hemomancy.zealot.take_vows.prompt: Will you serve the Church until every one of the five vows is done? Then take them. They are work, with no ceremony to hide behind.
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line1: Virid Salis and verdigris are corruption spent and turned into a ward. We work with them. We don't decorate with them.
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line2: Lay them where blood gathers. The line won't clear out what's already there, but it won't let any pass.
hemomancy:components/blood_binding.descr: Roots the target in place, preventing movement. Duration and magnitude scale with spell attributes.
hemomancy:components/blood_loss.descript: Applies the Blood Loss effect, slowing the target's movement. Composable with any MnA shape and modifier.
hemomancy:components/blood_rush.descript: Applies the Blood Rush effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, and minor healing. Composable with any MnA shape.
hemomancy:components/blood_to_mana.descr: Drains the target's blood volume and converts it into mana for the caster. The inverse of Sanguine Transmutation.
hemomancy:components/hemolysis.descripti: Applies Hemolysis, a damaging effect that destroys the target's blood over time. Composable with AoE shapes for area denial.
hemomancy:components/mana_to_blood.descr: Converts the caster's mana into blood volume for the target. Useful for refilling blood pools using arcane energy.
Increases breeding and growth of nearby animals with blood magic. Useful on farms and animal pens.
hemomancy:components/summon_sanguilith.d: Summons a Sanguilith at the target location. Requires Harbinger faction membership. Duration and damage scale with spell attributes.
item.hemomancy.absolution_dagger.tooltip: Permanently hemolytic; every strike disrupts blood-borne infection.
item.hemomancy.bloody_vial.examine: Examine with a Hematic Microscope to reveal its responses.
item.hemomancy.bloody_vial.inject: Hold use for 0.8 s to inject. The empty vial is retained.
item.hemomancy.bloody_vial.saturation: Transfusion Saturation: 20 s before another injection.

item.hemomancy.book_of_observances.toolt: Records NPC-directed observances, their offerings, and their fulfillment.

Show it to a Vicar, an Alchemist or a Voyager.

Knap from a retracted Chalybeate Snail; killing rarely preserves useful scrap.
item.hemomancy.chamber_of_will_teleporte: Right-click to enter The Chamber of Will, right-click again to return.

item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.not_found: The threads find no Circus pavilion within their reach.
item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.searching: The threads lift off the waybill and feel for the Circus.
item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.tooltip: A scarlet route inked by a Mnemonist who refuses to call it a map.
item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.tooltip.us: Use: next eligible untaught professor. Sneak-use: unfinished pavilion.
item.hemomancy.cleansing_hemolymph.toolt: A blue vial of cleansing fluid from Hemolymphopoda or Ice Fish
item.hemomancy.erythrocoral_fragment.too: Warm reef tissue from a Vivacious fungal coral.
Shear reef fans and tendrils for the cleanest harvest.
item.hemomancy.fruiting_lure.tooltip: Let it soak in Morphic Nectar to call the Mycophant back to a proven Apotheos.
item.hemomancy.gourd_seeds.tooltip: A strange crop seed found in common grass, and the first step onto the blood path.
item.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_ledg: Hermit Road: seek abandoned hermit cells and blood-stained stones like the one from your own first invitation.
First wild remnant recorded. Return future discoveries to the proper Harbinger.
A Vicar's ledger for keeping Harbinger assignments in order.
Use to review current assignment notes.

item.hemomancy.harbinger_lodestone.not_f: The lodestone finds no Harbinger Outpost within its reach.

item.hemomancy.hematic_iron_scrap.toolti: Iron scraped from a wound, still dark with the blood it soaked up.
Can be reclaimed as an iron nugget if you have no use for it yet.
item.hemomancy.hematic_memory_tool.blood: The tool finds too little awakened blood.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.fan: This link is outside your fane or needs Degree 5.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.ina: Your blood is not yet awakened.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.inv: The needle finds no blood route to stitch here.

item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.opt: You close your bloodline to fane routing.

item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.sta: Use on a blood machine or node. Sneak-use to toggle bloodline opt-in.
item.hemomancy.husk_effigy.tooltip: Rehydrates into a short-lived allied distraction.
item.hemomancy.liber_sanguinum.tooltip.f: The Hematic Order's field guide. New pages appear as you progress.

item.hemomancy.living_sickle.tooltip.hoo: Blood Hook: use to throw, wound, and pull a distant foe

item.hemomancy.memory_thread.stop: The thread knots the route shut.

Each squid or Prism Cuttle a whale kills yields one immediately. Bottle sampling and gentle shedding also work; keep the whale alive.

Right-click in the air to study

item.hemomancy.orb_of_perspective.outsid: The Orb works only inside its owner's Chamber.

item.hemomancy.relay_chart.attuned: The chart settles on a bearing toward the Lighthouse Garden.
item.hemomancy.relay_chart.not_found: No Lighthouse Garden lies within the chart's reach from here.

Vicar and Mnemonist inquiry can recover some of its meaning.

item.hemomancy.silthmere_glaive.tooltip: A long pale silver glaive, consecrated under Silthmere, Our Lady's liturgical title.
item.hemomancy.sporitic_thurible.message: Hold an aligned spore in your main hand.
The thurible will not answer below Degree %s.
Your blood is not awake enough to feed the thurible.
The thurible must hang from your offhand.
item.hemomancy.sporitic_thurible.tooltip: Unlit. Hold an aligned spore in your main hand to kindle it.

item.hemomancy.stained_church_map.not_fo: The map stains your fingers, but finds no broken church nearby.
item.hemomancy.stained_church_map.points: The stained map pulls %s, about %s blocks away. (%s, %s)

item.hemomancy.station_upgrade.free_kit: Free kit unclaimed: speak to %s when eligible.
item.hemomancy.synaptic_step.tooltip: Dormant. Dismantle in a crafting grid to recover its Naeglerophaeon Ganglion for the Somatic Loom.

item.hemomancy.tendon_line.too_far: The tendon cannot stretch that far.

item.hemomancy.vein_spider.linked: The spider threads both inventories together.
item.hemomancy.vein_spider.no_inventory: The spider cannot bite into that block.

jei.hemomancy.sanguine_condenser.info: Project blood into an empty cauldron to make a Sanguine Cauldron. It condenses Sanguine Formations from the blood it holds; take them out with an empty hand. The Vicar's Working rites raise it into Latticed and Druse Condensers.

material.hemomancy.aculeate_vitriol.desc: Biting corrosive infusion for Barbed sidegrades.
material.hemomancy.adipocere.desc: Corpse wax. Scrape it off an unharvested bog body with an axe, take it from bog revenants, distill it from honeycomb and a Ruinous Enzyme, or find it crusted on the walls of old dungeons, strongholds and ancient cities.
material.hemomancy.altar_of_cleansing.de: Sacred altar devoted to Our Lady of Still Waters. Grants purity boosts through offerings.
material.hemomancy.ambergris_cylinder.de: Whale-derived medium for ancient records and Masterwork Forge patterns; also accepts ordinary recordings.
material.hemomancy.corpse_wax_cylinder.d: Adipocere bound with hematic iron. Holds Masterwork patterns and can be recut after ordinary Forge applications.
material.hemomancy.barbed_blade.desc: Cruel living weapon lined with blood-drawing barbs.
material.hemomancy.bleeding_bulb.desc: Primary bleeding-heart flora reagent for hemomantic recipes.
material.hemomancy.bleeding_heart.desc: Crimson flower that bleeds on harvesting. Brews into blood-positive potions.
material.hemomancy.blood_basin.desc: Ritual basin used to pool sanguine energy for blood crafting.
material.hemomancy.blood_crystal_block.d: A crystallized concentration of sanguine energy.
material.hemomancy.blood_crystal_shard.d: A shard of crystallized blood energy.
material.hemomancy.blood_gourd_white.des: Organic gourd cultivated to store blood naturally.
material.hemomancy.blood_lust_helm.desc: Savage armor that empowers bloodthirsty combat.
material.hemomancy.blood_rock.desc: Dense stone saturated with sanguine energy.
material.hemomancy.blood_stained_stone.d: Craft each from one Venous Stone, one Sanguine Formation, and redstone, or find it in a Hermitage Remnant. A blank Hematic Memory needs four.
material.hemomancy.blood_wood_log.desc: Dense crimson-barked log from the fungal tree of the Sporecrown biome.

Return for the Crimson Vestment Fitting.
Complete and wear the Blood Lust set.

Upgrade one forked armor piece into Blood Lust.
All eight enzyme expressions recorded. Your Vial Centrifuge work is done.
Carry each enzyme to record all eight expressions. Cultivation is a separate Vocation step.
Bring filled ecology specimen jars to the Alchemist. Morphling layer families recorded: %s.
The covenant survived in shared action. The Archon rite is open.
Enter and safely leave the Chamber, bind the Covenant Throne, then finish Covenant Vigil with a surviving assigned helper.
Four specimens cataloged. Keep harvesting: Bulbs serve bloodcraft, Foul Paste starts living infrastructure, and Spore Sacs feed cultures.
Three lanes: Bleeding Heart/Sarcodes to Bleeding Bulbs; Infected Fungus/Stinkhorn/Devil's Tooth to Foul Paste; Puffball/Rafflesia to Spore Sacs. A Fungling sample also yields Infected Fungus.
Accept First Draws. You get five empty Blood Vials once, and any that don't fit wait until you have space. You never need this Side work for Degree 2.
Speak with the Alchemist and accept the First Separation.

screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.antiphonomyc: Antiphonomyces Resonans answers impact with a counter-song. Violence enters the body, and the scar teaches the vessel how to echo that force in useful directions.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.cryostroma_p: Cryostroma Perdurans forms a cold skin over living mycelium. Motion and casting crack the frost, while stillness conserves blood and gives damaged vascular paths time to close.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.noctifly_aga: The Noctifly Agaric unfurls pale mycelial wings when the wearer wills it. The fungus carries the practitioner into a hover, closer to being lifted than learning to fly.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.oculiflora_r: Oculiflora Reticularis opens in darkness like an eye grown from hyphae. It catches nearby signals and passes them into forms the wearer's blood can understand.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.putrivora_re: Putrivora Resolvens knows the taste of poison, wither, hunger, and blood loss. It shortens each affliction's meal, then returns what little nourishment the suffering contained.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.rhizovitta_c: Rhizovitta Communis roots the vessel into the fungal floor and lets the surrounding mycelium answer blood spent in motion. It feels like buried veins feeding the body from below.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.saprovitta_v: Saprovitta Vestigium leaves a feeding wake behind the moving practitioner. Anyone who follows steps into hungry blood-fungus and meets the garden's appetite firsthand.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_anvil: The Anvil fixes iron into the blood, the joints, and finally the earth beneath them. The practitioner becomes nearly immovable, and every step carries that same weight.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_blight: The Blight turns the practitioner's own toxins outward. The body learns to treat poison as a weapon, though the same venom can still read its bearer as the wound.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_blood_h: The Blood-Honed Scar lets an enchanted edge draw strength from the blood behind it. The deeper the weapon's enchantment bites, the more blood the strike spends.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_chimera: Two bodies move through one vessel. The Chimera quickens the strike, the step, and the heartbeat until armor becomes dead weight and the body starts feeding the pace.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_corona: The Corona drives Flammeus discipline to its final stage. Every strike burns hotter, the body stands firm against impact, and armor blisters away while the veins keep feeding the heat.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_crucibl: The Crucible demands motion and returns iron. Blood settles into armor, toughness, and a deeper Iron Heart, leaving the practitioner built like a wall and forced to move like one.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_descend: The Descendence aligns blood with the deep cold. The practitioner crosses frozen ground with extraordinary speed, but the cold reaches the hands and drains force from every slower strike.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_eye: The Eye carves sight directly into the hemomantic lattice. Darkness opens around the practitioner while each moment of that vision drains blood and each quick step leaves less force behind the blow.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_feral: The Feral reaches beneath doctrine for the hunger that came before it. The hand strikes faster, but the skin gives up some of the armor it once carried.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_flux: The Flux keeps blood from settling into one shape. Strikes arrive faster as armor loosens around the changing form, so every gain in speed leaves the vessel easier to open.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_glacier: The Glacier slows the hands so the rest of the body can move with cold precision. The practitioner gains speed across the field, but every strike must drag itself through the frost first.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_halo: The Halo follows those who learned to endure. It hardens the body against heavy blows, then makes every step feel the weight of that protection.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_heart: The Heart is the first scar and states its price plainly. It gives the vessel more life by narrowing the blood it can hold, so survival grows while the power available to spend grows smaller.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_marrow: The Marrow reaches past blood and into the reserve buried in bone. The vessel gains more life, then pays for that depth with a smaller blood pool and a heavier step.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_moon: The Moon aligns blood with a rhythm the practitioner cannot command. The shadow carries the body faster while each blow lands with less force, an ebb and flow written into motion.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_oblivio: The Oblivion strips away whatever a vessel can spare. Its bearer strikes harder while health and blood drain with the same steady appetite.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_phoenix: The Phoenix pours vitality back into a vessel prepared to burn for it. More life survives inside the body, but the blood pool closes tight and every step slows under the cost of carrying it.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_pyre: The Pyre sharpens the strike by feeding protection into it. The practitioner hits harder because the body has given the blade one less layer to cross.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_rime: The Rime sends cold into the legs before it reaches the hands. Movement quickens across the frozen field, then each strike loses time to the ice gathering in the wrists.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_shade: The Shade lets the practitioner move through darkness with the speed of a passing thought. The body arrives quickly, but the strike behind it lands with less force.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_sol: The Sol teaches blood to answer heat before the mind can. The strike grows sharper as the guard burns away, leaving the practitioner bright, fast to wound, and easier to wound in return.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_thorn: The Thorn turns each wound into tougher armor and a deeper Iron Heart, while the iron added to the blood weighs down the legs.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_transce: The Transcendence burns through the limits carried in a practitioner's blood. What remains is harder to break, slower to move, and forced to survive on a thinner blood reserve.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_veil: The Veil hides its bearer in plain light. That radiance hardens the body against heavy blows, but it gathers around every movement until speed gives way beneath it.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_wither: The Wither pulls vital excess from its target and puts that force behind the practitioner's strike. The vessel gives up part of its own health to keep making the claim.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.talaromyces_: Talaromyces Minus decomposes dead matter. Once etched into the hemomantic lattice, it leads the hand along ferric seams as if stone were only the next thing waiting to be broken down.

skill.hemomancy.base.desc: The root of your hemomantic potential.
skill.hemomancy.deep_base.desc: The inner root opens at the fifth Degree. Every deeper discipline branches out from here.
skill.hemomancy.skill_ancestral_sovereig: Your authority carries into the oldest covenant rites. Improves domain-style covenant bonuses and ally support per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_arterial_cadence.d: Your draw matches the pressure of a trained artery. Reaches the mature Blood Absorption damage cadence.
skill.hemomancy.skill_automatic_coagulat: Spend blood over time to suppress active bleeding.
skill.hemomancy.skill_autonomous_retalia: Bound summons also retaliate when another puppet is attacked.
skill.hemomancy.skill_blood_flow.desc: Reduces manipulation cooldowns by 5% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_blood_tolerance.de: Your vessels endure longer contact with stolen blood. Delays weakness, nausea, and blood poisoning from living-target absorption per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_bloodhound_sense.d: Sense nearby wounded, bleeding, and blood-rich creatures through cover.
Your draws on the bloodline pool run cleaner. Improves shared pool draw and donation efficiency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_bound_command.desc: The crossbar's tether holds longer and farther. Per level: +32 charge capacity, +4 blocks tether range, and +1 second unequipped grace.
skill.hemomancy.skill_bright_eyed.desc: Lux revelation reaches 10% farther and lasts 20% longer per level; Blindness and Darkness expire 20% faster per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_coagulation.desc: +15% chance to block incoming bleed effects. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_mastery.de: The blood roots deeper in you. +15% manipulation damage/effectiveness per level. Lingering state damage (Searing, Blood Loss, Necrosis release) stays flat.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_projection: The staff projects blood with finer pressure. Increases Living Staff structure and vessel feed rates per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_wake.desc: While badly wounded, sprinting leaves a brief slowing and revealing blood wake.
skill.hemomancy.skill_deep_inscription.d: Your tier-three scars accept deeper writing. Required for standard tier-three scar crafting and slightly extends tier-three scar effects.
skill.hemomancy.skill_deep_scar_resonanc: Permit equipped scars to express stronger secondary effects at greater upkeep.
skill.hemomancy.skill_distributed_siphon: Divide Blood Absorption across several targets without multiplying its total draw.
skill.hemomancy.skill_dormant_symbiote.d: Suspend morphling upkeep while its gifts are idle and it does not need bonding blood.
skill.hemomancy.skill_dragging_siphon.de: You learn to keep walking while you draw. Allows very slow movement while channeling Blood Absorption.
skill.hemomancy.skill_dynamic_use.desc: Manipulations of your strongest tendency cost less blood: their cost is divided by 1 + 10% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_efficiency.desc: Each level multiplies manipulation blood cost by 0.92.
skill.hemomancy.skill_fane_suture.desc: Owned suture links route blood with less hesitation. Improves direct routing transfer and working reserve per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_far_tether.desc: +8 blocks of summon tether and hostile-acquisition range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_feeding_frenzy.des: +25% blood gained from kills. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_fungal_symbiosis.d: Fungal scars work as part of your body. Improves fungal scar scaling per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_guarded_feeding.de: Convert excess absorbed blood into temporary protection at reduced efficiency.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hematic_focus.desc: The Living Staff holds a steadier focus. A midgame staff upgrade that improves staff absorption and projection.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hemostasis.desc: Reduces blood lost when taking damage by 10% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_high_strung.desc: Toggle an over-tensioned puppet link. Per level, bodies move faster, strike sooner, and obey 4 blocks farther, but consume more thread and blood and recoil through you when destroyed.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hungry_pulse.desc: The siphon bites in a steadier rhythm. Further increases living-target Blood Absorption pulse frequency.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hyphal_cultivation: Cultivated hyphae listen through carried bodies. Each level adds 3% to the chance that a Marrowplume's Whale Fall leaves a Spore Sac.
skill.hemomancy.skill_iron_handed.desc: +0.5 melee knockback but -7.5% attack speed per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_iron_will.desc: 10% damage reduction per level when blood is below 15%.
skill.hemomancy.skill_last_wind.desc: Regenerate +0.5 mL/tick (10 mL/s) per level while below 10% blood.
skill.hemomancy.skill_light_footed.desc: In strong light, gain 5% movement speed and 0.15 step height per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_conduit.des: The Living Staff reaches further. Increases staff absorption targets and range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_sinew.desc: Bound summons gain +15% health and +10% damage per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_manip_slots.desc: +1 equipped manipulation slot per level. (Max 9 total; excess refunded as skill points.)
skill.hemomancy.skill_merciful_command.d: Bound summons stop attacking ordinary targets near defeat.
skill.hemomancy.skill_mobile_conduit.des: You learn to move while the staff draws. Reduces the Blood Absorption channeling slowdown per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_nerves_of_steel.de: Reduce knockback and Slowness duration by 15-20% per level; damaged charged manipulations retain 25% more charge per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_persistent_arsenal: Living Weapon forms remain shaped when you leave their hotbar slot.
skill.hemomancy.skill_primal_morphogenes: The final morphling lesson becomes less ruinous. Reduces Morphic Strain and improves primal morphling bonuses.
skill.hemomancy.skill_puppet_skein.desc: +1 active bound summon per level. This cap is player-bound, not crossbar-bound.
skill.hemomancy.skill_qliphoth_gestation: Qliphoth fruit lingers in the blood. Improves pome empowerment duration and efficiency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_quick_caster.desc: Selecting a quick manipulation from the radial wheel or cycle key casts it at once. Charged, channeled, passive, staff-form and conjuring manipulations still wait for the cast key.
skill.hemomancy.skill_quickened_draw.des: The first practiced cadence shortens the pause between Blood Absorption damage pulses.
skill.hemomancy.skill_reflexive_coagulat: Spend blood at the instant of injury to prevent severe bleeding from worsening.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_crystalli: Steadies a Sanguine Cauldron: reduces its collapse chance by 5% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_reach.des: Your blood reaches further from your body. Each level grants +15% range to ranged blood manipulations.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_reserve.d: Protect an emergency floor of blood from passive and automatic spending.
While holding your owner-attuned Crossbar, spend 10 blood each second to wind 1 thread charge. Sanguine Reserve protects its floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_surge.des: Passive blood regen of +0.25 mL/tick (5 mL/s) per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sated_siphon.desc: Keep drawing blood from living targets at full blood volume, preserving Blood Absorption's damage pulse.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_affinity.desc: The mind takes to cerebral scarring more easily. +10% scar effect potency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_mastery.desc: The scarred pathways are fully colonized, and their effects linger. Scar effects last 20% longer per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_resonance.des: Scar and blood bind tighter. +1 equippable scar slot per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_selective_hunger.d: Ignore passive, allied, and tamed creatures unless you aim directly at them.
skill.hemomancy.skill_servitor_tender.de: Drudges and thralls move blood with practiced hands. Improves servitor throughput and routing range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_shared_siphon.desc: Share part of absorbed blood with bonded allies and bloodline routes.
skill.hemomancy.skill_skein_transpositio: You can swap your prepared skein in the field. Unlocks the Crossbar's outer radial for hot-swapping puppets in one step.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sporitic_attunemen: The thurible's spores find your pulse. Improves Sporitic Thurible aura range and reduces blood upkeep per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_symbiotic_metaboli: A fed morphling can draw half its upkeep from your hunger while preserving a safe food floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_synaptic_memory.de: The Dendritic Distributor teaches your blood to remember whole mnemonic patterns. +1 saved pattern slot per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_thread_economy.des: The crossbar spends charge with restraint. Reduces bound summon call and upkeep charge costs by 5% per level, to a 70% floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_unbound_siphon.des: The siphon no longer roots your body. Removes Blood Absorption movement penalties.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vascular_draw.desc: The staff learns to draw without hesitation. Increases staff absorption amount and block or reservoir draw rate per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vascular_mercy.des: Ordinary Blood Absorption stops before killing its target.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vespers_refusal.de: Vesper's disciplined refusal amplifies the Living Staff's focus and unlocks its final inherited limb: the Living Sickle.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vital_link.desc: The blood you spill can tie a thread back to you. Each level adds a 10% chance to heal when a manipulation deals damage.
skill.hemomancy.skill_weapons_master.des: Reduces Living Staff weapon hot-swap cost by 50 mL per level.
